jobs.title: Financial Controller (Remote)
jobs.description:
Finance Controller

Location: Fully remote
Start date: ASAP
Languages: Fluent English required
Industry: Data Center Infrastructure / Technology

About the Role

Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing company specializing in the design, production, and installation of data center infrastructure.

As the company scales its large, capital-intensive projects, we are seeking an experienced Finance Controller to own financial control, treasury, and contract governance across the business.

This role is critical in an environment where long-cycle customer contracts, supplier payment terms, milestone billing, revenue recognition, and significant working capital swings directly impact the company's cash position.

You'll work closely with Project, Operations, Procurement, Sales, Commercial, and Senior Leadership teams, providing financial visibility across projects while ensuring strong controls, accurate reporting, and healthy liquidity.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own financial oversight of complex customer, supplier, and subcontractor contracts, including milestones, payment terms, change orders, retentions, and cost-to-complete.

  • Manage long-term contract revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15, including percentage-of-completion / input methods, contract assets, liabilities, and unbilled revenue.

  • Monitor project profitability and financial risk, including cost overruns, margin erosion, schedule delays, and cash-at-risk.

  • Own key financial controls, monthly close, management reporting, and audit coordination.

  • Lead day-to-day and forward-looking cash flow management, including rolling weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts.

  • Monitor and optimize working capital, including customer receivables, supplier terms, inventory, and project-related cash requirements.

  • Manage banking relationships, credit facilities, project finance, and asset-backed lending where applicable.

  • Monitor FX exposure across international equipment, materials, and contracts.

  • Partner with Sales, Procurement, and Project teams on commercial terms, payment structures, guarantees, and financial risk before contracts are signed.

  • Provide Senior Leadership with clear visibility into liquidity, funding requirements, project profitability, and overall financial performance.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in financial controlling or a similar finance role.

  • Experience in EPC, infrastructure, construction, equipment manufacturing, data centers, or other project-based businesses.

  • Strong experience with financial and management reporting under GAAP and/or IFRS.

  • Advanced knowledge of ASC 606 / IFRS 15 and long-term contract revenue recognition.

  • Demonstrated experience in treasury, cash flow management, and working capital within a project-based or capital-intensive business.

  • Experience reviewing complex customer, supplier, and subcontractor contracts from a financial perspective.

  • Strong understanding of project profitability, cost-to-complete, and financial risk.

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Sales, Procurement, Legal, Project, Operations, and Senior Leadership.

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • Fluent English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent qualification.

  • Previous Big 4 accounting or audit experience.

  • Experience with data center infrastructure, EPC, construction, manufacturing, or large-scale equipment projects.

  • Experience with project finance, credit facilities, or asset-backed lending.

  • Experience managing multi-currency operations and FX exposure.

  • Experience with ASC 842 / IFRS 16.

  • Experience building financial controls and processes in a high-growth organization.

Why Join Us

You will take on a key finance role within a fast-growing data center infrastructure company, with direct influence over the financial performance and liquidity of large-scale projects.

This role offers high ownership and cross-functional exposure, working closely with commercial, operational, and leadership teams on projects where financial control and cash management are critical to success.

You'll have the opportunity to help build and scale robust finance processes while working at the intersection of technology, infrastructure, and the rapidly growing data center industry.

Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process.

We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

In accordance with GDPR*, your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely, and used solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration. You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data at any time. We are committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your information throughout the recruitment process.*

jobs.title: Account Executive - SMB Inbound (Inside Sales)
jobs.description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Mission Principale :
 
En tant qu'Account Executive SMB, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de notre portefeuille clients en traitant l'intégralité du cycle de vente, de la qualification des leads entrants jusqu’au closing.
 
Votre focus sera les leads entrants non identifiés dans notre CRM, en dehors des sociétés déjà connues de notre base de données. Vous aurez pour objectif de transformer ces opportunités en contrats clients.
 
 
Responsabilités :
 
1. Gestion du cycle de vente intégral :
- Qualification des leads entrants : Identifier et prioriser les leads générés par le marketing ou d'autres canaux, avec un focus sur les entreprises SMB (1 à 5 juristes).
- Compréhension des besoins clients : Mener des découvertes approfondies et efficaces pour comprendre les défis et besoins spécifiques des prospects afin de proposer la solution la plus adaptée.
- Présentation des solutions : Démonstration de notre plateforme SaaS et de ses fonctionnalités en lien avec les enjeux des prospects.
- Négociation et closing : Gérer la proposition de valeur, négocier les termes du contrat et finaliser les ventes jusqu'à la signature.
 
2. Suivi des opportunités commerciales :
- Utilisation proactive du CRM pour tenir à jour les opportunités, le pipeline de vente, et assurer un suivi rigoureux des prospects.
- Priorisation des opportunités les plus chaudes
- Participer aux réunions hebdomadaires de revue du pipeline
 
3. Collaboration interservices :
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Marketing, Produit et Customer Success pour assurer une excellente expérience client.
- Remonter les feedbacks des prospects et clients pour améliorer le produit et les processus commerciaux.
 
4. Développement de la connaissance marché :
- Maintenir une veille active sur les évolutions du secteur juridique et des besoins spécifiques des entreprises juridiques SMB.
- Proposer des initiatives pour améliorer la qualification des leads et les stratégies de vente sur ce segment de marché.
 
Objectifs et KPIs :
- Honorer un nombre de volume rdvs journaliers issus de la qualification de leads entrants.
- Taux de conversion des leads entrants en opportunités qualifiées.
- Allier qualité et opportunisme dans traitement des salescycle pour convertir avec le meilleur Sales Cycle.
- Atteinte des quotas de vente mensuels et trimestriels.

Compétences requises :
  • Expérience commerciale : Expérience significative en tant qu’Account Executive, Business Developer ou poste similaire, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS ou dans la vente de solutions B2B.
  • Cycle de vente complet : Capacité prouvée à gérer un cycle de vente de bout en bout (qualification, négociation, closing).
  • Orienté résultats : Forte capacité à atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente, avec un excellent sens des priorités.
  • Communication : Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec des interlocuteurs variés.

    • Qualités personnelles :
  • Autonomie et proactivité : Capacité à travailler de manière autonome dans un environnement startup en forte croissance.
  • Écoute active : Vous êtes à l’écoute des besoins de vos interlocuteurs et savez adapter votre discours en conséquence.
  • Esprit d'équipe : Vous aimez collaborer avec les autres départements pour atteindre des objectifs communs.
  • Adaptabilité : Vous êtes flexible et capable de vous adapter rapidement aux changements dans un environnement en constante évolution.
  • Résilience : Vous avez une forte capacité à surmonter les obstacles et à persévérer pour atteindre vos objectifs.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)
     
     
    Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !
    Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
    Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
     
    Diversité & inclusion
    Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
    Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

At the Diest facility, imported Toyota and Lexus automotive parts are stored, orders for dealers and distributors are picked and assembled, and shipments are prepared and dispatched. TPCE is a modern, highly automated distribution center specializing in automotive parts logistics.


Jobomschrijving

Toyota Diest is looking for forklift operators who are passionate about their profession and seeking a long-term career opportunity.

Are you the person we're looking for? Then Toyota is the right place for you!

As a Forklift Operator, your responsibilities include:

  • Order picking
  • Moving automotive parts and placing/removing them from warehouse racks
  • Stacking various pallets
  • ...

You will start working in a specific department, where you will learn all aspects of the operation. Over time, you will also become familiar with other departments. At Toyota, there is always room for growth and development! You will have the opportunity to develop into a fully-fledged Toyota team member. Who knows, you might even become Toyota's next supervisor or team leader.

Did you know that?

  • Toyota offers highly stable employment.
  • After approximately six months of employment, you may be offered a long-term contract.
  • Toyota grants permanent contracts to temporary agency workers twice a year.
  • More than 1,000 employees work at Toyota, making it one of the largest employers in the region.
  • Toyota encourages continuous development and promotes a culture based on teamwork and respect.
  • It is the ideal workplace for people who value innovation, people-oriented values, and a stable career.

Experience? Not necessary at all! We invest in our employees and provide comprehensive training. With the right attitude, you'll go a long way!

You are looking for a job where you can build a future. After positive performance evaluations, you may qualify for a permanent contract.

In addition:

  • You have experience operating a forklift.
  • You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:50 AM - 2:00 PM and 1:50 PM - 10:00 PM).
  • Do you enjoy rolling up your sleeves and staying physically active? Great! Then Toyota is the right place for you.
  • Safety is your top priority.
  • You can travel independently to work. While we encourage carpooling, you must also be able to commute on your own when your carpool partner is unavailable. Public transport is not an option, considering your work hours.

jobs.title: Personlig assistent till 10-årig pojke i Åkersberga - extraarbete
jobs.description:
Är du trygg, varm och engagerad och tycker om att arbeta med barn?
Vi är en familj i Åkersberga som söker personliga assistenter till vår 10-årige son. Vi söker dig som vill ha ett meningsfullt extrajobb där du får möjlighet att lära känna ett barn och bli en viktig del av hans vardag. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn eller ungdomar med autism, ADHD, intellektuell funktionsnedsättning (IF) och/eller andra funktionsnedsättningar. Du behöver däremot inte ha arbetat som personlig assistent tidigare. För oss är din personlighet, trygghet och förmåga att skapa en bra relation minst lika viktig som vilken yrkestitel du tidigare har haft.

Om arbetet
Som personlig assistent finns du med i vår sons vardag och stöttar honom utifrån hans individuella behov. Arbetet handlar mycket om att skapa trygghet, struktur och en rolig och meningsfull fritid. Du behöver därför tycka om att vara aktiv och göra saker tillsammans. Det kan exempelvis handla om lek, promenader, utflykter och andra aktiviteter. Samtidigt behöver du kunna vara lugn, tydlig och lyhörd, anpassa ditt bemötande efter dagsform och situation och behålla lugnet även när något blir utmanande. Du arbetar nära oss som familj och behöver kunna följa de rutiner och arbetssätt som finns kring vår son. För oss är ett gott samarbete, öppen kommunikation och ömsesidigt förtroende viktigt.

Vem söker vi?
Vi tror att du:
- är varm, trygg, stabil och ansvarstagande
- har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn eller ungdomar med autism, ADHD, IF och/eller andra funktionsnedsättningar
- är aktiv och fysiskt rörlig och tycker om lek, promenader, utflykter och andra aktiviteter
- är lyhörd och kan anpassa dig efter barnets behov och dagsform
- kan vara lugn och tydlig även i mer utmanande situationer
- har förståelse för lågaffektivt bemötande, struktur och tydlighet
- är initiativrik och tycker om att hitta på aktiviteter
- har lätt för att skapa en trygg relation samtidigt som du respekterar barnets integritet
- samarbetar bra med oss som föräldrar och kan följa de rutiner och instruktioner som finns.

Du behöver ha fyllt 18 år.
Du behöver inte ha arbetat som personlig assistent tidigare
Relevant erfarenhet kan komma från många olika verksamheter. Kanske arbetar eller har du arbetat som exempelvis elevassistent, resursperson, barnskötare, fritidsledare, boendestödjare eller inom LSS, anpassad skola eller annan omsorgsverksamhet. Du kanske studerar exempelvis pedagogik, psykologi, socialt arbete eller inom något annat relevant område och söker ett meningsfullt arbete vid sidan av studierna.
Det viktigaste för oss är att du har relevant erfarenhet, ett genuint intresse för att arbeta med barn och att personkemin mellan dig och vår son fungerar bra.

Arbetstider
Det här är framför allt ett extraarbete, med möjlighet till återkommande arbetspass för rätt person.
Arbetet förekommer främst:
- vardagar på eftermiddagar och kvällar
- helger
- under skollov och andra ledigheter
- vid behov när ordinarie assistenter inte är tillgängliga.
Vi uppskattar att du har en viss flexibilitet, men försöker samtidigt planera arbetspassen så långt i förväg som möjligt. För rätt person kan det finnas möjlighet till återkommande och mer regelbundna arbetspass.

Anställningsvillkor
Assistansen anordnas av familjen i egen regi och du anställs direkt av oss som arbetsgivare.
Vi är anslutna till Fremia och omfattas av kollektivavtalet för personlig assistans mellan Fremia och Kommunal.
Anställningsform bestäms utifrån arbetets omfattning och behov i enlighet med kollektivavtalet. För enstaka arbetspass vid oförutsedda extra behov kan anställning per arbetad timme bli aktuell. Vid mer återkommande arbete kan annan anställningsform enligt kollektivavtalet bli aktuell.
Lön, OB-ersättning och övriga anställningsvillkor följer kollektivavtalet.
Arbetet omfattas av tystnadsplikt.

Arbetsplats
Arbetet utgår från Åkersberga i Österåkers kommun, men som personlig assistent är arbetsplatsen där vår son befinner sig. Arbetet kan därför även innebära att du följer med på aktiviteter och utflykter.
Eftersom många arbetspass ligger på eftermiddagar, kvällar och helger är det en fördel om du bor i eller i närheten av exempelvis Åkersberga, Täby, Vallentuna, Vaxholm eller angränsande områden.
Närheten är särskilt värdefull om du ibland har möjlighet att hoppa in med relativt kort framförhållning.

Registerutdrag
Eftersom arbetet innebär personlig assistans till ett barn behöver du, innan en eventuell anställning, kunna visa upp ett giltigt registerutdrag avsett för arbete med barn med funktionsnedsättning. Utdraget innehåller uppgifter från belastnings- och misstankeregistret. Registerutdraget ska inte skickas med ansökan. Det blir aktuellt först om vi går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen och du erbjuds arbete.

Det här kan passa dig som.
- vill ha ett meningsfullt extrajobb
- tycker om att arbeta med barn
- vill kombinera arbetet med exempelvis studier eller ett annat arbete
- uppskattar ett arbete där relation, engagemang och personligt bemötande betyder mycket
- tycker om att vara aktiv och hitta på saker
- vill ha möjlighet till återkommande arbetspass
- vill bidra till en trygg, aktiv och rolig vardag för en 10-årig pojke.

Ansökan
Skicka gärna CV och några rader om dig själv till:
personligassistansrekrytering@gmail.com
Kontaktperson: Henrik Bengtsson
Berätta gärna:
- vilken erfarenhet du har av att arbeta med barn eller ungdomar
- vilken erfarenhet du har av autism, ADHD, IF och/eller andra funktionsnedsättningar
- vad du arbetar med eller studerar idag
- var du bor
- vilka dagar och tider du vanligtvis har möjlighet att arbeta
- varför du tror att just det här arbetet skulle passa dig.
Vi träffar gärna intressanta kandidater personligen och lägger stor vikt vid trygghet, engagemang och personkemin mellan dig och vår son.
Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

jobs.title: Hyllyttäjä, Pääkaupunkiseutu
jobs.description:
Haluatko saada arvokasta työkokemusta kaupan alalta? Kiinnostaako joustava työ, jossa voit itse valita työvuorosi? Tule Joblinkille oppimaan kaupan alan ammattilaiseksi!

Haemme nyt uusia asiakaspalveluhenkisiä hyllyttäjiä ja verkkokaupan keräilijöitä! Meille voit hakea huolimatta siitä, oletko työurasi alussa oleva lupaus vai kokeneempi osaaja. Sovit kaupan alan keikkatyöhön, jos sinulla on intoa työskennellä vaihtelevissa kohteissa ja tunnet, että asiakaspalvelu voisi olla sinun juttusi.

Millaisesta työstä on kyse?

Joblinkilla teet keikkatyötä vaihtelevissa kaupan alan kohteissa itse valitsemissasi työvuoroissa. Töitä teet joustavasti omien aikataulujesi mukaan. Työvuorot varaat kätevästi Joblinkin sovelluksella. Suuri osa vuoroista varataan lyhyellä varoitusajalla samalle viikolle, mutta toisinaan tiedät työvuorosi useaksi viikoksi eteenpäin.

On hyvä tietää, että keikkatyö kulkee usein asiakkaidemme sesonkien mukana – kiireisinä aikoina vuoroja on paljon, ja hiljaisempina kausina niitä on vähemmän. Samalla oma joustavuus, asenne ja aktiivisuus vaikuttavat siihen, kuinka paljon vuoroja sinulle tarjoutuu.

Hyllyttäjät vastaanottavat ja purkavat kuormia, asettavat tuotteita esille ja pitävät huolen siitä, että hyllyt pysyvät siisteinä. Hyllytyksessä edellytetään tarkkuutta, ripeää työtahtia sekä järjestelmällisyyttä. Verkkokaupan keräilijän työ on monipuolista, hektistä ja tarkkuutta vaativaa työtä. Asiakkaan tilauksia kerätään ja pakataan ripeään tahtiin, useampi tilaus päivässä. Keräilijän työ vaatii tarkkuutta, reipasta työotetta sekä monen asian hallitsemista yhtä aikaa. Tuotteiden tulee olla tuoreita, päiväyksien kunnossa ja tuotteiden tulee aina vastata asiakkaan toiveita.

Työ on fyysisesti raskasta nostojen ja painavien tuotteiden siirtelystä johtuen. Työ vaatii siis hyvää yleiskuntoa. Työ tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti aamupäivisin alkaen klo 6 tai 7, joten työ sopii etenkin aamuvirkuille. Työtä tehdään joustavasti maanantaista lauantaihin.

Sekä verkkokauppakeräilyssä että hyllytyksessä tehdään töitä reippaalla tahdilla, mutta pilke silmäkulmassa! Kaikissa kaupan töissä on pohjimmiltaan kyse siitä, että asiakkaalle jää kauppareissusta hyvä fiilis. Toivottavasti siis innostut työstä, jossa saat olla tekemisissä ihmisten kanssa!

Ennen ensimmäisiä työvuorojasi saat meiltä tarvittavat eväät työssä onnistumiseen. Sinun ei siis tarvitse pelätä, että joudut altaan syvään päätyyn ilman tarvittavaa osaamista.



Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Sinulla ei tarvitse vielä olla aikaisempaa työkokemusta, vaan reipas asenne ja halu oppia on meille tärkeintä. Aikaisempi päivittäistavarakaupan kokemus on toki hyödyksi, mutta ei missään nimessä edellytys.

Keikkatyöntekijänä viihdyt, jos tykkäät vaihtelusta ja sinulla riittää rohkeutta ottaa haltuun useita eri työkohteita. Toivomme, että sinulla on hyvät sosiaaliset taidot ja innostut uusien ihmisten kohtaamisesta.

Työssä tarvitset sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, jonka lisäksi odotamme sinulta vähintään 18 vuoden ikää.

jobs.description:
About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

 

The challenge

The Broker Channel is Wayflyer's fastest-growing route to market, and growth like that doesn't manage itself. We need someone who can scale a panel of brokers into a genuine growth engine, turning relationships and referral volume into closed deals. This isn't a maintenance role. It's a build role.

What you'll actually do

  • Grow and manage our broker panel, bringing on new brokers and training them to properly understand and sell our products

  • Build real relationships with existing brokers, the kind that make them think of you first when a deal comes up

  • Review referrals and provide sense checks and indicative offers, reading business financials well enough to spot what matters

  • Own your portfolio end to end, converting referral volume into funded deals, not just noise in the pipeline

  • Represent Wayflyer at industry events and in broker networks, building our name as much as your own

What this role could turn into

Brokers are a key focus area for the business, so whoever takes this on gets a real say in shaping it, not just executing someone else's plan. From here, that can mean leading a regional broker team as we expand into new regions, or stepping into a wider commercial partnerships role across the business.

Who thrives here

Someone who treats brokers as partners, not leads, and understands that a broker's reputation is on the line every time they refer you a deal. You're commercially sharp, comfortable with numbers, and genuinely curious about the businesses behind the applications, not just the credit markers. You don't wait for a case to be handed to you in a tidy format. You chase it down, sense-check it, and move.

We hire for range

We're looking for someone who's spent at least 2 years in business lending, ideally in fintech, and at least 2 years working directly with commercial finance brokers, with a real network to show for it. You'll have at least a year analysing business financials at a working level, and Hubspot experience is a bonus. More important than the years is the trajectory: have you built something, grown a book, or turned relationships into revenue? We'll also consider exceptional candidates from adjacent areas of business finance who don't tick every box.

Location and working policy

📍London, hybrid (3-4 days)

 

The good stuff

25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and a pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

  • Experience administering and scaling multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters and streaming platforms such as Kafka in production, including upgrades, workload isolation, reliability, security, and incident response

One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here.

jobs.title: Sairaalageneetikko Diagnostiikkakeskus Genetiikka
jobs.description:
Innostaisiko sinua työ nopeasti kehittyvällä alalla? Geneettinen analytiikka kehittyy kiihtyvällä vauhdilla ja vaikuttaa yhä useamman potilaan hoitoon. Genetiikan laboratorio tarvitsee lisää ammattilaisia vastaamaan tähän haasteeseen.

HUS Diagnostiikkakeskus on Suomen johtava kliinisten laboratorio- ja kuvantamispalvelujen tuottaja. Pääasiallinen toiminta-alueemme on HUS-yhtymän erikoissairaanhoito ja HUSiin kuuluvien hyvinvointialueiden perusterveydenhuolto. Vastaamme myös Kymenlaakson hyvinvointialueen ja Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialueen laboratorio- ja kuvantamistoiminnasta.

Toimimme kahdeksalla lääketieteen erikoisalalla. Vastaamme valtakunnallisesti useista erityisosaamista vaativista tutkimuksista sekä yliopistolliselle sairaalalle kuuluvasta tutkimuksesta ja opetuksesta. Diagnostiset tutkimukset ovat keskeisessä roolissa sairauksien varmistamisessa, poissulkemisessa, osana hoitoa sekä hoidon seurannassa ja seulonnassa. HUS Diagnostiikkakeskuksessa työskentelee noin 3400 laboratorio- ja kuvantamisalan asiantuntijaa yli 150 toimipisteessä.

HUS Diagnostiikkakeskuksen Genetiikan laboratorio on laaja-alaisesti diagnostisia genetiikan laboratoriotutkimuksia tarjoava laboratorio. Laboratorion tutkimusvalikoima kattaa laajasti sekä synnynnäisten että somaattisten muutosten tutkimuksia ja toiminta on voimakkaasti siirtymässä genomin laajuisiin tutkimuksiin.Laboratorioon haetaan sairaalageneetikkoja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Sairaalageneetikon työtehtävissä vaaditaan asiantuntijuutta laboratoriomme valikoimaan kuuluvissa geneettisissä tutkimuksissa.Asiakasyhteistyö, tuotekehitys ja uusien menetelmien käyttöön otto ovat meillä osa sairaalageneetikon työtehtäviä.

Kelpoisuutena tehtävään on asetuksen (564/94) mukainen sairaalageneetikon pätevyys sekä Valviran myöntämä oikeus käyttää sairaalageneetikon nimikesuojattua terveydenhuollon ammattinimikettä.Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää aloitteellista ja itsenäistä työotetta, hyvää organisointikykyä, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä innostusta uusien menetelmien kehittämiseen ja käyttöönottoon. Tehtävää täytettäessä eduksi katsotaan kokemus laboratorion laatujärjestelmistäsekämassiivisellarinnakkaissekvensoinnilla tehtävien laboratoriotutkimusten kehittämisestä ja validoinnista sekä potilastulosten lausumisesta.

Senior Data Analyst - CRM (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

As a Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d), you will join our global CRM team. This is an important role for CRM at Flix as we expand our capabilities, redefine our communication strategy and constantly optimize for maximum growth, as well as scalability and efficiency. We support global market growth with our marketing activities to increase repeated purchases and prevent churn. We always aim for cutting-edge technologies and a high level of innovation. By joining our team, you will be a crucial part of driving the team forward, developing our brands and customer communication throughout the globe.

About the Role

  • Own CRM analytics and reporting across 45+ markets, delivering clear visibility into performance, customer behavior, and commercial impact
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards providing real-time tracking of CRM performance, targets, and business trends
  • Deliver actionable insights on campaign performance, drivers of customer behavior, value-generating segments, and cross-market differences
  • Develop scalable, automated reporting solutions alongside deep-dive analyses and ad hoc business investigations
  • Monitor and optimize key CRM KPIs (engagement, conversion, retention, reactivation, communication effectiveness) and customer lifecycle performance
  • Partner with CRM, data, and product teams to improve segmentation, personalization, experimentation, tracking quality, and data reliability
  • Evaluate A/B tests and proactively identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities, presenting clear recommendations to senior stakeholders

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics or BI, ideally within CRM, marketing, or e-commerce environments
  • Proven track record of building dashboards and automated reporting solutions for non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong SQL expertise (CTEs, window functions, multi-table joins) in a modern cloud data warehouse, preferably Snowflake
  • Advanced Power BI skills including data modeling, DAX, and best-practice dashboard design and visualization
  • Solid understanding of marketing and CRM KPIs (conversion, engagement, attribution, customer lifetime value)
  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and marketing/CRM teams; familiarity with marketing automation tools (e.g., Braze is a plus)
  • Strong data storytelling, statistical literacy (e.g., significance testing), and a structured, detail-oriented, and autonomous working style
  • Proficiency in English

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

As a Working Student Automation, you will be a key part of our Automation Team and help improve and scale production through practical automation solutions. You will work closely with production technicians, team leads, external service providers and machine builders.   • Identify inefficiencies, recurring problems and improvement opportunities in production.

  • Analyze root causes and develop practical automation concepts.

  • Take ownership of projects from the initial idea through implementation and handover.

  • Build and integrate solutions involving software, hardware, sensors and automation.

  • Coordinate external service providers, suppliers and machine builders when required.

  • Support production technicians with troubleshooting and technical improvements.

  • Help increase process stability, product quality and production scalability.

  • You are studying Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, ideally near the end of your bachelor's degree or in a master's program.

  • You are passionate about automation and enjoy building, programming and developing solutions outside your studies.

  • Hands-on experience from private or university projects, internships or production environments is a strong advantage.

  • Knowledge in several of the following areas is welcome: PLCs, Python, robotics, sensors and actuators, electrical engineering, CAD, industrial networks, MES and production systems.

  • You think analytically, take initiative and work independently with a pragmatic hands-on mindset.

  • You are curious, eager to learn and communicate effectively with production teams and external partners.

  • You have C1 proficiency in either German or English and at least B2 in the other language.

Why Quantum-Systems:

We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working.

Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.

About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). jobs.title: Customer service agent
jobs.description:
Ben jij een echte teamspeler die graag klanten verder helpt? Spreek je vlot Nederlands en Frans en zoek je een stabiele functie met toekomstperspectief? Dan hebben wij misschien wel de ideale uitdaging voor jou!

Jouw functie: 
Als Customer Service Agent ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten. Je zorgt ervoor dat elke vraag professioneel, vriendelijk en efficiënt wordt behandeld.

Je takenpakket bestaat uit:

Beantwoorden van inkomende telefoongesprekken van klanten (ongeveer 50% van je tijd, gemiddeld 40 oproepen per dag).
Verwerken van e-mails en schriftelijke aanvragen.
Opvolgen van klantendossiers en administratieve taken.
Klanten informeren en ondersteunen bij hun vragen.
Samenwerken met collega's om een optimale dienstverlening te garanderen.
Deze functie heeft een administratieve en repetitieve component. Daarom zoeken we iemand die graag structuur heeft, nauwkeurig werkt en voldoening haalt uit het helpen van klanten.

Wie zoeken wij?
Voor ons zijn motivatie, klantgerichtheid en teamspirit belangrijker dan jaren ervaring.

Je profiel:

Zeer goede kennis van Nederlands en Frans (tweetalig NL/FR of FR/NL).
Je houdt van klantencontact en helpt mensen graag verder.
Je bent communicatief, geduldig en beschikt over gezond verstand.
Je zoekt een functie op lange termijn en bent op zoek naar stabiliteit.
Je werkt nauwkeurig en bent administratief sterk.
Je bent een echte teamplayer.

Pluspunten:
Een eerste ervaring in customer service, een callcenter of een andere klantgerichte functie.
Ervaring binnen de logistieke sector is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste.

jobs.title: (De)Monteerder

Je werkt samen met ervaren collega’s in een moderne werkplaats en draagt bij aan het eindresultaat waar wij trots op zijn: wagens die eruitzien alsof ze net uit de showroom komen.

iemand met een duidelijke motivatie om het vak (verder) te leren. Je bent een pietje precies: je levert graag werk af waarop je fier kan zijn en vindt nauwkeurigheid & netheid zeer belangrijk. Kehität verkko-omaisuuden luokittelua ja varmistat osaltasi, että verkkotietojärjestelmän tiedot muodostavat luotettavan perustan liiketoiminnan johtamiselle, investointien arvioinnille ja regulaatioraportoinnille. Keskeisiin tehtäviisi kuuluu sähköverkon rakennetietojen tuottaminen, analysointi ja raportointi sekä verkko-omaisuuden luokittelun kehittäminen ja ylläpito. Vastaat verkko-omaisuuden investointi- ja purkutietojen laadunvarmistuksesta sekä verkkotietojen oikeellisuuden, kattavuuden ja yhdenmukaisuuden seurannasta. Kehität raportointilogiikoita, tietomalleja ja automaattisia tarkistuksia sekä tunnistat tiedon laatuun liittyviä poikkeamia, selvität niiden syitä ja edistät korjaavien toimenpiteiden toteutusta. Lisäksi dokumentoit raportointiperiaatteita, määrittelyjä ja työohjeita sekä osallistut tiedonhallinnan ja raportointiprosessien jatkuvaan kehittämiseen. Roolissa yhdistyvät sähköverkkoliiketoiminnan ymmärtäminen, tiedonhallinta ja käytännön analytiikka. Pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten verkkotietoa tuotetaan, luokitellaan ja hyödynnetään koko verkko-omaisuuden elinkaaren aikana. Odotamme sinulta tehtävään soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa sekä analyyttista ja järjestelmällistä työskentelyotetta. Sinulla on kokemusta datan käsittelystä, raportoinnista tai tiedon laadunhallinnasta ja hallitset SQL:n. Lisäksi olet kiinnostunut kehittämään Python-osaamistasi. Pystyt hahmottamaan laajoja tietokokonaisuuksia ja niiden välisiä riippuvuuksia sekä tunnistamaan tietoaineistojen virheitä ja poikkeamia. Työskentelet oma-aloitteisesti, viet tunnistamiasi kehitystarpeita käytännön ratkaisuiksi ja toimit sujuvasti yhteistyössä erilaisten sidosryhmien kanssa. Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen sähköverkoista, energia-alasta tai teknisen omaisuuden hallinnasta sekä Trimble NIS -verkkotietojärjestelmän tuntemuksen. Arvostamme osaamista Azure Databricks-, Power BI-, Python- tai paikkatietoratkaisuista sekä kokemusta viranomais- tai muusta sääntelyyn perustuvasta raportoinnista. Lisäksi tehtävässä hyödyt ymmärryksestä tietomalleista, datan laadunhallinnasta ja raportoinnin automatisoinnista sekä kokemuksesta prosessien, ohjeistusten tai tiedon omistajuuksien kehittämisestä. Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen tehtävän Helsingin sähköverkon ja yhteiskunnan kriittisen infrastruktuurin kehittämisen parissa. Pääset työskentelemään laajojen ja liiketoiminnan kannalta keskeisten tietoaineistojen kanssa sekä rakentamaan toimintatapoja, joilla parannetaan sähköverkko-omaisuuden hyödynnettävyyttä pitkäjänteisesti. Meillä pääset tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitys: rakennamme yhdessä sujuvampaa arkea ja parempaa kaupunkia tuleville sukupolville. Jäikö jokin vielä mietityttämään? jobs.title: Fraud and Risk Officer Intern
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

As a Fraud and Risk Officer Intern, you will be responsible for the ongoing assessment of Fraud risks, organizing the framework for action to monitor and prevent the risk of fraud on the Back Market platform. In this role, you will work closely with the finance team to ensure fraud risks are managed effectively.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Evaluate and monitor high-risk transactions for potential fraud

  • Report on Fraud statistics and share fraud trends to improve team knowledge and detection rates- Defend Chargebacks on behalf of BackMarket.

  • Suspend accounts as appropriate or lift suspension based on appeal

  • Resolve customer fraud-related emails- Assist our customers and help to resolve their disputes in claims inquiries

  • Work closely with internal Customer Support to ensure that while fraud risks are managed effectively, there is minimal friction to our customers

  • Analyze fraud & payment data to identify vulnerabilities and take actions

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • Student in Finance (or equivalent)

  • Looking for a 6-month internship

  • English is a no-brainer (fully professional capability). If you’re extra cool and speak more languages, bonus points for you!

  • You have an investigative mind and you are highly detail-oriented

  • You have a strong sense of confidentiality and integrity

  • You are data-oriented and not afraid about using excel

  • A first experience in fraud prevention and/or e-commerce is a plus

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: 6 months (until June 2027)

  • Schedule: Full-time (35H/week)

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Contract: Internship agreement from your French school required

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Skill fit interview and live case study with a team member (45min)

  • Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (30 min)

  • Cultural fit interview with the manager (30min)

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Compensation: €1.2K – €1.4K per month

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.

At Checkout our software engineers develop the next-generation payments technologies that enable our Merchants to boost their acceptance rates, cut processing costs, fight fraud, and create cutting edge technology that enables extraordinary customer experiences.

We're looking for Software engineers who bring fresh ideas, have a curious nature and are passionate about working in an Engineering environment which focuses on building products to achieve the company's strategic goals. You’ll get to work with teams from across Checkout.com’s portfolio of products and services who all have a real customer first philosophy.

With your technical expertise you will lead project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

What are we looking for:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

  • Proficiency in C# .NET, Java, or Go, with a strong understanding of software development principles in either a backend or full stack environment.

  • Great communication skills and ability to interact effectively with a wide range of stakeholders

  • Experience working in agile environments and delivering high-quality code within tight deadlines

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team

  • Someone who is AI proficient or AI curious, you will be hungry to embrace what the latest technology has to offer to enhance yours and your teams productivity

  • Payments or financial knowledge is a plus, but not a necessity



How you’ll make an impact

  • Be part of, and collaborate with, cross-functional teams including product management, across a large engineering community.

  • Define and design loosely coupled, scalable systems in a wider microservices using industry best practices.

  • Stay up-to-date, use, and spread knowledge of the latest technologies used by Checkout.

  • Build, own and operate your systems to the highest levels of resilience and service.

  • Mentor junior team members and assist in their technical development

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

jobs.title: Bus Technician

You combine mechanical knowledge with electrical and electronic expertise, and get the opportunity to deepen your skills even further.   • You have at least a lower or higher secondary education diploma, preferably in a technical field

administracja platformą wirtualizacyjną VMware vSphere;
administracja systemami Windows Server (instalacja, konfiguracja, aktualizacje);
zarządzanie usługą domenową Active Directory; zarządzanie kontami, uprawnieniami oraz wdrażanie polityk bezpieczeństwa;

udział w procesach backupu i odtwarzania (współpraca z zespołem backupu, testy odtworzeniowe);

współpraca z zespołami developerskimi, sieciowymi, bezpieczeństwa, przy wdrożeniach i zmianach;
tworzenie i aktualizacja dokumentacji technicznej oraz procedur operacyjnych.

- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: znajomość systemu Veeam Backup & Replication (konfiguracja zadań backupu, podstawowe scenariusze odtwarzania);
podstawowa znajomość systemów Linux (praca w konsoli, administracja usługami w stopniu umożliwiającym współpracę z zespołem);
znajomość zagadnień związanych z normami i regulacjami bezpieczeństwa informacji (ISO 27001, NIS2, RODO  aspekt praktyczny w IT);
znajomość technologii firmy Fortinet (w szczególności FortiGate, FortiAnalyzer, FortiMail);
wiedza z zakresu sieci komputerowych (TCP/IP, VLAN, routing, VPN, podstawowe mechanizmy bezpieczeństwa sieciowego);
doświadczenie w pracy z systemami monitoringu (preferowany Zabbix);
doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku uczelni wyższej lub jednostek sektora publicznego.

As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda into their own systems. You'll be part of a greenfield team building a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption entirely from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, responsible not only for the streaming architecture itself, but also the analytics product and other data consumers built on top of it - with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures.   • Design and build the core streaming infrastructure that decouples process data access from the live execution engine, backed by durable, low-cost storage.

  • Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.

  • Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.

  • Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.

  • Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  •  7+ years of experience as a backend engineer, in Java, with a strong focus on distributed or data-intensive systems.

  • Hands-on experience with object storage systems (S3/GCS/Azure or similar) and building reliable, idempotent upload/commit protocols against them.

  • Experience with Kafka or a similar streaming/event-log system.

  • Solid grounding in distributed systems fundamentals, even without core execution-engine experience specifically.

  • A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one.

  • Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.

  • Experience with Apache Iceberg, Parquet, or general lakehouse/data-lake architectures.

  • Experience with embedded state stores (RocksDB or similar) for projection/checkpointing workloads.

  • Experience with stream processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink), particularly stateful processing with local state backends and checkpointing.

  • Familiarity with object-storage-native streaming architectures (e.g. systems like WarpStream) is a plus, even without direct hands-on experience.

jobs.title: Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

Having launched the Million Pound House Draw in 2020, one of the UK’s fastest ever growing products that to date has raised over £150M for charity, Omaze is preparing to build and launch our next big thing. Designed to take our playbook of dream property prizes to new audiences we are seeking a talented and hungry marketeer to help us make it all happen.

Alongside the General Manager you will shape the new proposition and the strategy to bring it to a new audience — defining that audience, positioning the brand and running the creative platform, launching the proposition, and creating a sustainable engine for both brand and commercial growth.

This is a rare opportunity to take something from zero to one and then build the operating rhythm that allows it to grow. You'll start by developing a deep understanding of the customer, defining our positioning and go-to-market strategy, and leading the launch. From there, you'll own the marketing approach for a regular cadence of new campaigns, using customer insight, brand signals and performance data to improve the proposition each time.

You won't have a large dedicated marketing team around you. Instead, you'll need to roll your sleeves up and get it all done, with support from specialists inside and outside of Omaze — including Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, Brand, PR, Analytics and Product — bringing it all together, delivering a clear strategy and executing brilliantly.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong consumer marketing instincts, brand and creative judgement, commercial thinking and hands-on execution.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

Build the go-to-market strategy

  • Develop the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a new Omaze proposition, from initial customer understanding through launch and scale.

  • Define our priority audiences, their motivations and barriers, and the occasions that will drive participation.

  • Define what this new product should stand for in customers' minds, how it should differentiate itself and how it should relate to the wider Omaze brand and product set.

  • Develop the brand positioning, messaging architecture and creative platform that can build recognition, relevance and desire over time.

  • Determine how the new proposition should relate to the broader Omaze brand and existing product portfolio - including driving incrementality

  • Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics and Research teams to shape decisions around the customer experience, offer and proposition.

  • Build a clear acquisition and retention strategy, identifying the channels, messages and customer journeys most likely to drive sustainable growth.

  • Translate strategy into measurable objectives, combining brand and commercial KPIs.

Lead every campaign

  • Own the marketing strategy and integrated campaign plan for each new property prize launch.

  • Turn each new campaign into a compelling customer story with a clear audience, insight, proposition and creative brief.

  • Ensure every individual property campaign strengthens the brand as well as delivering its immediate commercial objectives.

  • Set a high creative bar and work closely with Creative teams to develop work that is distinctive, emotionally compelling and capable of building the brand over time.

  • Lead the cross-functional marketing squad responsible for bringing campaigns to market.

  • Partner with Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, PR, Social and other teams to deliver against the strategy.

  • Ensure every customer touchpoint works together as one coherent campaign, from first impression through conversion and repeat participation.

  • Make clear prioritisation and investment recommendations based on expected commercial impact.

Build the playbook

  • Establish the processes, templates, measurement framework and operating cadence required to run campaigns repeatedly and efficiently.

  • Track and develop our understanding of brand health alongside commercial performance, using measures such as awareness, consideration and customer perceptions where appropriate.

  • Design and prioritise tests across audiences, propositions, messaging, creative, channels and customer journeys.

  • Know when to experiment and optimise, and when consistency and creative conviction are more important than reacting to short-term campaign data.

  • Build a strong understanding of what drives performance by customer segment and campaign type.

  • Turn learnings from each campaign into improvements for the next, creating a compounding growth loop rather than starting from scratch each time.

  • Bring customer insight and market intelligence back into the wider business to help shape the future product roadmap.

🤩 About You

We're less interested in a particular industry background than in finding someone who has the right attitude and has shown success at building consumer brands and growing new consumer propositions.

You'll probably have:

  • Significant experience in consumer marketing, brand, growth or integrated marketing roles.

  • Experience taking a new proposition, product or category from early-stage concept through launch and growth.

  • Strong customer and commercial instincts: you can move comfortably between qualitative customer insight, proposition development and quantitative performance data.

  • A strong understanding of how brand building and customer acquisition work together to create sustainable growth.

  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, customer segmentation and integrated brand and marketing strategies.

  • Strong experimentation instincts and experience using data to improve marketing performance over time, without becoming overly dependent on short-term performance signals..

  • The ability to lead complex cross-functional work without needing direct reporting lines.

  • Excellent briefing and communication skills, particularly with creative and channel specialists.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes where none yet exist.

  • The judgement to know when something needs deep analysis and when it simply needs to get done.

🙌 What’s In It For You

  • Generous stock options scheme

  • 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

DEI Statement

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer - Creative Studio
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for Full-Stack Engineers to develop and maintain both front-end and back-end components of our Creative & Studio products. These include the Image/Video, Flows, Agentic Creation, Audiobooks and Music/Studio features.

 Your general responsibilities will include:

  • Building and maintaining our products and platform on top of our cutting-edge voice models, which will be used by millions of users.

  • High degrees of ownership. Developing the product roadmap, and running experiments on some of our enterprise ventures across Creative Platform, Music, and GenAI.

  • Collaborating closely with others on the Engineering, Growth and Sales teams to understand, and design solutions for, our customer and internal team’s most important problems and workflows.

  • Building end-to-end API and Core Engineering workflows for enterprise customers, with potential ML involvement: generative output quality on Image/Video models

We believe in pairing engineers with work that matches their strengths and interests. This means that there is significant flexibility in staffing engineers across the company.

Specific responsibilities might include:  

  • Strong product engineering mindset, able to build 0 > 1 (API through to UI). Scoping and building brand new proof of concept products, sometimes directly with partner customers, that could later be scaled to capture entirely new markets.

  • Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break-throughs. This could involve making sweeping architecture changes, adding significant functionality, or building integrations with other common consumer/enterprise solutions.

  • Maintaining and strengthening our internal infrastructure as we scale and grow to ensure that our products remain live, performant and secure.

  • Working to collect, manage, and process massive-scale datasets to lay the groundwork for the next generation of voice models at the forefront of generative AI.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions.

We do require:

  • Expertise in Python

  • Experience with Web Development using Typescript/React

  • Familiarity with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions, data structures etc.

  • Experience designing APIs, platform reliability, and building products at scale

  • Bonus: experience deploying products directly to enterprise customers, or ML/GenAI exposure

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Resurs till Hedens skola
jobs.description:
Hos Bodens kommun blir du en del av samhällsutvecklingen och arbetar med lösningar för en hållbar framtid. Du möts av stöd, förtroende och möjlighet att växa – tillsammans med engagerade kollegor.

Vi tror på att våga prova nytt och erbjuder trygga villkor samt ett meningsfullt arbete, både i din yrkesroll och som människa.

Läs mer om vad vi erbjuder på www.boden.se/jobbaiboden

Arbetsmarknads- och utbildningsförvaltningen erbjuder pedagogisk verksamhet av hög kvalité. Kunskap, trygghet och goda lärandemiljöer för alla barn och elever är utmärkande för vår verksamhet. Verksamheternas lärmiljöer kännetecknas av tolerans, jämställdhet, mångfald och demokrati. Målet är att lägga grunden för och främja ett livslångt lärande. I Boden får barn och ungdomar framtidstro och verktyg att påverka sin egen och ortens framtid.

Bodens kommun ligger i Norrbottens kustland, 3 mil från havet. Här bor cirka 28 000 personer. Boden är en modern småstad med närhet till det mesta för ett trivsamt arbets- och fritidsliv.

Hedens skola är en grundskola med ca 230 elever från förskoleklass upp till år 6. Skolan ligger 6 km från centrala Boden vackert belägen i Heden intill en liten skog som nyttjas frekvent av skolan. På skola finns två fritidshemsavdelningar. Under många år har skolan utformat och uppgraderat arbetsmiljön för såväl elever som pedagoger. Fokus har varit att skapa rum i rummet, så att arbetsmiljön kan fungera som en extra pedagog för eleverna, vara lätt att förändra och samtidigt öka arbetsglädjen för både elever och pedagoger. Även utemiljön, den väl tilltagna skolgården är under ständig utveckling. Skolan har en väl fungerande rastverksamhet med aktiviteter för eleverna.

Vi vill ge våra elever mod och kompetens att möta framtidens möjligheter och utmaningar. Vi anser att man lär av och med varandra, i olika situationer och miljöer och att det sociala samspelet är en viktig pusselbit i lärandet. På skolan finns ett kollegialt lärande där vi tillvaratar och delar kunskaper samt erfarenheter med varandra. Vi är arbetar aktivt med att ta del av aktuell forskning och utveckling.

Välkommen till oss på Hedens skola! För visst vill Du också ha ett av världens viktigaste jobb?

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vi söker dig som vill arbeta som resurs på vår F6-skola och som trivs med variation, utmaningar och att göra skillnad varje dag. I rollen kommer du att möta elever i behov av stöd.

Om tjänsten:
Som resurs hos oss är du en viktig del av skolans dagliga verksamhet. Du behöver vara flexibel, lyhörd, ha tålamod och ha god förmåga att skapa relation med elever.

Vi erbjuder:

    • Ett varierat och meningsfullt arbete där du gör skillnad varje dag.
    • Ett engagerat och stöttande kollegium.
    • Möjlighet till utveckling och erfarenhet inom skolans alla verksamheter.

Som medarbetare hos oss förväntas du samverka med övrig personal på skolan, den samverkan är viktig för att berika elevernas lärande. Du har kompetens kring bl.a. demokratiska begrepp och förhållningssätt samt social kompetens. Genom att implementera dessa kompetenser i det dagliga arbetet bidrar du till skolans utveckling.

Tjänsten är just nu till höstterminens slut men kan ev. komma att förlängas. Sysselsättningsgraden är 75%.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som:

    • Har erfarenhet av arbete med barn och unga, gärna inom skola eller fritidshem.
    • Är trygg i dig själv och har god förmåga att skapa struktur och lugn.
    • Är flexibel, lösningsfokuserad och har lätt för att samarbeta.
    • Har god kommunikativ förmåga och kan skapa goda relationer med både elever och kollegor.

Vi söker dig som är tydlig och har en god samarbetsförmåga med en vilja att dela med dig av dina kunskaper och erfarenheter. Du har god förmåga att skapa bra relationer med kollegor, elever och vårdnadshavare. Du tar vara på elevernas intressen och vidareutvecklar dem genom både praktiskt och teoretiskt arbete under elevens hela dag.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: 3-6 månader, tillträde: 2026-09-02  Snarast eller efter överenskommelse, upphör: 2026-12-22  .

Boden är en modern småstad i hjärtat av den gröna omställningen. Här bygger vi framtidens samhälle med hållbara lösningar för boende, företagande och vardag. Kommunen spelar en viktig roll i regionens utveckling, med närhet till både stad, natur och två älvdalar. Det vi kallar närhetsliv.

Som medarbetare hos oss blir du en del av ett samhälle i tillväxt. Vi erbjuder en miljö där du kan växa i din roll, där idéer uppmuntras och där du gör skillnad, för både människorna här och för framtiden.

När du söker jobb hos oss:

    • Använd vårt e-rekryteringssystem för en trygg och rättvis process
    • Du omfattas av kollektivavtal och får tillgång till friskvårdsbidrag och friskvårdstimme
    • Kontakta den person som anges i annonsen om du har frågor
    • Vi arbetar aktivt för mångfald och en jämn köns- och åldersfördelning
    • Vi har rökfri arbetstid
    • Vår hälsoportal erbjuder aktiviteter och inspiration för ett hållbart arbetsliv
    • Följ oss på Facebook och Instagram för aktuella nyheter och inspiration
