jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Junior)
jobs.description:
Do you want to join the technological revolution? Tendium is looking for an ambitious individual in a customer-facing role, ready for the next step in their career!

About Tendium

Tendium is the global pioneer in AI-driven public tender management, transforming how companies discover, analyse, and win government contracts. Our platform turns complex processes into something simple and transparent, empowering businesses to compete fairly for billions in public sector opportunities. We’ve been building our AI-native platform since 2018, leveraging a vast data moat, agentic AI, and tens of thousands of hours of R&D. Today, we serve large numbers of customers across Europe and are rapidly scaling.

If you want to know more about our culture and what you can expect when working at Tendium you can read more about it here.

The Job

As a Customer Success Manager, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve success using our platform. You'll work closely with existing customers in the SME segment to secure renewals and identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling. This position offers a blend of relationship building and technical support, making sure our customers get the most out of our product.

You’ll be part of our sales team, collaborating with marketing, sales, and product teams. We are looking for someone who is comfortable with both hands-on customer support and proactively identifying growth opportunities.

As a Customer Success Manager at Tendium, your main focus will be to:

    

Onboard, build and maintain strong relationships with customers to understand their goals, challenges, and pain points.

    

Develop and execute a customer success plan to help customers achieve their desired outcomes and business goals.

    

Provide ongoing support and guidance to customers using our platform.

    

Monitor and analyse customer usage and provide recommendations to improve the adoption and usage of our platform.

    

Engage with customers to ensure that they renew their subscriptions for our platform.

    

Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities and work with the sales team to close deals.

    

Be the voice of the customer and provide feedback to our product and engineering teams to improve our platform.

    

Collaborate with the marketing team to create customer case studies, testimonials, and other materials that showcase the success of our customers.

    

Resolve customer issues and ensure customer satisfaction.

    

Measure and report on customer success metrics, such as retention rate, customer satisfaction score (CSAT), and net promoter score (NPS).

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone with experience in a customer success or customer-facing role within the tech or SaaS sector. To excel in this role, we believe you are entrepreneurial, proactive, and skilled at taking initiative and managing your own projects. As a key point of contact for our customers, strong communication and relationship-building abilities are essential.

Since you will be working at a leading SaaS company, it's crucial that you can quickly adapt to and stay ahead of the ongoing technical evolution of our product.

You Have:

    

Experience in a customer facing role within the SaaS/tech sector.

    

Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

    

Ability to work independently and manage multiple customer accounts simultaneously.

    

Familiarity with AI technologies and an ability to adapt to new technologies.

    

Strong organisational skills with a keen attention to detail.

    

Proficient in Swedish and in English

    

Experience can come from either a business, sales, customer-facing, operational, or procurement-related background.

Bonus (but not mandatory) if you have:

    

Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.

    

Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

    

Experience in a fast-paced start-up environment.

    

Experience and/or knowledge of public procurement processes.

    

Fluency in Norwegian or any additional European language is a plus.

Application

We look forward to your application. We recruit on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as possible. Successful candidates will initially be invited to an initial interview where you will have the opportunity to meet the team.

Please find additional information on our recruitment process here.

To make this process even more efficient, feel free to sign in to your Connect profile and add your references at any stage.

If you’re ready to make an impact and grow with us, we want to hear from you.

_______________________

Equality and inclusion statement

At Tendium, we value and celebrate diversity. We’re building a workplace where everyone feels that they belong, where your voice is heard, and your experiences are respected. Different perspectives fuel our creativity and drive innovation, and we’re always looking for people who can bring something new to the team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, we’d love to hear from you.

Let’s shape the future together.

jobs.title: Team Leader Nurse Team
jobs.description:
Lead a Team of Registered Nurses Providing Medical Assistance Worldwide

Are you an inspiring leader who wants to make a difference every day?

At Viking Travel Care, we help travellers who become ill or injured while abroad. From our offices in Torrevieja and Fuengirola, Spain, we provide travel and medical assistance services 24/7, 365 days a year to customers and travellers worldwide.

We are now looking for a Team Leader for our Medical Assistance Coordinator (Nurse) team.

Our Nurses are experienced Registered Nurses from the Nordic countries. They assess medical reports, coordinate treatment, communicate with healthcare providers around the world, handle own medical cases, and support travellers during some of life's most challenging moments. They also serve as an important medical resource for colleagues across the Travel Care operation.

As Team Leader, you will have day-to-day personnel responsibility for a team of highly skilled nurses, supporting their development and helping ensure that the Medical Assistance team works in a structured, professional, and reliable way.

You will work closely with Viking Travel Care's Medical Management and Operations Management teams, as well as fellow Team Leaders, to support the continued development of our medical assistance services. In this role, you will act as an important link between the Medical Assistance team and management, helping translate strategic priorities into daily operations, quality improvements, and employee development.

This is a unique opportunity to combine healthcare expertise with people leadership in an international and fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

    Personnel responsibility for a team of Medical Assistance Coordinators (nurses)
    

    Conduct performance reviews, development conversations, and regular follow-up meetings
    

    Drive employee engagement, professional development, and competence building within the team
    

    Support recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members
    

    Ensure delivery of agreed service levels, KPIs, and quality standards
    

    Monitor workloads, staffing, and operational priorities
    

    Support daily operations and assist with complex cases when needed
    

    Handle administrative responsibilities such as scheduling, absence follow-up, and workforce planning
    

    Promote high clinical and documentation standards
    

    Ensure compliance with SOPs, routines, and quality requirements
    

    Support the implementation of new processes, routines, and quality initiatives within the Medical Assistance team
    

    Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects across Travel Care

Qualifications Required

    Experience from healthcare, medical assistance, travel assistance, insurance, customer service, operations, or another relevant field.
    

    Fluent in one of the Nordic languages and English
    

    Strong communication and interpersonal skills
    

    Comfortable working in a dynamic and international environment
    

    Strong IT skills and ability to quickly learn new systems
    

    Clean criminal record

Preferred

    Relevant experience in people leadership, team coordination, employee development, or similar responsibilities.
    

    Registered Nurse holding a valid nursing licence recognised within the EU, with a minimum of three years of clinical nursing experience
    

    Experience from travel assistance, insurance medicine, emergency care, intensive care, ambulance services, acute care, or similar fields

What can we offer the right candidate?

    Competitive salary and employment conditions
    

    Permanent employment contract under Spanish labour law
    

    Employer-provided laptop and mobile phone
    

    Comprehensive onboarding and training programme
    

    A supportive and collaborative work environment with highly skilled colleagues
    

    Social activities and team events
    

    Modern offices in Torrevieja and Fuengirola
    

    The opportunity to work in an international organisation helping travellers worldwide

Are you the one we're looking for?

The right person for this position is a positive and approachable leader who enjoys helping others succeed. You thrive in a dynamic environment, balancing operational priorities with employee development. You are organised, solution-oriented, and focused on creating clear and reliable ways of working for your team. You enjoy working closely with others while also taking ownership and acting independently when needed.

Most importantly, you believe that great customer care starts with strong teamwork, professional judgement, and clear, friendly communication.

About Viking

Viking Assistance Group is a leading roadside and travel assistance company in the Nordics. Viking Travel Care is the group’s travel and medical assistance division, providing assistance services 24 hours a day, 365 days a year to travellers and employees abroad. Across our services, we aim to make assistance easy to access, reliable in delivery, and friendly in every interaction.

Workplace

The position will be based at Viking Travel Care in Torrevieja or Fuengirola, Spain.

Working Hours

The role follows the Team Leader rotation and includes day, evening, and occasional weekend shifts, with flexibility needed to support a 24/7 operation when required.

Start Date

As soon as possible.

Deadline

Please apply before September 30th

jobs.description:
**Tarjoilija, tuukko töihin?**

Etsimme tiimiimme kokemusta jo kerännyttä tarjoilijaa, jolla pysyy käsissä niin useampi AC lautanen, bricka, lisämyynti, baarilusikka kuin isot ryhmät!

Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian ja on viikonloppupainotteista. Tunteja tarjolla noin 50h/3vk, eli mainio lisäduuni!

Meillä pääset tekemään tarjoilijan työtä laajasti; arkisin lounasbuffet, iltaisin ja viikonloppusin A la carte ja lisäksi teemme tilaustarjoilua yhteistyökumppaneille. Meitä Pancholaisia yhdistää rennon rempseä ote työhön, hyväntuulisuus ja huumori niin työkavereiden kuin asiakkaiden kesken, ammattitaitoa ja rautaista asiakaspalvelua sekä myyntiä tietenkään unohtamatta.

Meillä tehdään töitä seuraavien arvojen mukaisesti: Lämmöllä, vahvuuksilla, huumorilla, kannattavasti! Miksi kannattaisi hakea? Nokian Pancho on saavuttanut erittäin hyvät arvosanat ja maineen. Työntekijät kertovat viihtyvänsä meillä erityisesti hyvän työyhteisön ansiosta. Nokian Pancholla pääset nuorekkaaseen, erityisen hyväntuuliseen ja yhteen hiileen puhaltavaan työyhteisöön. Työaika ja palkkaus sovitaan yhdessä. Ole rohkeasti yhteydessä. Voit soittaa tai voidaan sopia tapaaminen mikäli haluat kysyä lisää paikasta.

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Our Corporate teams support the company's performance and growth whilst putting people at the core of everything they do. As a French tech leader and global successful company, our Corporate teams are constantly looking for ways to innovate and increase organization efficiency to keep Voodoo ahead of the market. Voodoo's Corporate function is composed of three teams: HR, Legal and Finance, working together to drive Voodoo's success.

Role

We're looking for a Corporate Finance Intern to join our Corporate team. In this role, you'll support the Finance team with monthly reporting, financial analysis, and business partnering activities.

  • Participate in monthly reporting: data extraction, reconciliation, data mapping and analysis of budget variances

  • Contribute to monthly performance analysis with a data-driven approach

  • Prepare monthly dashboards for the leadership team

  • Support the team's management control activities

  • Assist with forecasting and cost control, including tracking Purchase Order requests

  • Conduct ad hoc analyses based on business needs

  • Assist in key financial planning processes such as budgeting and reforecasting

Profile

  • You're currently enrolled in a Master's degree specialized in Engineering, Finance, Business Administration or related field

  • You have strong analytical skills and attention to detail

  • You are proficient in Excel and comfortable working with data

  • You have a data-driven mindset and enjoy working with numbers

  • You have an interest in AI and its applications in finance

  • You are proactive, organized and able to manage multiple tasks

  • You have excellent communication skills in both French and English

  • Previous experience in finance, controlling or business analysis is a plus

jobs.title: Service Technician and Installation Supervisor
jobs.description: About the positionFerrum is looking for an experienced and hands-on Service Technician and Installation Supervisor who can take responsibility for the installation, start-up and servicing of individual machines and complete filling lines at our customers' sites. We supply solutions for the production and filling of beer and soft drinks, including process equipment, filling machines, conveyors and associated utility systems.You will have a key role at customer sites, combining hands-on work with the coordination of installation, connection, testing and commissioning activities. The position requires solid industry experience and extensive travel. Assignments will mainly be in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe, and you must be prepared for overnight stays, changing working hours and work carried out during production shutdowns.Your main responsibilities•  Plan and carry out the installation, mechanical assembly and run-in of new machines and complete filling lines.•  Act as Installation Supervisor and coordinate Ferrum technicians, customer personnel, subcontractors and other equipment suppliers on site.•  Ensure correct positioning, levelling and mechanical integration of machines, conveyors, piping, platforms and associated equipment.•  Carry out and verify pneumatic connections and assist with the connection of process media and utilities such as compressed air, water, CO2, nitrogen, steam, cooling and CIP.•  Participate in testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, production start-up and performance runs in close cooperation with project management, automation specialists and the customer.•  Systematically troubleshoot mechanical and pneumatic faults and carry out basic fault-finding on electrical signals, sensors, drives and PLC-related issues.•  Perform service, inspections, preventive maintenance, repairs, modifications and format changeovers on existing systems.•  Identify the root causes of downtime and quality issues and recommend spare parts, maintenance activities and technical improvements.•  Train customer operators and maintenance personnel in safe operation, cleaning, changeovers and routine maintenance.•  Document progress, working hours, deviations, outstanding items and completed work in daily site and service reports.•  Ensure that all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable safety requirements, customer site rules and relevant hygiene and food-production requirements.•  Provide practical feedback to the project, engineering and service teams to support the continuous improvement of future solutions and installations.Your professional background•  You have a relevant technical qualification, for example as an industrial mechanic, marine engineer, metal fabricator, automation technician or similar. Extensive relevant industry experience may compensate for a different educational background.•  You have several years of hands-on experience with the installation, servicing and commissioning of machinery or complete lines for the beverage, brewery, food or packaging industry.•  You have in-depth knowledge of filling lines and preferably experience with fillers, cappers, can seamers, conveyors, mixers/carbonators, pasteurisation, CIP and utility equipment.•  Experience from a manufacturer or service organisation such as Krones, KHS, Sidel, GEA or another supplier of process and filling lines would be a clear advantage.•  You are able to read and work from mechanical drawings, layouts, P&IDs, pneumatic diagrams, manuals and technical documentation.•  You have strong mechanical expertise and can perform precise alignment, installation, adjustment and systematic troubleshooting.•  Knowledge of electrical systems, instrumentation, variable frequency drives, sensors and Siemens PLC/HMI systems is an advantage, but this is not a dedicated PLC programming role.•  You can communicate professionally in written and spoken English. Danish or another European language would be an advantage.•  You hold a valid driving licence and a valid EU/EEA passport, and are able to travel and work throughout Denmark and Europe without significant restrictions.Personal qualities•  You take ownership of your assignments and maintain an overview, even when schedules are tight or several disciplines are working simultaneously.•  You are hands-on, solution-oriented and comfortable working independently away from the office.•  You communicate clearly and respectfully with customers, colleagues and subcontractors and can lead site meetings in a professional manner.•  You work in a structured manner and follow up on agreements, open items, safety, quality and documentation.•  You are flexible regarding travel, working hours and changing priorities and understand that start-ups and production-critical service assignments may require additional effort.We offer•  A permanent position with significant influence on the successful delivery of international customer projects.•  A varied working day involving new installations, commissioning, service and technical problem-solving.•  The opportunity to work with complete solutions - from process systems and utilities to the finished filling line.•  Close cooperation with project managers, engineers, automation specialists, suppliers and customers' technical organisations.•  An informal company with short decision-making paths, a high level of responsibility and a strong focus on quality and professional integrity.•  Salary and employment terms based on qualifications, together with relevant travel conditions and work equipment.Practical informationWork location: Ferrum's base in Fredericia, combined with assignments at customer sites in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe.Travel: Extensive and varying according to the project portfolio. Overnight travel and assignments lasting several weeks may occur.Employment: Permanent position.ApplicationPlease send your application and CV, including a brief description of your experience with filling lines, installation, service and commissioning. Please also state which machine types and suppliers you have previously worked with and the level of travel you are accustomed to.

jobs.title: Kokybės kontrolės ir kalibravimo inžinierius (-ė)
jobs.description:
Plečiame komandą ir ieškome atsakingo bei techniškai smalsaus specialisto, kuris prisijungtų prie mūsų laboratorijos komandos ir būtų atsakingas už komponentų kokybės kontrolę bei matavimo prietaisų kalibravimą.
Patirtis radiacinės saugos srityje nėra būtina – suteiksime visus reikalingus mokymus. Mums svarbiausia jūsų techninis mąstymas, kruopštumas ir noras mokytis.

Jūsų kasdienės atsakomybės:
• Įeitinė kontrolė (IQC): komponentų vizualinis, geometrinis ir funkcinis vertinimas pagal techninę dokumentaciją.
• Prietaisų kalibravimas: matavimo prietaisų tikrinimas, kalibravimas ir atitikties norminiams reikalavimams nustatymas.
• Dokumentacijos valdymas: kalibravimo protokolų rengimas ir kokybės įrašų priežiūra vadovaujantis ISO/IEC 17025 standarto principais.
• Neatitikčių valdymas: aptiktų komponentų ar gamybos broko fiksavimas, analizė ir konstruktyvus bendradarbiavimas su komanda ieškant sprendimų.

Mes jums siūlome:
• Aiškią investiciją į jūsų profesinį tobulėjimą: įgysite retą ir paklausią kvalifikaciją metrologijos bei radiacinės saugos srityse.
• Sertifikuotus mokymus: įmonės lėšomis apmokamus specializuotus mokymus darbui su jonizuojančiosios spinduliuotės šaltiniais ir profesionalius metrologo kursus ateityje.
• Lankstų darbo grafiką, leidžiantį geriau suderinti darbą su asmeniniu gyvenimu.
• Turėsite konkrečią profesinio augimo kryptį į metrologijos, kokybės ar produktų testavimo sritis.
• Fiziškai nesunkų (daugiausia sėdimą), tačiau intelektualiai dinamišką ir atsakingą darbą šiuolaikiškoje laboratorijoje.
• Atlyginimas: 2500-3000 € Bruto (prieš mokesčius). Konkretus atlyginimas derinamas su pasirinktu kandidatu, atsižvelgiant į jo turimas bazines technines kompetencijas.
• Profesionali, draugiška ir įvairiapusė komanda.
• Įdarbinimas ir socialinės garantijos atitinkamai su teisės aktais.
• 3 mėnesių bandomasis laikotarpis.

jobs.title: Développeur Backend PHP (Alternance 12 mois)
jobs.description:
A propos de Lemonway

Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne.

Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds.

Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés.

Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund.

Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable.

  • Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne

  • Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement)

  • Télétravail : Jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine (au choix)

Le Poste

L'équipe est composée d'une Product Manager, un Engineering Manager 2 développeurs BACK PHP et 2 développeurs FRONT (Typescript / React). Intégrée au sein de la Squad MERCHANT, dédiée aux outils et services à destination de nos marchands partenaires, nous fonctionnons en Scrum avec des sprints de deux semaines et une livraison continue.

Voici les principales informations sur l'équipe :

  • L'amélioration continue et la capacité à délivrer une qualité toujours au rendez-vous sont des enjeux très forts au sein de cette équipe.

  • Au sein de la squad MERCHANT, nous développons et maintenons des APIs Backend utilisées par nos marchands pour interagir avec la plateforme de paiement Paygreen by Lemonway.

📌 Les missions principales

Contribuer au développement de notre offre produit

  • Participer au développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur les APIs Backend PHP exposées aux marchands.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes produit et les développeurs seniors pour s'assurer que les solutions développées répondent aux besoins des marchands et aux standards de la plateforme.

Participer à la gestion du legacy

  • Analyser et comprendre le code existant pour identifier les zones nécessitant une refonte ou une optimisation.

  • Contribuer aux chantiers de réduction de la dette technique en collaboration avec l'équipe.

  • Participer à la refactorisation du code selon les bonnes pratiques, sous la supervision de développeurs expérimentés.

Contribuer à la documentation et aux process

  • Rédiger et maintenir une documentation technique claire pour les APIs développées.

  • Appliquer les guidelines de développement de l'équipe et contribuer à leur amélioration.

  • Participer à la mise en place et à l'utilisation des pipelines CI/CD pour automatiser les contrôles qualité.

Améliorer la qualité du code

  • Participer aux revues de code et progresser grâce aux retours de l'équipe.

  • Contribuer à l'écriture de tests unitaires et d'intégration pour sécuriser les livraisons.

  • Appliquer les bonnes pratiques de développement backend et monter en compétence sur les enjeux de performance et de sécurité des APIs.


Que recherchons nous ?

  • Une formation en cours (Bac+3 à Bac+5) en développement informatique ou école d'ingénieurs.

  • Des bases solides en PHP et une envie d'approfondir tes connaissances backend.

  • Une première expérience ou connaissance des APIs REST.

  • Une connaissance ou un intérêt pour les bases de données relationnelles SQL/Postgres.

  • Un esprit d'équipe fort : tu sais poser des questions, t'appuyer sur tes collègues et partager ce que tu apprends.

  • Une curiosité technique et une sensibilité à la qualité du code.

  • La capacité à lire de la documentation en anglais.

Le process de recrutement 

  1. Interview RH

  1. Interview Manager : échange avec l'Engineering Manager et un membre de la squad, pour discuter des missions et des attentes du poste.

  1. Entretien technique : exercice pratique pour évaluer tes bases en développement backend.

Vi arbejder med BMW & MINI reservedele, som bliver sendt til kunder i Danmark og resten af verden. Som lagertrainee kommer du derfor til at lære hele rejsen fra varen lander hos os, til den bliver sendt videre til kunden.

Du behøver ikke kunne alt fra dag ét. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære og tage fat.

Du får en hverdag med masser af forskellige opgaver og mulighed for at lære, hvordan et professionelt lager og en international reservedelsvirksomhed fungerer.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, og hvor du hurtigt kan få ansvar, hvis du viser, at du vil det.

jobs.title: Privacy Manager
jobs.description:
Company description:

"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."

Job description:



    What you will do  

As Privacy Manager, you will act as a trusted advisor to management and business stakeholders, translating legal and regulatory requirements into practical and sustainable business solutions. This role provides strategic direction on privacy governance, regulatory compliance, risk management, and emerging digital regulations, and encourages a culture of privacy accountability across the organization.



In this position, you will collaborate closely with colleagues in Legal & Compliance, Information Security, Digital & IT, Enterprise Security, Product and Business teams, the Volvo Group Privacy Office (GPO), as well as Data Privacy Representatives (DPRs) of Volvo Group’s different Business Areas.



Your starting point will be to, together with your Legal & Compliance colleagues at VFS and in the broad cross-functional network at the Volvo Group, take responsibility in the following areas:•    Lead and continuously improve the VFS privacy compliance framework, ensuring alignment with applicable data protection laws and regulations•    Advise senior management and key stakeholders on privacy, data protection and regulatory developments.•    Embed Privacy by Design principles across business initiatives, products, processes, and technology solutions.•    Lead privacy risk assessments, DPIAs, and mitigation activities in collaboration with Legal, Risk, Information Security, and Compliance teams.•    Oversee VFS privacy operations, including data subject rights requests, privacy incidents, data breach management, and remediation activities.•    Maintain and improve privacy governance documentation, including Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), policies, procedures, and data mapping initiatives.•    Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including the Volvo Group Privacy Office (GPO), to drive consistent and harmonized privacy practices.•    Develop and promote privacy awareness, training, and a culture of accountability across the organization.



Your future team



You will report directly to the Senior Counsel, Data Privacy & Technology of VFS. In VFS, we demonstrate a clear vision to continue Transforming Together, a global mindset and a proven track record of successfully developing people, teams, culture, and leadership.

     Who are you?  

Do you dream big? We do too, and we are excited to grow together. In this role, we believe it is the right mindset that will make a difference at VFS. If you, besides your genuine interest in working with people in Transforming Together, also have a positive, service-oriented, and collaborative mindset, and take a proactive approach with a strong commitment to integrity and accountability - then, we would welcome you to apply for this role.  



Qualifications likely required to be successful in this role include:•    Bachelor’s degree in law, business law, compliance, information management, information security, or a related field; legal qualification or an equivalent privacy/compliance background is preferred.•    Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in privacy, data protection, compliance, or a related regulatory function within a complex multinational environment.•    Demonstrated experience leading privacy governance initiatives across jurisdictions and advising senior stakeholders on regulatory compliance, governance, and risk management.•    Strong knowledge of GDPR and other global privacy frameworks, privacy governance, data lifecycle management, information security principles, and related risk and compliance requirements.•    Familiarity with the EU Data Economy Legislation as well as evolving digital regulation and the privacy implications of cloud technologies, data analytics, automation, and.•    Sound judgment and the ability to translate complex requirements into practical guidance, balance regulatory risk with business needs, and support management decision-making.•    Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across organizational levels and collaborate effectively with legal, compliance, digital, product, and information security teams.•    Strategic, analytical, and well organized, with the ability to solve problems, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively across multinational and multicultural environments.•    High standards of integrity, professionalism, and accountability.•    Experience with privacy management platforms such as OneTrust and proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools are advantageous; relevant privacy certifications, such as CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT, are also an advantage.

     Ready for the next move?  

If you want to make a real impact in your career, Volvo Financial Services is where you want to be. We look forward to meeting you.Last Application Date: September 30th 2026

jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
METAL FABRICATOR / MECHANICAL WORKSHOP TECHNICIAN Beara Iron Works – Eyeries, West Cork, Ireland We are looking for a practical, mechanically minded person to join our small fabrication and repair workshop in West Cork. This is a varied job – not just welding. Our work includes: Structural steel fabrication to EN 1090 standards Steel and stainless-steel fabrication MIG and MMA welding Marine and fishing vessel repairs Plant and machinery repairs Hydraulic repairs Boat trailer manufacture and repairs Cutting, drilling, grinding and fitting Repairing and modifying machinery and structures General mechanical and workshop repairs We are a CE-certified structural steel fabrication company, and our work ranges from structural steel projects to marine repairs and machinery maintenance. The person we're looking for You do not need to be a qualified welder. What matters most to us is that you are a practical, mechanically minded person who enjoys fixing and making things. You should ideally: Have some welding experience Be confident using hand and power tools Understand basic mechanical systems Be able to dismantle and rebuild machinery Be able to measure, cut, drill and fit steel Be able to look at a problem and work out how to repair or modify it Be comfortable working on different types of equipment Be able to work independently Take pride in doing a good job Be willing to learn new skills Experience in metal fabrication, agricultural machinery, plant machinery, marine work, mechanical repairs, engineering or similar trades would be an advantage. Practical ability and experience are more important to us than formal qualifications. Life in West Cork We are located in Eyeries on the Beara Peninsula, right beside the Atlantic coast. The area is ideal for someone who enjoys the outdoors, with excellent opportunities for sea fishing, boating, hiking and exploring the coast. If fishing is your hobby, this is a particularly good place to live – the coast is right on your doorstep. Accommodation can be arranged near the workplace. You will be working in a workshop where every day is different. Rather than doing the same job every day, you will get the opportunity to work on structural steel, boats, machinery, fabrication and mechanical repairs. If you are the type of person who enjoys welding, fixing machinery, working with tools and figuring out how things work, we'd like to hear from you. Please send us a CV or a short description of your experience and the type of work you have done.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will step into a complex technical transformation in a financial services environment, with a focus on corporate channel migration and adjacent payments capabilities. This is a role for you if you enjoy turning moving parts into a clear plan, aligning business and technology, and keeping delivery on track across multiple teams and stakeholders.

You will work close to business SMEs and technical specialists in an environment where structure, pace and communication matter. The role is especially interesting if you like owning technical delivery in large organisations and navigating both complexity and ambiguity.

Job Description

    You will lead the planning, execution and closing of a technical project or technical workstream within a larger initiative.
    You will create a viable technical project plan together with business SMEs and technical contributors such as Business Analysts, Solution Architects, Developers and Testers.
    You will coordinate technical activities across teams, drive delivery forward and provide clear progress reporting to business, programme and steering stakeholders.
    You will facilitate problem-solving sessions and escalate issues and impediments to keep momentum and reduce delivery risk.
    You will help set and maintain a high pace of delivery across disparate teams and contributors.
    You will support the team across topics related to Payment Channels, Payments Processing Platform and Payments Reporting when needed.
    You will work in a delivery setup that includes both traditional waterfall Project Management and Scaled Agile ways of working.

Requirements

    7+ years’ experience as a Project Manager in technology projects.

jobs.title: TECH LEAD IA H/F
jobs.description:
Le rôle

Équiper des équipes de LLM et de coding agents prend un après-midi. Les faire travailler en AI-Native SDLC, c'est-à-dire concevoir et livrer du logiciel avec des agents dans la boucle plutôt qu'à côté, demande de faire évoluer tout l'environnement autour : architecture, gestion du contexte, harness (la couche système qui donne à un agent ses outils, ses permissions et son contexte d'exécution), developer platforms, intégration au SI, infrastructure, sécurité, observabilité, évaluation.

Comme Tech Lead, tu aides nos clients à comprendre ces transformations, tu arbitres les décisions d'architecture qui en découlent et tu mets en place les capacités qui leur manquent. Tu conçois, tu conseilles, et tu descends dans le code quand il faut confronter une décision au réel.

Pourquoi on ouvre ce poste

Nos clients ont dépassé le stade du POC. Leur question porte maintenant sur l'intégration des agents au SI et au cycle de delivery, et sur ce qui doit être mutualisé dans une plateforme plutôt que laissé à chaque équipe. Ce sont des questions d'architecture, et on n'a personne dont c'est le métier à plein temps.


Tes missions 🎯

•    comprendre le contexte Product, business et technologique du client, son SI et son environnement de delivery

•    identifier ce que l'IA change et les capacités technologiques qui manquent pour y répondre

•    concevoir les architectures et arbitrer les choix structurants : build ou buy, plateforme ou équipe, standardisation ou autonomie, besoin immédiat ou capacité durable

•    prototyper ou implémenter certains composants quand une décision d'architecture a besoin d'être éprouvée

•    accompagner les équipes client et faire monter les équipes Thiga en compétence

•    intervenir en avant-vente comme garant technique, challenger les demandes et aider le client à transformer un problème flou en décision


Deux exemples de ce que ça donne concrètement 👀

Passer à l'échelle avec les coding agents

Le cas du début. Tu analyses l'existant, tu identifies les capacités manquantes et tu conçois l'architecture qui permet aux équipes et aux agents de travailler ensemble de façon observable et sécurisée. Le vrai sujet est souvent le knowledge : reconstruire un contexte exploitable à partir de repos, de docs et de conventions que personne n'a maintenus depuis trois ans.

Décider ce qui se mutualise

Cinq équipes expérimentent chacune avec leurs propres modèles, agents et outils. Tu aides le client à trancher ce qui remonte dans une plateforme, ce qui reste décentralisé et dans quel ordre y aller. La réponse est rarement la grande plateforme IA. C'est plus souvent trois capacités bien choisies qui débloquent tout le monde.


Avec qui tu travailles 🤝

  • Chez nos clients : CTO, responsables Engineering, architectes, Platform Engineers, développeurs, équipes sécurité et Product. Tu dois pouvoir passer d'une discussion d'architecture très technique à une décision avec un dirigeant dans la même journée.

  •  

    Chez Thiga : nos Product Builders, Product Engineers et consultants Product. Ton rôle est de construire les enablers technologiques qui leur permettent de tirer parti de l'IA sur leurs missions, et de les faire progresser.


    • Ton profil 🚀

    Une culture Tech large

    Tu es d'abord un bon technologue. Tu comprends assez bien les systèmes logiciels modernes pour raisonner sur une architecture entière : software architecture, systèmes distribués, APIs, données, cloud, infrastructure, sécurité, IAM, CI/CD, developer platforms, observabilité. On cherche quelqu'un capable de repérer ce qui est structurant, de comprendre les interactions entre les couches et d'aller en profondeur quand le problème l'exige, plutôt qu'un spécialiste de chacune de ces disciplines. Tu as assez de kilomètres au compteur, souvent une dizaine d'années, pour avoir vu des architectures évoluer, atteindre leurs limites et parfois échouer.

    Une vraie profondeur IA

    Tu comprends les systèmes construits avec des LLM et des agents, ce qu'ils permettent et où ils coincent. Context engineering, retrieval, tool use, systèmes agentiques, evals, sécurité, observabilité : tu sais raisonner sur les propriétés architecturales que ces systèmes introduisent et sur ce qu'elles impliquent pour le reste du SI.

    Du jugement, et des mains

    Tu raisonnes en trade-offs, tu prends position et tu expliques pourquoi une option est préférable dans un contexte donné, sans confondre architecture et accumulation de technologies. Et tu es resté assez hands-on pour ouvrir le code, manipuler des APIs, explorer une infra ou monter un prototype quand ça devient le moyen le plus rapide de savoir.

    Une culture Product et client

    Tu cherches à comprendre le problème, les utilisateurs, les contraintes de l'organisation et le résultat attendu avant de dessiner une solution. Tu sais challenger un client, poser plusieurs options avec leurs compromis, puis l'aider à décider.

    Apprécié

    Une expérience du conseil, des transformations Product & Engineering, des developer platforms ou des systèmes IA en production. Si tu écris, contribues à de l'open source ou parles en conférence, c'est un vrai plus.


    Pourquoi Thiga 👀

    Thiga vient du Product Management, ce qui change la manière d'aborder l'AI-Native SDLC. Cette transformation touche la technologie, le produit et la façon dont les équipes travaillent en même temps, donc on refuse de la traiter comme un simple sujet d'outillage ou de plateforme.

    Tu seras rattaché à la Tribe Tech & IA, qui réunit nos Product Builders, les consultants qui déploient l'AI-Native SDLC chez nos clients et les architectes qui en construisent les enablers. Notre ambition : mener de vraies transformations chez nos clients, construire un collectif d'experts qui partage réellement ce qu'il apprend, et faire reconnaître Thiga comme un acteur de référence sur le sujet.

    Il y a donc une vraie dimension intrapreneuriale, et la liberté qui va avec.


    Process de recrutement 🎢

    1.   Premier échange avec une Chargée de recrutement : ton parcours, ce que tu cherches, et une présentation précise de Thiga et du rôle.

    2.   Cas et soutenance : on t'envoie un cas une semaine avant. L'exercice ne consiste pas à retrouver notre architecture ou à réciter une stack, on veut voir comment tu abordes un problème complexe, comment tu explores les options, comment tu arbitres et comment tu défends une recommandation. On évalue quatre dimensions : profondeur Tech, profondeur IA, culture Product, posture de conseil.

    3.   Rencontre finale avec un.e Directeur.rice : approfondir ce qui doit l'être et valider l'envie de travailler ensemble, des deux côtés.

    Notre culture
     
    Chez Thiga, nous vivons selon des principes forts :
    Product first 
    Nous pensons produit dans sa globalité, de l'expérience utilisateur jusqu'à l'infrastructure.
    Hands-on or nothing 
    Notre approche est radicalement pratique. Nous croyons en la démonstration concrète plutôt qu'en la théorie.
    Market Maker by Design 
    Nous repoussons les limites et partageons ouvertement nos innovations.
    Knowledge Open Bar 
    Le savoir n'a de valeur que lorsqu'il est largement partagé. Nous diffusons librement nos apprentissages et nos outils.
     
    Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse

jobs.title: Program Professional
jobs.description:
Program Professional, Talent Solutions TAPFIN

Join TAPFIN, ManpowerGroup's global MSP business, and act as the key link between clients and suppliers. You will coordinate consultant recruitment, support hiring managers, drive processes through VMS, and deliver insights that create business value. A great opportunity for a structured, proactive professional who thrives in an international, relationship-driven environment.



At ManpowerGroup, we help people grow every day. It's the people we meet who shape us into who we are - a workplace with strong, business‑driven individuals with big hearts. We are now looking for a Program Professional to join our team.

About TAPFIN  
Talent Solutions TAPFIN is ManpowerGroup's brand for Managed Service Provider (MSP) solutions. We help companies manage their external workforce through strategic solutions that combine people, processes, and technology to increase control and transparency.
Our services cover the entire lifecycle of consultant and supplier management - from sourcing and quality assurance to risk management. Many of the solutions we work with are global, which means you will quickly build a network within our global organization and collaborate frequently with colleagues in other countries.

About the Role  
As a Program Professional, you act as the central point of contact between the client and suppliers. You work closely with the client's managers and are responsible for driving and coordinating consultant recruitment and related processes. The role is both operational and advisory, with a strong focus on quality, structure, and customer satisfaction.

You will work with:

    Managing and coordinating consultant recruitments through VMS systems.

    Supporting and training managers in the program regarding policies, systems, candidate review, and reporting.

    Handling daily relationships with hiring managers and suppliers, including onboarding, supplier registration, interview coordination, and negotiation.

    Preparing and presenting monthly/quarterly reports to the client and internal leadership.

    Contributing market data and insights for better business decisions.

Your Background  
We are looking for someone who is structured, communicative, and solution-oriented. You enjoy working independently and have the ability to drive projects forward. You are curious, eager to learn new things, and have a critical eye for detail - when something isn't working, you find a way to fix it.
As a person, you need to be proactive and professional. This role requires a high degree of self-leadership, and you will independently drive the projects and recruitments you are responsible for.

We believe you have:

    Post-secondary education.

    3-4 years of experience in administration, coordination, recruitment, or procurement.

    Preferably experience with MSP or outsourcing.

    Strong IT/system skills (VMS experience is a plus).

    Fluency in Swedish and English.

Your strengths:

    Problem solving and leadership.

    Communication and relationship-building.

    Ability to work in a structured way and follow processes.

We Offer

    Opportunities to grow in an international environment.

    A workplace that supports your career and personal development.

    A team that values collaboration and innovation.

    Access to over 4,500 training and development programs.

Location: Stockholm.
Work Arrangement: Hybrid
You are expected to be on-site at the client's location one day per week and at our office in Solna one to two days per week. For the remaining time, work may be performed remotely, depending on business needs.

Application  
If you have questions about the position, you are warmly welcome to contact Robenson Hoekard via email (robenson.hoekerd@manpowergroup.com). As we are reviewing applications continuously, it is important that you submit your application as soon as possible.
We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Chief Specialist, Physical activity and functional capacity
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about advancing research and innovation that improves physical activity, functional capacity, and human performance across the lifespan? LAB University of Applied Sciences is seeking an internationally recognized researcher with expertise in physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, or related fields to strengthen its Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group.

We welcome applicants with expertise in areas such as physical activity promotion, prevention of functional decline, neurofunctional health, rehabilitation, digital health solutions, and data-driven assessment and monitoring of human function and performance.

What your work will be like

In this position, you will contribute to the scientific development of LAB's Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group and strengthen its national and international profile. You will participate in high-quality research, build multidisciplinary collaborations, and support the development of impactful research, development, and innovation activities.

You will work closely with academic, healthcare, industry, and societal partners in Finland and internationally. You will be expected to actively acquire competitive research funding from Finnish, European, and international funding programmes, publish in leading peer-reviewed journals, and strengthen cooperation between LAB University of Applied Sciences and LUT University.

Key research tasks include:

- conducting and leading high-quality research in physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, or related fields.
- acquiring competitive research funding from national and international funding instruments.
- leading and contributing to multidisciplinary research, development, and innovation projects.
- publishing scientific results in internationally recognized peer-reviewed journals.
- building and maintaining strategic partnerships with industry, healthcare organizations, public-sector actors, and academic institutions.
- strengthening research collaboration between LAB University of Applied Sciences and LUT University.
- Depending on the selected candidates experience and expertise, the role may also include leadership of the Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group and responsibility for developing its strategic research agenda and scientific activities.

What we expect from you

You have a doctoral degree in a relevant field, such as health sciences, rehabilitation sciences, sport and exercise sciences, physiotherapy, public health, biomedical sciences, human movement sciences, neuroscience, health technology, digital health, or another relevant discipline. Qualifications corresponding to the Finnish title of Docent (Adjunct Professor) are considered an advantage.

To succeed in this role, you should demonstrate:

- a strong track record of internationally recognized research and scientific publications.
- demonstrated success in securing competitive research funding.
- experience in leading multidisciplinary research and development projects.
- experience in collaboration with industry, healthcare, public sector, and academic partners.
- strong communication, networking, and scientific leadership skills.
- The ability to lead and develop a multidisciplinary research team; previous research group leadership experience is considered an advantage.
- excellent English language skills (CEFR C1) and good working knowledge of Finnish (CEFR B2), or a willingness to develop Finnish language proficiency. Additional language skills are considered an asset.

What we offer

The position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the future of physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, and digital health research within a rapidly developing university research environment.

You will join an innovation-driven university of applied sciences with strong regional, national, and international networks. LAB provides access to a growing ecosystem of companies, research institutes, healthcare organizations, and public-sector partners that support collaboration and the development of new solutions. You will work in an increasingly international, highly skilled, and collaborative community that values openness, curiosity, and teamwork. You will also benefit from LAB's developing research infrastructure.

Your primary workplace can be either the Lahti or Lappeenranta campus. LAB follows a modern hybrid work model that combines flexibility with regular collaboration on campus.

The position is permanent and full-time, starting on 1 November 2026 or as agreed. A six-month probationary period applies.

Employment conditions follow the collective agreement for universities of applied sciences (Sivistysala ry). The position falls under the working-time system for experts and support staff, with a regular working time of 36.25 hours per week.

The monthly salary ranges from approximately EUR 5,200 to EUR 6,100 depending on the successful candidates qualifications, experience, and demonstrated expertise.

Interested? Please submit your application and CV through the recruitment system by 25 September 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish local time, UTC+2). We will review applications on a rolling basis. Only applications submitted through the recruitment system will be considered.

For further information about the position, please contact RDI Director Kati Peltonen (kati.peltonen@lab.fi, +358 44 708 1041). She is available for enquiries on Friday, 18 September 2026, from 13:00 to 14:00 and on Tuesday, 22 September 2026, from 09:00 to 10:00 (Finnish time).

Read more about the LAB University of Applied Sciences [here](https://www.lab.fi/en/info/about-us).

The best of both worlds: studies and work. The LAB University of Applied Sciences is a higher education institution specialising in innovation, business and industry. It operates in Lahti and Lappeenranta, Finland, and also online. We offer education in five fields: health care and social services, technology, business, hospitality, and design, fine arts and visual communication. We focus on supporting responsible, regenerative growth through intangible value creation, multipurpose materials, and human well-being. We have 10 900 students and 650 teachers and RDI experts.

Technical support for using the recruitment system: recruitment@lab.fi

jobs.title: Phd Research Fellow in Medicinal Chemistry
jobs.description:
About the position

As part of the HARPNET Doctoral Training Network we invite applications for a position as PhD Research Fellow in Medicinal Chemistry available at the Department of Pharmacy, University of Oslo. 

Starting date no later than April 1, 2027. 

The fellowship period is three years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 

Place of work is Department of Pharmacy, the Life Science Building, Blindern, Oslo

About the network
HARPNET is a Horizon Europe Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network that prepares 15 doctoral candidates to transform how chronic inflammatory diseases are understood and treated. HARPNET’s scientific programme is integrated across three scientific work packages, where data, technologies and biological models will be shared across projects through joint supervision, network activities and academic and industrial secondments. The position is allocated to work-package 3 Developing therapeutic and translational solutions within the HARPNET network.

We are looking for a highly motivated PhD candidate to join our team at the Uni-versity of Oslo for the project:

DC12 - Small-molecule promoters of inflammation resolution

Supervisor Trond Vidar Hansen: https://www.mn.uio.no/farmasi/english/people/aca/trondvh/index.html


Project description

This project aims to develop low-molecular-weight resolution promoters targeting GPR101 as potential therapies for rheumatoid arthritis. Computational experiments will guide compound design, synthesis, and biological evaluation, including the assessment of bioactivity, mechanisms of action, medicinal chemistry properties, and metabolism.

The work will be conducted in close collaboration with research groups across the network working on resolution biology and drug discovery based on resolution pharmacology. The position also include internships with both academic and industrial partners, and the doctoral candidate must participate in these activities.

Methods will include synthetic medicinal chemistry, chromatography, spectroscopic and analytical techniques (HPLC, LC-MS, and GC), as well as computational tools. An integral part of the work will be the integration of biological data with medicinal chemistry principles to identify the most promising molecular candidates.

Position location: Oslo, Norway
Application deadline: October 1st, 2026
Interviews: Online during the period October 19th – November 6th and in presence Friday 4th December 2026
Project start date: April 1st, 2027

Apply for position DC12; we recommend applying for multiple positions within the network.

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in synthetic medicinal chemistry or synthetic organic chemistry. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Documented solid experience in synthetic organic chemistry
  • Documented solid experience in chromatography, spectroscopy and analyses of low molecular organic compounds
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Desired qualifications:

  • Documented relevant experience in lipid chemistry
  • Documented relevant experience in medicinal chemistry oriented computational tools
     

University of Oslo is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

We are an international team of researchers from diverse scientific and cultural backgrounds, and we seek a candidate with these personal skills:

  • Good language and communication skills
  • Good collaboration skills

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

  • Candidates must not have been awarded a doctorate previously
  • Applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity in the country or recruiting institution for more than 12 months in the 3 years immediately prior to the date of recruitment. See https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/actions/doctoral-networks
  • Candidates must meet all eligibility criteria as outlined in the individual research projects descriptions

    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

In addition to the eligibility criteria above, candidates admitted to the PhD pro-gramme at the University of Oslo must fulfill the Grade requirements, see www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc7

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 


We can offer you

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Pharmacy has 130 employees. We have an active research and innovation environment based on independent research in pharmaceutical topics. The Department of Pharmacy is responsible for the popular master's degree program in pharmacy and has 350 competent and committed students.
Pharmaceutical related research and education forms the base of all activities at the Department of Pharmacy. The science of pharmacy lies in the interface between the natural sciences, pharmaceutical technology, health related topics and social sciences. This interdisciplinarity is reflected both in our study programmes and in our research. 
 

In the planned life science building at the University of Oslo, closer collaboration with health enterprises, local government and the business sector will enhance quality and relevance in research and education of the future labour force. The building will be the heart of the first innovation district in Norway – Oslo Science City. The Department of Pharmacy will move into the new Life Science building in 2026.

Arbejdsområdet er med udgangspunkt fra din hjemme adresse og med tilknytning til vores kontor i Silkeborg

NHC arbejder for at være den mest troværdige IT-Partner i markedet. Med udgangspunkt i de mest anerkendte teknologier, leverer og driver vi Microsoft Cloud IT-løsninger, som styrker vores kunders forretning. Vi fungerer som vores kunders IT-Afdeling. Vi Rådgiver omkring IT services, vi implementerer services og efterfølgende, drifter vi dem.

jobs.title: Myyjä (30 h/vko) K-Citymarket Tornio
jobs.description:
Olet sitten kokenut asiakkaiden hurmaaja tai hyvällä palveluasenteella varustettu tulevaisuuden osaaja - Tervetuloa tekijöiden taloon!

Haemme nyt myyjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen K-Citymarket Tornion käyttötavaraosastolle.

Tutustu tavarataloomme!

Loistamme siinä, miten palvelemme asiakkaitamme. Meillä asiakas tulee aina ensin ja asiakaspalvelumme on huipputasoa. Meille asiakkaiden palveleminen on sydämen asia.

Meidän rempseä porukka koostuu reilusta 30 huumorintajuisesta tyypistä, joilta ei työpäivän keskeltä naurua puutu eikä vastoinkäymisistäkään lannistuta.

Mottomme on; #tehemäyhessä

Miksi meille kannattaa tulla töihin?

Meillä on työporukka, jossa viihdytään oikeasti – ei vaan puheen tasolla vaan se myös näkyy arjessa ja henkilöstötutkimus osoittaa, että meillä on hyvä tehdä töitä. Yhdessä tuumin jaetaan onnistumiset ja ratkotaan haasteet. Me huolehdimme, että pääset porukkaan ja sujuvasti alkuun. Sinä tuot asenteen ja me perehdytämme. Esihenkilösi onkin aidosti arjessa läsnä. Hän sparraa, kuuntelee ja tukee kehittymistäsi. Palkitsemme myös säännöllisesti tekijöitämme ja tiimejämme.

Olet avainasemassa kaupan menestyksessä.

Käyttötavaraosastolla pääset päivittäin vaikuttamaan asiakkaiden arkeen: kohtaat heitä, autat arjen valinnoissa ja huolehdit, että asiointi sujuu mutkattomasti. Loistava asiakaspalvelu on sinulle luontevaa – kuuntelet, autat ja teet asiakkaan vierailusta ilahduttavan kokemuksen. Osallistut asiakaspalveluun, esillepanoihin, kuorman purkuun ja kampanjoiden toteutukseen. Huolehdit, että tuotteet ovat siististi esillä ja kaupassa on viihtyisää. Työ sisältää myös varastohallinnan tehtäviä, kuten kuormien vastaanottoa ja inventointia, joissa onnistut tarkkuudella ja järjestelmällisellä työotteella. Teet yhteistyötä tiimisi kanssa ja avustat kassatyössä tarvittaessa.

Nämä taidot tukevat onnistumistasi
- Sydämesi sykkii asiakaspalvelulle -haluat tarjota parhaan mahdollisen asiointikokemuksen jokaiselle asiakkaalle - Asiakasmäärämme ovat ajoittain suuria, joten arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, huolellisuutta ja reipasta työotetta - Olet valmis käärimään hihat ja oppimaan uutta. Aiempi kokemus samankaltaisista tehtävistä on plussaa - Pystyt työskentelemään kaupan aukioloaikoina ja olet vähintään 18 vuotta - Kykenet työskentelemään suomeksi
Voit näyttää meille, että olet valmis oppimaan ja tarttumaan uusiin mahdollisuuksiin. Suorita maksuton LET'S K! Duunitaidot -koulutus ja liitä suoritusmerkintä hakemukseesi. Koulutuksesta saat käytännön vinkkejä työnhakuun, oman suunnan löytämiseen ja työelämään. Koulutuksen löydät osoitteesta kesko.fi/duunitaidot.

Mitä saat meiltä?
- Mukavan ja osaavan työyhteisön, joka auttaa ja tukee arjessa - Kattavan perehdytyksen sekä oman kummi KAMU:n, joka auttaa sinua ja huolehtii, että pääset osaksi porukkaamme ja työssäsi hyvin alkuun - Monipuolisia kaupan eri tehtäviä. Meillä voit rakentaa pitkänkin uran ja tuemme sinua osaamisesi kehittämisessä - Kaupan TES:n mukaisen palkan + ilta- ja viikonloppulisät - Sinulla on mahdollisuus vuosittaiseen tulospalkkioon sekä palkitsemme säännöllisesti erilaisista hyvistä suorituksista pienemmillä palkinnoilla - Suomen Aktiivisimpana työpaikkana tarjoamme HeiaHeia-hyvinvointiapin ja erilaisia liikuntahaasteita - Tarjoamme hyvät työsuhde-edut, kuten henkilökunnan ostoedun K-ryhmän ketjuihin, ePassin, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen. Kattava työterveys pitää sinusta huolta.
Käy myös tutustumassa ammattilaistemme työskentelyyn Cittarissa: Töissä myyjänä K-Citymarketissa

Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään 23.9.2026 oheisen linkin kautta. Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana.

Lisätietoja: Aira Annala-Appel, osastopäällikkö– aira.annala-appel@citymarket.fi

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan.

KCM Tornion aukioloajat sijoittuvat ma-la klo 8-21 ja su klo 10-20.

Haluatko tutustua meihin lisää? Löydät meidät myös täältä: Instagram Facebook TikTok

Miten rekrytointi etenee?

Täytä hakemus järjestelmässämme hae tästä -painikkeen kautta Kutsumme esivalintavaiheessa hakijoita videohaastatteluun Mahdollinen haastattelu tai rekrytointipäivä tavaratalossa Olemme yhteydessä kaikkiin hakijoihin valintojen ja prosessin edetessä.

Huomioithan, että palkka määräytyy toimittamiesi työ- ja opintotodistusten perusteella. Varaudu toimittamaan ne prosessin aikana. Aloitamme hakemusten käsittelyn jo hakuaikana ja voimme täyttää paikan ennen hakuajan päättymistä. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä. Yhdenvertaisuus, syrjimättömyys ja oikeudenmukaisuus ovat keskeisiä periaatteitamme rekrytoinnissa, palkitsemisessa ja urakehityksessä.

jobs.description:

Haemme avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Nurmeksessa. Asiakasta avustetaan kevyissä kodin askareissa ja ulkoilussa.

Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!
