jobs.description:
Ramudden Rådgivning søker nå en ny kollega ved vår avdeling i Kristiansand. Hos oss jobber vi med å skape trygge arbeidsområder langs veiene i hele Norge. Nå ser vi etter deg som tar ansvar, liker å jobbe selvstendig og trives i en variert arbeidshverdag.  

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som konsulent i Rådgivning vil du jobbe med planlegging og utarbeidelse av løsninger som bidrar til sikker og effektiv gjennomføring av arbeid på og langs vei.

Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver vil være:

  • Utarbeidelse av arbeidsvarslingsplaner
  • Utarbeidelse og oppfølging av gravesøknader
  • Trafikkplanlegging

 

Hvem er du?

Har du erfaring fra lignende stilling fra før? Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det viktigste for oss er hvem du er, hvordan du jobber og at du har lyst til å lære. Vi gir grundig opplæring. 

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Trives med en variert og praktisk arbeidshverdag
  • Er opptatt av å levere god service og høy kvalitet
  • Ønsker å bidra til et viktig sikkerhetsarbeid
  • Trives med å arbeide selvstendig og ta ansvar
  • Har god arbeidskapasitet og evner å prioritere når det er mye å gjøre

 

Hva vi tilbyr

  • Solid opplæring og gode utviklingsmuligheter
  • Gode kolleger og faglig sterkt miljø
  • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

 

Klar for å bli en del av et solid og trivelig team?

Vi vil gjerne høre fra deg!
Send inn en søknad – eller ta kontakt om du har spørsmål!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in the field of Special Needs Education
jobs.description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a three to four-year full-time position as PhD Research Fellow in Special Needs Education, based at the Department of Special Needs Education, Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo.

The position is linked to the research project Co-creating Professional Development (CoDev), which aims to contribute to strengthening inclusive education in Norwegian kindergartens and/or schools. 

In this position, the candidate is expected to produce research on: 

  • Professionals’ approaches to inclusive education, including their knowledge, skills and attitudes
  • How different approaches to professional development can affect inclusive education and sustaining professional development

The project is anchored in the research group Communication and Inclusion (COIN) at the Department of Special Needs Education.  

CoDev is an interdisciplinary project with several partners. The University of Oslo has the main responsibility for the project. In addition, Østfold University College and Oslo Metropolitan University are core collaborators, along with a selection of municipalities, kindergartens, and schools.

As a PhD Research Fellow, you will write an article-based PhD thesis, and conduct both theoretical and empirical (mainly qualitative) research.


More about the position

The fellowship period is 3 years. A fourth year as a PhD Research Fellow may become relevant, and it will involve 25 percent of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This will depend on the candidate's qualifications and the needs of the institute.

The research fellow must take part in the faculty’s approved PhD program and is expected to complete the project within the set fellowship period. The main purpose of the fellowship is research 
training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree.

For more information, please see our web site. 


Qualification requirements

Applicants must satisfy the requirements for admission to the faculty´s PhD program. This normally includes:

  •  Applicants must hold a master’s degree or equivalent in education or special needs education 
  • A master’s degree (120 ECTS) with a minimum grade B (ECTS grading scale) or equivalent. The master’s degree must include a thesis of at least 30 ECTS, with a minimum grade B 
  • A bachelor’s degree with a minimum grade C (ECTS grading scale) 
  • For 5-year studies, the average grade must be C or better for the first three years, and B or better for the last two years (ECTS grading scale). The master’s thesis must have been graded with a minimum grade of B 
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English and Norwegian (or another Scandinavian language) 

In the assessment of applications, emphasis will also be placed on: 

  • Previous experience with practice-oriented research and/or relevant experience from special needs education in Norwegian kindergarten and/or schools

Personal skills 

We are looking for a motivated and engaged PhD fellow with strong potential for high-quality research. Personal suitability will be emphasized and assessed based on the following qualities:

  • Is academically curious, proactive and able to work independently 
  • Has good collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to collaborate and be a part of a cross-disciplinary academic community 
  • Is structured and goal-oriented in their work  
  • Is motivated to improve inclusive practices in Norwegian kindergartens and/or schools 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


We offer
  • Salary NOK 550 800 – NOK 594 000 per annum depending on qualifications in a position as PhD Research fellow (position code 1017). From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 
  • Attractive welfare benefits and a generous pension agreement, in addition to Oslo’s family-friendly environment with its rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities 
  • A friendly, interdisciplinary, and international research environment with dedicated colleagues at the Department of Special Needs Education 
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities 

How to apply and what to include in your application

The application must include:

  • Cover letter, including statement of motivation and research interests 
  • A project description (written in English), including progress plan (5-7 pages). Please see our guidelines 
  • CV (summarising education, positions, and academic work) 
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only). Foreign applicants must attach an explanation of their university’s grading system 
  • Documentation of English proficiency (for information on required documentation, see information on this webpage) 
  • Master’s thesis 
  • A complete list of publications and academic works 
  • List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and phone number) 

Incomplete applications will not be assessed.

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge.  

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language).

When evaluating the application, emphasis will be given to the project description and the applicant’s academic and personal prerequisites to carry out the project. Applicants will be called in for an interview.


Formal regulations

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Research Fellowships, Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The appointment may be shortened/given a more limited scope within the framework of the applicable guidelines on account of any previous employment in academic positions.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 27 400 students and 6 900 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Special Needs Education is one of the three departments at The Faculty of Educational Sciences.

The department focuses on basic and applied research and education of bachelor-, master- and doctoral level candidates within the field of special needs education in Norway. 

The department employs over 50 scientific staff in addition to about 20 administrative employees. The department has approximately 800 students distributed between bachelor- and master's degree studies in special needs education as well as PhD-studies.

jobs.title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project at The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
jobs.description:
The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applicants for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working within the field of environmental epidemiology and public health. The project aims to investigate new and previously suspected toxicants to risk of Parkinsons Disease.

The PhD project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative “Connecting the environmental exposome to PD risk and disease pathology” funded by Michael J Fox Foundation. Through this grant, a 3-year PhD position has been funded. The larger project includes four work packages (WPs), where the PhD project is part of the WP with the title “Toxicant-wide association studies for PD”, which also includes funding for two part time researchers.


Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at the National Institute of Public Health within the research group in Geographical and Register-based Epidemiology in Copenhagen. Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll will be the principal supervisor, researcher Stine Kloster and researcher Kirstine Wodschow will be co-supervisors. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the research team in the larger project. Together, the larger team provides an interdisciplinary research environment with close integration of public health, in vivo and in vitro experimental research, neurology, register-based research and environmental epidemiology. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about the research initiative here:  https://www.michaeljfox.org/grant/connecting-environmental-exposome-pd-risk-and-disease-pathology. 

 

Project description

The PhD project will focus on associations between toxicants and risk for Parkinsons Disease. The association between toxicant exposure at residential location and incidence of Parkinsons Disease will be investigated for the entire Danish adult population through access to Danish national registers. Toxicants will include pesticides in drinking water, airborne pesticides exposure from fields and larger chemical pollutions.

Together with the researchers in WP4 the PhD student will:

  • Establish the study population of the entire Danish adults 

  • Derive toxicant exposure at an individual level

  • Analyze associations between toxicant exposure and risk of Parkinsons Disease

  • Prepare and publish research findings in international peer-reviewed journals.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • The ideal candidate will have demonstrated an interest in research within epidemiology, environmental medicine, or data science

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in public health, epidemiology, data science or related fields

  • Experience with programming using statistical software (such as SAS, Stata or R) is considered a strength but not a requirement

  • Preferably prior experience with register-based and/or environmental epidemiology

  • An interest in working with quantitative analyses and large datasets

  • Excellent communications skills in English, both written and spoken

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll

The National Institute of Public Health 

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Phone: +45 65507775   E-mail: ake@sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process.

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date October 9th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Doctoral Researcher position in regeneration and ageing biology, group Pentinmikko
jobs.description:
Pentinmikko laboratory invites applications for a 3-year DOCTORAL RESEARCHER position in regeneration and ageing biology under the supervision of Dr. Nalle Pentinmikko. The successful applicant will join the research group located at the Institute of Biotechnology, HiLIFE, and enrol in one of the doctoral programs at the University of Helsinki. The work is scheduled to start in January 2027 or as soon as a suitable candidate has been found.

Position description

The Research Council of Finland funded PhD project aims to discover how inflammatory conditions and ageing affect the function and regenerative capacity of liver tissue. Your work will involve the use of research animals to investigate cell-cell interactions during regenerative processes and to developed new in vitro organoid models. You are expected to discuss your work in regular group meetings, to present your findings in scientific conferences, prepare funding applications for travel grants, as well as lead the writing of manuscripts for publication in international scientific journals. You will have shared responsibilities in management of the facilities of the research group.

Requirements

Motivated candidates with a M.Sc. degree or equivalent in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, or other related fields are encouraged to apply. Prior experience in laboratory work is required. Experience in working with research animals and organotypic cell cultures is advantageous, but most importantly you should have a strong motivation to learn new methods, contribute ideas, and possess the ability to conduct your research independently while being an active member of an international research environment. Good written and oral communication skills in English will be needed. The selected candidate must meet the eligibility requirements for doctoral studies at the University of Helsinki (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/admissions-and-education/apply-doctoral-programmes) and prepare and apply for a doctoral study right within the trial period of 6 months.

Five percent of the working time is expected to be devoted to teaching and undergraduate student supervision.

The chosen applicant is expected to reside in Finland while employed by the University of Helsinki.

Salary and benefits

The salary will be in accordance with the University salary system (for teaching and research personnel, starting level 2). In addition, the appointee will be paid a salary component based on personal performance. The starting salary will be approximately 2600 €/month.

The University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care, sports facilities, and ample opportunities for professional development and language studies. The International Staff Services office (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/about-us/careers/welcome-finland-information-arriving-staffy) assists employees from abroad with their transition to work and life in Finland.

How to apply

Applications shall be submitted through the University of Helsinki´s recruitment system and include the following documents: a CV (maximum 2 pages), a copy of your transcript records, and a letter (maximum 1 page) with a description of your research interests and why you would be a suitable candidate for the project and the contact information of two referees to provide reference letters upon request. Please send us an application that you have crafted yourself, reflecting your own capability and thoughts.


The deadline for applications is October 6, 2026. However, we encourage to apply as soon as possible as the role will be filled when a suitable candidate is found. Top candidates will be interviewed in October 2026.

A diverse and equitable study and work culture is important to the University of Helsinki. That is why we do our best to promote an inclusive university community. We encourage all qualified applicants from different gender identities, linguistic and cultural backgrounds, and minorities to apply for the position. You can read about the accessibility and inclusivity of our university via this link.

About the Institute of Biotechnology

Institute of Biotechnology BI, a part of HiLIFE, is an internationally renowned research institute with an inclusive and curiosity-driven working culture. The research activities are carried out in research groups joined into three multidisciplinary research programs. The Institute hosts several shared research infrastructures, including cutting-edge facilities for cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM), light microscopy, sequencing, and proteomics. For more information, please visit https://www.helsinki.fi/hilife/bi

Additional information

For further inquiries regarding the position, please contact Dr. Nalle Pentinmikko (nalle.e.pentinmikko@helsinki.fi).

Support with the recruitment system may be obtained from University of Helsinki HR Specialists at recruitment@helsinki.fi.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in the field of Special Needs Education
jobs.description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a three to four-year full-time position as PhD Research Fellow in Special Needs Education, based at the Department of Special Needs Education, Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo.

We invite applications for doctoral projects within the broad field of counselling in special needs education. Counselling is a central component of special needs education and contributes to promoting participation, inclusion, learning, and well-being among children, young people, and adults with special educational needs. Research in this field encompasses collaboration among individuals with special educational needs, families, educators, and professionals across educational, health, and welfare services, and addresses relational, communicative, ethical, organizational, and evidence-informed aspects of counselling practice. 

For this position, we particularly encourage applications with a quantitative empirical orientation. Relevant projects may make use of large-scale survey data, administrative or register-based data, repeated cross-sectional or longitudinal designs, evaluation studies, or combinations of these. Applicants should demonstrate methodological rigour and propose statistical methods appropriate to the research questions and data. Mixed-methods, qualitative, participatory, design-based, or intervention components are also welcome where they strengthen the overall project. Relevant data sources include Ungdata, HBSC (Health Behaviour in School-aged Children), other large-scale survey data, and administrative or register-based data. For example, Ungdata provides opportunities to investigate changes over time in adolescents' school well-being, school belonging, teacher and peer relationships, psychosocial difficulties, and future educational expectations, and how these factors relate to support needs, counselling, early identification, and preventive work in schools and local services.

Relevant doctoral projects may address, but are not limited to: 

  • Communication, interaction, and counselling processes in special needs education 
  • Counselling to support inclusive education, participation, and equitable educational 
    opportunities
  • Family – professional partnerships and parent counselling
  • School well-being, school belonging, teacher and peer relationships, mental health, and 
    educational aspirations among children and adolescents
  • The interplay between school experiences, psychosocial difficulties, social background, and 
    counselling-related support needs
  • Interdisciplinary and interagency collaboration
  • Counselling within schools, kindergartens, and the Educational and Psychological Counselling 
    Service (PPT)
  • Professional judgement, ethical decision-making, and relational competence
  • Implementation, evaluation, and improvement of counselling practices and support systems
  • Digital and technology-supported counselling and supervision

We welcome innovative and methodologically rigorous projects that advance knowledge and practice in counselling within special needs education.  

The successful applicant will become part of an active and collaborative research environment and is expected to participate in one of the Department's research groups. 


More about the position

The fellowship period is 3 years. A fourth year as a PhD Research Fellow may become relevant, and it will involve 25 percent of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This will depend on the candidate's qualifications and the needs of the institute. 

The research fellow must take part in the faculty’s approved PhD program, and is expected to complete the project within the set fellowship period. The main purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree.

For more information, please see our web site. 


Qualification requirements

Applicants must satisfy the requirements for admission to the faculty´s PhD program. This normally includes:

  • A bachelor’s degree with a minimum grade C (ECTS grading scale)

  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English and Norwegian (or another Scandinavian language)

Personal skills 

We are looking for a motivated and engaged PhD fellow with strong potential for high-quality research. Personal suitability will be emphasized and assessed based on the following qualities: 

  • Is academically curious, proactive and able to work independently 
  • Has good collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to collaborate and  be a part of a cross-disciplinary academic community 
  • Is structured, reliable and result-oriented in their work 
  • Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
  • Has the ability to give and receive constructive feedback

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


We offer
  • Salary NOK 550 800 - NOK 594  000 per annum depending on qualifications in a position as PhD Research Fellow, (position code 1017). From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • Attractive welfare benefits and a generous pension agreement, in addition to Oslo’s family-friendly environment with its rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • A friendly, interdisciplinary, and international research environment with dedicated colleagues at the Department of Special Needs Education

How to apply

jobs.title: Työnjohtaja, Kiuruveden maanteiden hoitourakka
jobs.description:
Etsimme työnjohtajaa Kiuruveden maanteiden hoitourakoihin, joissa pidämme huolen, että tiet pysyvät turvallisina ja liikenne sujuvana vuoden jokaisena päivänä. Meille infra ei ole vain rakenteita, vaan ihmisten arkea ja elämänlaatua. Tässä roolissa olet mukana varmistamassa, että kaikki pääsevät perille turvallisesti – työmatkalaiset, koululaiset ja ammattikuljettajat.

Minkälaiseen rooliin ja tiimiin olisit tulossa?

Työnjohtajana vastaat itsenäisesti työnjohtotehtävistä Kiuruveden maanteiden hoitourakassa raportoiden työmaapäällikölle. Työssäsi pääset tekemään monipuolisesti urakan tehtäviä, kuten johtamaan aliurakoitsijoita sekä huolehtimaan budjetti- ja materiaaliseurannasta. Työmaalla tapahtuvan työnjohtotehtävän vastuullisen hoitamisen lisäksi osallistut myös työmaan dokumentaation tuottamiseen. Tehtäviin sisältyy myös avustavia viranomaistehtäviä sekä talvi- ja kesäkelipäivystyksiä.

Työsuhde on luonteeltaan vakituinen, ja alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Toimipisteesi sijaitsee Kiuruvedellä.

Miten onnistut parhaiten tehtävässä?

Destialla menestyvät ihmiset, jotka arvostavat rehtiä tekemistä, turvallisuutta ja yhteistyötä. Haluamme, että jokainen voi kehittyä ja vaikuttaa omaan työhönsä. Työnjohtajana sinulla on mahdollisuus kasvaa tulevien urakoiden työmaapäälliköksi, jos sinulta löytyy halua kehittää osaamistasi ja ottaa lisää vastuuta.

Tehtävässä onnistuaksesi tarvitset

- soveltuvaa teknisen alan koulutusta, kuten rakennusmestari, rakennustekniikan insinööri

- aiempaa kokemusta hoitourakan ympärivuotisista tehtävistä ja talvipäivystyksestä sekä halua toimia työnjohtotehtävissä

- alueen paikallistuntemusta ja valmiutta liikkumiseen urakka-alueella päivittäin

- asiantuntijatestin palvelu- ja organisaatiovalmiuksista sekä kirjallisen asiantuntijatentin suoritusta EVK-keskuksen MH-urakan vaatimuksen mukaisesti

- yhteistyökykyä, erinomaisia viestintätaitoja sekä tietoteknisiä taitoja

- halukkuutta jakaa omaa ammattitaitoa ja osaamista tiimissä, työskentelemmehän yhdessä päivittäin

Lupaamme, että Destialla

Destialla pääset tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitys ihmisten arjessa. Rakennamme ja ylläpidämme infraa sen koko elinkaaren ajan yhdessä eri alojen osaajien kanssa tiimeissä, joissa jokaisen työpanos on tärkeä. Meillä voit kehittää osaamistasi ja rakentaa urapolkuasi omaan suuntaasi myös kansainvälisesti osana Colas-konsernia.

Haluamme, että Destialle on helppo hakea erilaisista taustoista käsin. Kohtelemme toisiamme yhdenvertaisesti ja arvostavasti, ja uskomme, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät, kun ihmiset saavat olla työssään omia itsejään ja tuoda esiin erilaisia näkökulmia. Kannamme vastuuta ihmisistä, ympäristöstä ja yhteiskunnasta arjen teoissa. Vastuullisuus näkyy meillä siinä, miten teemme töitä, huolehdimme toisistamme ja kehitämme infraa, joka palvelee ihmisiä pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Meille tärkeintä on, että nämä lupaukset näkyvät myös destialaisten omissa kokemuksissa joka päivä. [Lue lisää vastuullisuudesta ja tavastamme toimia nettisivuiltamme](https://destia.fi/tietoa-meista/vastuullisuus/).

Kiinnostuksesi herättyä toimi näin

Hae meille työkaveriksi työpaikkailmoituksen kohdasta "Hae tähän työpaikkaan", ja kerro vapaamuotoisesti osaamisestasi ja toiveistasi CV:n ja hakemuskirjeen muodossa. Seuraathan sähköpostiasi, sillä saat meiltä viestejä haun etenemisestä säännöllisesti. Haastattelut aloitamme usein jo hakuajalla sopivien ehdokkaiden kanssa.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä ja Destialla työskentelystä antaa mielellään työpäällikkö Markku Manninen, +358405850007, markku.manninen@destia.fi


Destia Oy

Destia on suurin infra-alan palveluita Suomessa tuottava yhtiö ja osa kansainvälistä Colas-konsernia. Luomme hyvän yhteiskunnan perustaa suunnittelemalla, rakentamalla ja ylläpitämällä huomisen liikenne- ja energiainfraa. Teemme sen noin 1 900 destialaisen ainutlaatuisella infran tajulla. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihtomme oli noin 790 miljoonaa euroa. [www.destia.fi](http://www.destia.fi/)

The successful candidate will have their workplace at Department of Special Needs Education, Faculty of Educational Sciences, at the University of Oslo.  

SpedAims is a collaboration between five Norwegian institutions and is led by the Department of Special Needs Education, University of Oslo. The PhD position is connected to work package ABC123, a work package focusing on math and reading difficulties. The main focus of the current position is on math skills and difficulties, but also the relationship between math, language and reading. An important next step in the ABC123 work package is to further develop and validate instruments for assessing math difficulties within a response to intervention framework. These tools are intended to support both research and practice by providing valid, reliable, and practically useful ways to identify children's needs and evaluate the effects of special education efforts. The candidate will play an important role in this. Also, pending on the candidate’s background and interest, it can also be relevant to focus on interventions and skill development both through collecting new data sets and using existing data.

The successful candidate will contribute to this work by developing and validating the assessment tools, collecting and analyzing data, contributing to the design of new studies.

Residence in Norway is expected during the fellowship period. PhD fellows are also encouraged to spend time abroad, for instance for research stays or conferences. 

More information about the research center can be found on the center's website.

The fellowship period is 3 years. A fourth year as a PhD Research Fellow may become relevant, and it will involve 25 percent of other career-promoting work. The research fellow must take part in the faculty’s approved PhD program and is expected to complete the project within the set fellowship period. The main purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree.

jobs.title: Senior Data Center IT Support Technician
jobs.description:
Overview

As a Senior Data Center IT Support Technician, you will provide technical support for Secure Access Workstations (SAWs), laptops, servers, and audio/visual equipment used across Microsoft datacentres. You will help ensure devices remain secure, compliant, and fully operational while maintaining inventory, managing device lifecycles, and supporting users across multiple sites.

In this role, you will work closely with datacentre teams and corporate stakeholders to resolve IT issues, onboard new employees, manage hardware deployments and replacements, and support critical infrastructure. You will also contribute to datacentre operations by assisting with server, network, and hardware troubleshooting when needed.

Travel between sites may be required, therefore a valid driver's licence is essential.

Microsoft's Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) organisation powers services including Azure, Office 365, Bing, Xbox, and OneDrive. CO+I employees benefit from ongoing training, professional certifications, career development programmes, and opportunities to grow within one of the world's largest cloud infrastructure organisations.

Microsoft operates more than 200 datacentres across 32 countries, supporting over 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses worldwide. Sustainability, innovation, and operational excellence are central to our continued success.

Our mission is to empower every person and organisation on the planet to achieve more. Guided by our values of respect, integrity, and accountability, we foster an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

Responsibilities

    Build strong working relationships with datacentre personnel, corporate teams, and business stakeholders.
    Provide day-to-day IT support for Secure Access Workstations (SAWs), laptops, servers, mobile devices, and conference room audio/visual systems.
    Support new employee onboarding by provisioning, configuring, and troubleshooting laptops, phones, and related equipment.
    Manage device repairs, replacements, warranty claims, and Return Merchandise Authorisation (RMA) processes while ensuring compliance with Microsoft security standards.
    Maintain inventory of IT equipment, including ordering, receiving, assigning, redeploying, and decommissioning assets.
    Perform hardware troubleshooting, component replacement, media handling, and power-cycle activities when required.
    Assist with server deployments, rack-and-stack activities, cabling, hardware installations, testing, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
    Support Windows Server environments, network devices, storage systems, and other datacentre technologies.
    Assist Inventory and Asset Management teams with shipping, receiving, and inventory activities during periods of high demand.
    Share knowledge and provide technical guidance to colleagues across the datacentre environment.
    Maintain compliance with Microsoft security, safety, and operational standards.
    Embody Microsoft's culture and values in all aspects of work.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

    High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent.
    Experience supporting IT equipment, technical infrastructure, or related technology environments.
    Valid driver's licence and willingness to travel between sites as required.

Security Requirements

Candidates must be able to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements, including:

    Successful completion of the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

    Technical college degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Mathematics, Information Technology, or a related field.
    Relevant industry certifications, such as Microsoft, CompTIA, networking, or infrastructure certifications.
    Experience supporting servers, operating systems, networking technologies, and enterprise hardware.
    Valid licence to operate standard street-legal vehicles within the local jurisdiction.

jobs.title: Recruitment Researcher
jobs.description:
Role Description

As a Recruitment Researcher, you will work closely with hiring managers, clients and other stakeholders to understand recruitment needs and support successful recruitment processes across Sweden and international markets. The role combines recruitment research, proactive talent sourcing, market mapping and pipeline development with candidate assessment, stakeholder management and recruitment coordination.

You will independently develop sourcing strategies, identify and engage relevant talent, and provide market insights to support recruitment across different functions and levels of seniority, including specialist, senior specialist and leadership positions.

Key Responsibilities

    Partner with hiring managers and clients to understand recruitment requirements, business needs, competencies and candidate profiles.
    Independently develop and execute search and sourcing strategies for recruitment assignments.
    Proactively identify and engage candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, professional networks, recruitment databases and other sourcing channels.
    Conduct talent research and market mapping across Sweden, EMEA and other international markets to identify relevant talent, skills availability and sourcing opportunities.
    Build and maintain talent pipelines and candidate networks for current and future recruitment needs.
    Support recruitment across specialist, senior specialist and leadership-level positions in different functions and industries.
    Screen candidates and conduct initial interviews to assess experience, competencies, motivation and suitability.
    Prepare candidate profiles and shortlists and present suitable candidates to hiring managers and clients.
    Coordinate interviews and maintain professional communication with candidates and stakeholders throughout the recruitment process.
    Provide hiring managers and clients with talent-market insights, including candidate availability, sourcing possibilities, market conditions and relevant salary-market information.
    Apply inclusive sourcing practices and contribute to building diverse candidate pools across different markets.
    Contribute to recruitment process improvement, employer branding, sourcing methodologies, recruitment tools and reporting.

Myyjänä käytät työssäsi sekä kassajärjestelmää että mobiililaitteita, ja hyödynnät myymälän taustajärjestelmiä arjen sujuvoittamiseksi. Meillä sinua odottaa osaava ja toisiaan tukeva työyhteisö, jossa hyvä tiimihenki näkyy arjen tekemisessä. Meillä autetaan työkaveria, jaetaan osaamista sekä iloitaan yhdessä onnistumisista. Toivommekin sinulta positiivista energisyyttä, yhteistyökykyä ja halua onnistua joka päivä piirun verran paremmin. jobs.title: Shipping Coordinator
jobs.description:
An exciting opportunity awaits you as a Shipping Coordinator. In this role, you will be an important part of our dynamic Supply Chain team, ensuring that shipments are delivered efficiently and on time to customers around the world! This is a fixed-term position continuing until May 2028. Please note that the duration of the assignment and the end date may be subject to change depending on project requirements and business needs.

What you will be doing

As a Shipping Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating and administering export and import activities in compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and customer requirements. Ensures that all required documentation is accurate and complete, and that shipments are executed in accordance with customs regulations, trade compliance requirements, and agreed commercial terms. The role also provides support to the organization on matters related to customs, international trade, and Incoterms.

Key responsibilities:

    Plan and book transportation with freight forwarders and transport providers.
    Select transportation solutions based on cost, lead time, and customer requirements.
    Ensure deliveries are executed in accordance with agreed delivery schedules.
    Manage express shipments and priority customer orders.
    Coordinate direct deliveries from suppliers.
    Handle customer returns.

We think you should have

We are looking for a candidate with experience in international logistics, transportation, or shipping operations and a solid understanding of customs regulations, export/import procedures, and international trade terms, including Incoterms. To succeed in this role, you should have strong administrative and organizational skills, preferably gained in a fast-paced environment with experience working in ERP systems.

You are an effective communicator with excellent written and verbal skills in both Swedish and English and have a proven ability to build strong relationships and collaborate with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders. A structured, service-minded, and proactive approach will help you thrive in this dynamic and customer-focused role.

Since we are a company working with customers in the Naval segment, questions related to citizenship will be part of the selection process. Security clearance is required for this position, therefore Swedish citizenship, or alternatively currently living in Sweden with residency for a minimum of 5 years, is a demand.

At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!

Why join us

    We offer flexible working hours and the option to work remote or from home office.
    Work on exciting projects that are shaping the future of the maritime industry.
    Be part of a diverse team spread across several countries, embracing collaboration and cultural diversity.

Developing technologies for sustainable oceans guides us, and diverse backgrounds ignite problem‑solving

Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology. We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than 30,000 vessels operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than 8,300 employees in 35 countries.

Our Propulsion and Handling division delivers world class products for propulsion, handling systems and waterjet for all marine industry sectors including merchant, offshore and naval. Our products enhance operational efficiency and deliver safe, secure, reliable and sustainable products to our valued customers.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Application Platform
jobs.description:
Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.

We are continuing to strengthen our platform engineering capabilities and are now looking for a Senior Platform Engineer who wants to play a key role in developing and modernising our Application Platform.

This is an opportunity to work hands-on with modern platform technologies and help build the foundations that enable application teams to deliver software efficiently, securely, and at scale. The platform is built on Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies, making Kubernetes expertise a key requirement for the role.

Your role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will be part of the team responsible for our Application Platform. The platform provides the capabilities, tooling, and services that enable development teams across the organisation to build, deploy, and operate applications efficiently and securely. Kubernetes is a core technology within the platform, and you will work extensively with the design, development, operation, and evolution of Kubernetes-based platform capabilities.

You will work with both existing and future platform services, focusing on automation, reliability, scalability, security, and developer experience. The role combines software-oriented infrastructure engineering with platform development and offers significant opportunities to influence the technical direction of our platform ecosystem.

Working closely with architects, developers, security specialists, and other engineering teams, you will help build and improve platform services that are secure, scalable, and easy to consume through self-service capabilities and well-defined interfaces.

Key responsibilities

    Design, build, and evolve the organisation's Application Platform
    Develop and maintain Kubernetes-based platform capabilities
    Create self-service solutions and reusable platform services for development teams
    Drive automation initiatives and Infrastructure as Code practices
    Improve platform reliability, scalability, observability, and security
    Build and maintain tooling, integrations, and platform capabilities that enhance developer experience
    Contribute to the design and implementation of future platform services and architectures
    Support application teams adopting and consuming platform capabilities
    Participate in platform modernisation and migration initiatives
    Collaborate with architects and stakeholders to align platform capabilities with technical and business needs
    Contribute to the platform roadmap and continuous improvement activities

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is passionate about platform engineering and enjoys building capabilities that enable other teams to be successful. You have a strong technical foundation, an automation-first mindset, and an interest in creating scalable and reusable solutions.

Required

    Several years of experience as a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, or similar
    Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container platforms
    Experience designing, building, and operating platform services
    Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools
    Experience working in Linux-based environments
    Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
    Experience operating and improving business-critical platforms or services
    Knowledge of cloud-native technologies and platform engineering principles
    Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English
    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

Preferred

    Experience building or working with Internal Developer Platforms (IDP)
    Experience working in hybrid Kubernetes environments
    Experience with observability, monitoring, and platform security
    Experience driving platform modernisation or migration initiatives
    Experience from large or complex organisations

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

jobs.title: People & Culture Generalist
jobs.description:
At IKEA Tampere, people are at the heart of everything we do. As our Unit P&C Generalist, you will be a trusted HR partner who helps leaders and co-workers thrive, supports a healthy and inclusive workplace, and turns People & Culture plans into practical everyday actions. You will work close to the business, because the best people solutions are built together, where everyday life happens.

**Who you are**

You are an experienced, people-centred HR professional who combines sound judgement with a warm, practical way of working. You enjoy being a reliable partner to leaders and co-workers, take ownership of your work, and bring people together to find solutions that support both wellbeing and business results. You can move confidently between employment relations, work ability management and everyday HR processes, while helping change happen in a clear and respectful way.

- You have several years of broad HR experience and can provide practical, trusted support to leaders, co-workers and the business.

- You have expertise in work ability management and a relevant educational background in education, psychology or a related field, supported by hands-on experience.

- You understand collective agreements and employment relations, ideally the Finnish Commerce Collective Agreement or another collective agreement you have applied in your work.

- You know how to work closely with occupational health partners and use wellbeing insights to support sustainable everyday working life.

- You build trust through approachable, clear and confidential communication, and you can document and explain HR matters accurately to different audiences.

- You take responsibility for moving agreed actions forward, stay calm when priorities change and work independently while actively asking for and offering support.

- You have ability to embrace different IT solutions and use them in your daily tasks.

- You are fluent in both Finnish and English and enjoy bringing people together across the Tampere unit to make change practical, inclusive and meaningful.


**What you'll be doing day to day**

As a Unit P&C Generalist, you will make a real difference to everyday working life at IKEA Tampere. You will partner with leaders and co-workers to make our People & Culture plans happen in practice, strengthening wellbeing, capability and a workplace where everyone can contribute. Your work brings together hands-on HR support, employment relations and organisational development. You will listen, give clear advice and turn insights into simple actions that help the unit grow through people.

- You will partner with unit leaders to plan, deliver and follow up local People & Culture actions that support business priorities and a positive co-worker experience.

- You will provide practical HR advice and coaching to leaders and co-workers on employment relations, policies, procedures and everyday people matters.

- You will coordinate work ability management and occupational health collaboration, helping to find timely, respectful and sustainable solutions for co-workers.

- You will support leaders in developing their leadership capabilities and help co-workers build the skills needed today and tomorrow also executing trainings and on-boarding process for co-workers and managers

- You will contribute to fair and constructive cooperation with employee representatives and ensure that local practices follow applicable collective agreements, legislation and IKEA ways of working.

- You will execute operational people related tasks and daily routines on unit level, e.g. on- and offboarding related tasks.

- You will use people data, feedback and everyday observations to identify opportunities, improve HR processes and make clear recommendations that lead to action.

- You will help strengthen IKEA Tampere as an attractive employer by supporting talent, inclusion, internal growth and a culture where people trust, support and challenge one another.


**Together as a team**

IKEA is all about people, and our team make sure to bring the best people on board to keep our strong spirit of togetherness. We believe that different experiences and backgrounds collectively make us wiser and stronger, and we ensure that our co-workers bloom into their best selves as they contribute to our business.

**Apply now!**

This position is full time 37,5 h/week and fixed term until 17.9.2027. Starting in the role by agreement, but no later than 2.11.2026.

In this role your working hours may vary from 08.00 - 18.00 based on business needs. Main working location is IKEA Tampere store.

The salary for the position starts at 3099 €/month and will be specified during the recruitment process based on the selected candidates experience, skills, and the final content of the role.

You can apply by clicking the Apply now button and attach an updated CV with your application and salary request latest on 24.9.2026, so we can get to know you better.

We are interviewing the applicants during the weeks 39 and 40. We will communicate about the progress of the recruitment process via email, so keep on eye your inbox.

If you have any questions about the role, Tampere Unit People & Culture Manager Petra Aalto will be happy to answer them. You can reach her at petra.aalto@ingka.ikea.com in either English or Finnish.

Need adjustments? If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruitment.ikea.fi@ikea.com. Were happy to help.

**IKEA AS EMPLOYER**

Working at IKEA is more than just a job – with us you are part of an equal and diverse working community. A sense of belonging is important to our employees, and team spirit is at the heart of what we do. IKEA offers a variety of career paths and opportunities to develop yourself in roles that are right for you. We give you the opportunity to bring your ideas to the table to help us develop our work, and to create new IKEA success!

In addition to your salary, you will also enjoy a wide range of comprehensive staff benefits, including flexible Epassi saldo, staff discounts on our products, healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch menus at very low prices in our staff restaurants, One IKEA Bonus, gifts on special days and at Christmas, and much more!

jobs.title: Merimajan päiväkoti Kotkassa hakee 2-3 varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa!
jobs.description:
Merimajan päiväkoti etsii joukkoonsa toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen kokeneita ja motivoituneita varhaiskasvatuksen opettajia, jotka haluavat olla mukana rakentamassa lasten turvallista, lämminhenkistä ja merkityksellistä arkea.

Meillä Merimajassa arvostetaan rauhallista, sensitiivistä työotetta ja yhteisöllistä tekemisen kulttuuria. Toimintaamme ohjaavat kristilliset arvot, kuten lähimmäisenrakkaus, oikeudenmukaisuus ja kunnioitus.

Työ, jossa jokainen päivä on merkityksellinen

Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana olet tärkeä osa lasten kasvun ja oppimisen polkua. Toimit kasvattajana, ohjaajana ja tiimin pedagogisena suunnannäyttäjänä. Meillä saat toteuttaa laadukasta, leikkiin ja oppimisen iloon pohjautuvaa pedagogiikkaa yhdessä osaavan ja välittävän työyhteisön kanssa.

Etsimme sinua, joka

- omaat varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuuden (Varhaiskasvatuslaki 6 luku §26, varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018) mukainen kelpoisuus, huomioiden 74 § ja 75 § voimaantulon ja siirtymäsäännökset)


- työskentelet lapsilähtöisesti, sensitiivisesti ja ammatillisesti


- arvostat tiimityöskentelyä, yhteisöllisyyttä, avointa vuorovaikutusta ja kehittämistä


- osaat kohdata lapset, huoltajat ja työtoverit lämpimästi ja kunnioittavasti


- haluat olla mukana luomassa hyvän arjen kokopäiväpedagogiikkaa, jossa jokainen tuleenähdyksi ja kuulluksi.


Tarjoamme sinulle

- sitoutuneen ja välittävän työyhteisön, jossa huumori, arvostus ja yhdessä tekeminen näkyvät arjessa


- mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kasvuun ja kouluttautumiseen


- hyvinvointia tukevan ilmapiirin, jossa työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa arvostetaan


- riittävät resurssit ja varhaiskasvatuslain mukaiset ryhmäkoot


- työterveyshuollon Mehiläisessä, vaaterahan, tyhypäivät 2x/vuosi ja ePassi-edun


Tule osaksi Merimajan yhteisöä!

Jos sydämesi sykkii lasten kasvulle, varhaiskasvatuksen laadulle ja arvopohjaiselle työlle, saatat olla juuri se, jota etsimme.

Työsuhteessa noudatetaan 6kk koeaikaa. Valitun henkilön on esitettävä lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote sekä hyväksyttävä todistus terveydentilastaan. Tartuntatautilaki (55 §) velvoittaa alle kouluikäisten kanssa työskentelevien tuberkuloositartuntariskin selvittämisen.

Palkkaus 25E (3026,78- 3301,03e) riippuen kokemusvuosistasi.

jobs.title: Ympäristöasiantuntija, Keliber-litiumhanke
jobs.description:
Sibanye-Stillwaterin Keliber-litiumhanke on aloittanut Euroopan ensimmäisen omaan malmiin perustuvan akkulaatuisen litiumhydroksidin tuotannon vaiheittaisen käynnistämisen. Toiminta kattaa koko arvoketjun malminetsinnästä litiumhydroksidin jalostukseen ja vahvistaa Euroopan akkuarvoketjua. Rikastamo sijaitsee Kaustisen Päivänevalla ja litiumjalostamo Kokkolan suurteollisuusalueella (KIP).
Litiumhydroksidi on keskeinen raaka-aine litiumioniakuissa, jotka mahdollistavat sähköautot, energian varastoinnin ja monet digitaalisen arjen ratkaisut.
Keliber on kansainvälisen kaivos- ja metallinjalostusyhtiön Sibanye-Stillwaterin tytäryhtiö, ja sen toiseksi suurin omistaja on kotimaista akkuarvoketjua kehittävä Finnish Minerals Group.
Haluatko tarttua ainutlaatuiseen tilaisuuteen ja tulla luomaan uuden sukupolven suomalaista teollisuutta? Etsimme dynaamiseen ympäristöasiantuntijoiden joukkoomme

YMPÄRISTÖASIANTUNTIJAA

vastaamaan toimintamme ympäristötarkkailun toteuttamisesta ja kehittämisestä yhdessä tärkeimpien sisäisten ja ulkoisten sidosryhmiemme kanssa. Työnkuvaasi kuuluu tarkkailuohjelman mukainen näytteenotto (vesi, maa-ainekset ja kaivannaisjätteet), jätehuollon ohjeistus ja koordinointi tuotanto-osastoille sekä toiminnanharjoittajan laboratoriopalveluntarjoajan rajapinnalla toimiminen.
Toimit myös asiantuntijana ympäristöasioissa ja varmistat ympäristövelvoitteidemme huomioon ottamisen nyt hankkeen ylösajovaiheessa ja tuotannon käynnistyttyä. Raportoit työssäsi ympäristöpäällikölle.
Tärkeimmät vastuusi ovat:
-
toiminnan ympäristölupamääräysten ja velvoitteiden toteutumisen seuranta ja raportointi

-
vesien, kaivannaisjätteiden ja jätteiden hallinnan koordinointi

-
sidosryhmäyhteistyö (mm. ympäristökonsultit, viranomaiset)

-
tuotanto-osastojen ohjeistus ja opastus

-
viranomaismenettelyjen (YVA:t, lupamenettelyt, yms.) toteuttamisessa avustaminen.

Odotamme sinulta:
-
tehtävään soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa (esim. AMK Ins., DI, FM)

-
vähintään 3 vuoden kokemusta teollisuuden ympäristötehtävistä tai teollisuuteen liittyvistä hankkeista, kokemus kaivosteollisuudesta sekä pätevyys vesinäytteiden ja kiinteiden näytteiden otossa luetaan eduksi

-
kokemusta teollisuuslaitoksen ympäristötarkkailun toteuttamisesta ja kehittämisestä sekä raportoinnista

-
kokemusta teollisen toiminnan ympäristövaikutusten arvioinnista sekä vesien ja jätteiden hallinnasta

-
kykyä ajatella kriittisesti, kehittymishalua ja yhteistyökykyä

-
hyvää raportointikykyä sekä sujuvaa englannin ja suomen kielen taitoa.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa ympäristöpäällikkö Jaakko Saukkoriipi, puh. 050 439 0122 jaakko.saukkoriipi@sibanyestillwater.com tai henkilöstöjohtaja Asko Saastamoinen, puh. 040 614 7477 asko.saastamoinen@sibanyestillwater.com
Hae tehtävään 27.9.2026 mennessä.

Sibanye-Stillwaters Keliber lithium project has begun the phased ramp-up of Europes first battery-grade lithium hydroxide production based on its own ore. The operation covers the entire value chain from ore exploration to lithium hydroxide processing and strengthens Europes battery value chain. The concentrator is located in Päiväneva, Kaustinen, and the lithium refinery is in the Kokkola industrial park.
Lithium hydroxide is a key raw material in lithium-ion batteries, which power electric vehicles, energy storage, and many everyday digital solutions.
Keliber is a subsidiary of Sibanye-Stillwater, a multinational mining and metals processing Group, with Finnish Minerals Group as the second largest shareholder, a state-owned company developing the value chain of lithium-ion batteries.
Would you like to take on this unique chance and create new generations industry in Finland?

ENVIRONMENTAL SPECIALIST

Your responsibilities will include sampling in accordance with the monitoring program (water, soil, and mining waste), providing guidance and coordination on waste management to production departments, and liaising with the operators laboratory service provider.

Environmental permit regulations compliance monitoring and reporting

-
Coordinating the water management, mining waste and other waste management

-
Collaboration with stakeholders (e.g., environmental consultants, authorities)

-
Providing guidance and instruction to production departments

-
Assisting in the implementation of regulatory procedures (EIA, permitting processes etc.)


In order to succeed, we expect You to:
-

-
Have at least 3 years of experience in industrial environmental roles or industry-related projects; experience in the mining industry and proficiency in collecting water and solid samples are considered a benefit

-
Have experience in implementing, developing and reporting environmental monitoring at industrial facilities

-
Have experience in assessing environmental impacts of industrial operations, as well as in water and waste management

-
Be able to think critically, have cooperation skills and willingness to develop yourself

-
Have strong reporting skills and fluency in English and Finnish


For further information please contact Environmental Manager Jaakko Saukkoriipi, tel. +358 (0)50 439 0122, jaakko.saukkoriipi@sibanyestillwater.com or Chief HR Officer Asko Saastamoinen, tel. +358(0)40 614 7477, asko.saastamoinen@sibanyestillwater.com

You are offered

- Supporting senior leads on large-scale customer and partnership deals

- Performing market and corporate finance analysis for joint ventures and M&A projects
- Turning quantitative data into clear slides and presentations for management and clients

- Ability to present and explain financial findings clearly to stakeholders
- Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken)

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Finnish or Swedish
- Familiarity with the energy industry or large-scale infrastructure investments
- Background in Corporate Finance studies
- Experience with asset or portfolio optimization analysis

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Detail-oriented and structured
- Change-oriented
- Stress tolerant
- Proactive
- Collaborative
- Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. jobs.title: Osa-aikainen Support-/varastotyöntekijä Power Kaleva
jobs.description:
ETSIMME VARASTO-/SUPPORT-PISTEELLE TYÖNTEKIJÄÄ VAKITUISEEN TYÖSUHTEESEEN POWER KALEVAN MYYMÄLÄÄMME

Oletko henkilö, joka innostuu päästessään selvittämään miksi asiakkaan kannettava tietokone ei käynnisty tai saat auttaa häntä uuden puhelimen käyttöönotossa sekä yhteystietojen siirrossa? Haluat tarjota parasta asiakaspalvelua ja nautit siitä, että pystyt ratkaisemaan ongelmia päivittäin?

Onko sinustakin parasta työpäivissä se, etteivät ne ole aina samanlaisia ja osaat nähdä asioihin ratkaisun silloin kuin välttämättä muut eivät sitä näe? Sytyt saadessasi työskennellä päivittäin erilaisten laitteiden parissa ja selvittäessä vastauksia ohjelmistoihin sekä käyttöjärjestelmiin liittyviin asiakkaiden kysymyksiin. Onko sinulla paloa uuden oppimiseen ja tunnet aitoa halua auttaa asiakkaita? Hienoa - jatka lukemista ja selvitä, onko Powerin Support-työntekijän paikka juuri sinua varten tehty!

Me parannamme ihmisten päivää silloinkin, kun asiakkaan lattialle pudonneesta tietokoneesta pitää siirtää kuvat uuteen Macbookiin, tietokoneen näyttö pitää lähettää takuuhuoltoon tai virus jyllää ja aiheuttaa murheita puhelimessa. Osaamme neuvoa asiakkaita uusien laitteiden käytön kanssa ja löydämme oikeat sanat asiakkaiden auttamiseksi silloinkin, kun neuvojamme tarvitsee oman elämänsä koodari tai ensimmäisen älypuhelimensa hankkinut seniori.

Powerilaisille yhdenvertaisuus sekä monimuotoisuus ovat tärkeitä arvoja. Etsimme nyt hyvää tyyppiä osaksi Power Kalevan porukkaa. Meillä kaikki ovat saman arvoisia!

Haluamme sinut vahvistamaan tiimiämme ja tarjoamme:

- Työpaikan hienojen ja alati kehittyvien tuotteiden parissa
- Aloituksen sopimuksen mukaan sekä laadukkaan perehdytyksen
- Monipuolisen ja osaamistasi laaja-alaisesti kehittävän työnkuvan
- Mielenkiintoisen pohjoismaisen yrityksen puitteet työympäristöksi
- Kaupanalan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen
- Illoista, lauantaista ja sunnuntaista saat lisät työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti
- Työtunnit viikossa 20/vko
- E-passi
- Liittymäetu
- Omia tulevia hankintoja varten tuotteet hyvään henkilökuntahintaan

Voisit olla etsimämme henkilö jos

- Haluat palvella asiakkaita parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla
- Aikataulujen ja rutiinien noudattaminen ei ole sinulle haastavaa
- Tulet hyvin toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa
- Olet proaktiivinen ja valmis oppimaan uutta
- Osaat työskennellä niin tiimissä, kuin itsenäisesti

Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata meille hakiessa ja tärkeintä onkin, että haluat oppia uutta ja palat halusta työskennellä asiakkaiden parissa. Me perehdytämme sinut työtehtäviisi ja autamme sinua kehittymään työssäsi jatkuvasti.

Aloittamisen suhteen olemme joustavia, mutta sopivan henkilön löytyessä aloitus onnistuu, vaikka heti.

Muuta tietoa

Power Finland kuuluu Power International AS -konserniin, joka omistaa Power ketjut Norjassa, Tanskassa, Suomessa sekä Ruotsissa. Meitä Powerilaisia on Pohjoismassa yhteensä yli 6500, joista kaikki ovat sitoutuneet tarjoamaan ainutlaatuisia asiakaskokemuksia asiakkaillemme. Pohjoismainen keskusvarastomme sijaitsee Ruotsissa ja konsernin liikevaihto on yli miljardi euroa. Lisätietoa meistä löydät nettisivuiltamme www.power.fi

Tervetuloa Powerille!

jobs.title: Research assistant
jobs.description:
Want to combine your programming skills with pioneering research in Human-Robot Interaction? Join our multidisciplinary research team and gain practical experience developing software for robotic platforms, supporting user studies, and contributing to innovative projects that explore the future of human-centred technology.



Information about the division/the project

The https://www.chalmers.se/en/departments/cse/, a joint department of Chalmers and the University of Gothenburg, spans the breadth of computing disciplines. Our internationally visible research, strong industry links and diverse environment create a collaborative setting where ideas grow into real impact.

At the https://www.chalmers.se/en/departments/cse/our-research/interaction-design-and-software-engineering/, we design smarter ways to engineer better software, and explore how people engage with digital systems, combining global research perspectives with strong collaboration with industry.



Job description

You will join a research team comprising professors, Doctoral students, and postdoctoral researchers, who conduct research in the field of Human-Robot Interaction. Your role will be to assist with various ongoing research projects. Duties will include developing and testing software for robot (e.g. Softbanks Robotics "Pepper", and other similar platforms), setting up local databases for data collection, assisting the researchers during the user studies, helping setting up online studies, etc.

You will have regular contact with the researchers and you will participate in group meetings, allowing you to gain a wider knowledge about the research topics within the groups. This position will allow you to gain practical experience conducting research projects in a highly interdisciplinary setting, combining elements of computer science and cognitive science.



Contract terms

Temporary employment

Employment period: 2 months initial contract, followed by a 7-month extension (9 months total).

Extent: 20%

Location: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Gothenburg (Lindholmen campus)

First day of employment: 2026-10-01 or as soon as possible thereafter.



Qualifications

To qualify for this position:

    You must be an active student at bachelor or master level studying in one of the institution's BSc or MSc level programmes at the University of Gothenburg or Chalmers University of Technology.
    You should have good knowledge in English, both spoken and written.
    You need to be in Gothenburg, Sweden during the time of your employment.
    You are able to work independently and communicate progress / issues clearly.
    You are proactive and can manage working in parallel projects if need be.
    You have experience with one or more programming languages commonly used in Human-Robot Interaction research (Python, JavaScript).

It is meritorious if:

    You have experience programming robots (e.g. using ROS).
    You have an understanding of large language models or conversational AI frameworks (e.g., OpenAI API, Gemini AI).
    You have experience setting up and maintaining databases (e.g. SQLite, MySQL).
    You have an interest in research involving users interacting with technology.



What we offer

Chalmers provides a cultivating and inspiring working environment in the coastal city of https://www.goteborg.com/en/.

Read more about https://www.chalmers.se/en/about-chalmers/work-with-us/chalmers-as-an-employer/ and our https://www.chalmers.se/en/about-chalmers/work-with-us/chalmers-as-an-employer/benefits-and-conditions/ for employees.

Chalmers aims to actively improve our gender balance. We work broadly with equality projects, for example the https://www.chalmers.se/en/about-chalmers/organisation-and-governance/equality/genie-gender-initiative-for-excellence/. Equality and diversity are substantial foundations in all activities at Chalmers.



Application procedure

The application should be attached as PDF files, as below:



CV

Personal letter

Other documents (optional):

    Copies of completed education, grades etc.



A background check may be conducted as part of the application process.

Please use the button at the bottom of the page to reach the application form. We do not accept applications sent by email.



Application deadline: 2026-09-24



For questions, please contact:

Dr. Ilaria Torre

ilariat@chalmers.se



*** Chalmers declines to consider all offers of further announcement publishing or other types of support for the recruiting process in connection with this position. ***

Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg conducts research and education in technology and natural sciences at a high international level. The university has 3100 employees and 10,000 students, and offers education in engineering, science, shipping and architecture. With scientific excellence as a basis, Chalmers promotes knowledge and technical solutions for a sustainable world. Through global commitment and entrepreneurship, we foster an innovative spirit, in close collaboration with wider society.

Chalmers was founded in 1829 and has the same motto today as it did then: Avancez – forward.
