jobs.title: Account Associate - Retail & Grocery (H/F)
jobs.description:
Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de transformer la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses. Chez Deliveroo, impact, innovation et croissance sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les livreurs partenaires pour donner à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elle veut, comme elle le veut, quand elle le veut et où elle le veut.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Ce que vous ferez au quotidien

En tant que Account Associate - Retail & Grocery (H/F), vous serez responsable du succès d’un portefeuille de partenaires, afin d’assurer la meilleure expérience à nos utilisateurs, tout en construisant un partenariat solide et durable avec nos eux pour notre application.

  • Analysez la performance de votre portefeuille et prenez les mesures adéquates, faites des recommandations, soyez agile et ouvert à la nouveauté.

  • Optimisation et gestion de Processus : Deliveroo est une société qui évolue à grande vitesse et à grande échelle. Vous aurez l’opportunité de créer et améliorer des processus, par exemple la gestion de partenariats pour contribuer à la croissance. Vous élaborerez des documents de meilleures pratiques pour des comptes spécifiques et pour l'ensemble du portefeuille

  • Relations avec les magasins Retail et/ou Grocery : Vous gérerez le développement des partenariats, le suivi des données, et vous assurerez une expérience optimale sur l’application afin de faire de Deliveroo le service de livraison à domicile de référence, en apportant votre expertise Food Tech en étant l'expert de votre zone / ville.

  • Vous veillerez au suivi du respect des engagements contractuels pris avec les partenaires de votre portefeuille.

Ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir

  • Expérience : stage ou alternance dans un rôle d’Account management ou commercial. Une expérience terrain au sein d’un grand groupe (idéalement supermarché, marketplace, ecommerce, retailer, FMCG) est un vrai atout.

  • Commercial : vous avez à cœur de négocier, d’anticiper des discussions commerciales, d’entreprendre des actions afin de maintenir un portefeuille de qualité (discussions contractuelles, négociations de mise en place d'outils commerciaux, etc)

  • Entrepreneur : vous avez le goût pour entreprendre, créer, aller chercher des opportunités, en sachant prendre de la hauteur mais sans jamais se couper du terrain et de votre téléphone pour comprendre vos partenaires.

  • Analytique : capable d’être synthétique, d'approfondir les données et de comprendre les données qui permettent d'améliorer les performances pour nos partenaires en magasins.

  • Proactif(-ive) dans vos relations avec les interlocuteurs. Vous adorez être sur le terrain et vous êtes impliqué(e) dans tout ce qui est opérationnel dans votre périmètre.

  • Centré sur le client : être obsédé par nos clients. Utiliser des données quantitatives et qualitatives pour construire un service qui soit opérationnellement excellent pour nos clients.

  • Jouer en équipe : un joueur d'équipe qui collabore et qui est capable de tirer le meilleur parti des personnes qui vous entourent. Capable de travailler efficacement à tous les niveaux de Deliveroo et de réussir avec et par les autres.

  • Optimiste, confiant et plein d'énergie : vous apportez de la fraîcheur, de l'énergie et de la passion dans l'équipe. Vous contribuez à créer un environnement de travail unique, propice aux nouvelles idées et agréable pour les autres personnes impliquées.

  • Langues : Français et Anglais courant indispensables.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Nous sommes des passionnés de food, des problem-solvers, des créateurs de communauté et bien plus encore. Ce qui nous rassemble : un esprit entrepreneurial fort et l’envie de construire quelque chose d’ambitieux ensemble.

🔧 Une grande autonomie pour avoir un impact concret sur votre portefeuille et nos partenaires.
🌱 Un environnement stimulant favorisant l’apprentissage, le développement et l’évolution de carrière.
💙 Des avantages pensés pour le bien-être et l’équilibre de nos équipes.
🌍 Une culture inclusive, internationale et collaborative où chacun peut trouver sa place.

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

jobs.title: Senior Post-Market Surveillance Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company & Role Overview 

About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. 

Role overview

As Post-Market Surveillance Manager, you'll build and run our global post-market surveillance system — from complaint handling and adverse-event reporting to data trending and governance — and lead its rollout across Customer Support, QA, Regulatory, Engineering, Clinical, and Product. This is a hands-on role: you'll turn post-market insights into action that improves product quality, patient safety, and the customer experience, drawing on strong judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to influence stakeholders globally. 

Requirements

Core responsibilities

  • Design, build, and run our global post-market surveillance system — complaint handling, adverse-event/vigilance reporting, escalation, and governance — staying hands-on for complex or high-risk cases
  • Own the complaint-to-report pipeline: reportability assessments and timely, accurate adverse-event/vigilance submissions across markets (US, EU, and others)
  • Build the KPIs, dashboards, and trending methods that surface safety, quality, and customer-experience signals — and turn findings into action via CAPA, risk management, product/software fixes, and labeling updates
  • Lead the cross-functional rollout — implementation plans, priorities, dependencies, and risk — to build sustainable post-market processes and infrastructure
  • Present post-market performance and recommendations to leadership, and support PMS reports, PSURs, and management reviews 
  • Act as SME during audits and inspections, and guide internal teams and external partners on post-market activities 

Background & Experience

  • 7+ years in medical-device post-market surveillance, complaint handling, quality, or regulatory affairs, including leading process implementations 
  • At least a bachelor's degree
  • Hands-on experience with complaint investigations, reportability assessments, and regulatory submissions (FDA MDR, EU MDR vigilance/PMS, ISO 13485, ISO 14971), plus post-market data analysis
  • Program management skills — workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies — plus an analytical mindset for turning complaint data into risk-based recommendations 
  • Strong communicator, comfortable influencing cross-functional teams, leadership, and regulators
  • Hands-on, independent leadership style; able to scale processes as we grow
  • Nice to have: experience with additional international markets or digital complaint-management systems

What success looks like

  • Scalable processes for complaint intake, investigation, and resolution — with clear escalation pathways to ensure adverse events and reportable incidents are identified, assessed, and reported within regulatory timeline
  • Customer Support consistently identifies, documents, and escalates complaints and potential safety events, thanks to close partnership and training
  • KPIs and dashboards give clear visibility into complaint timeliness, resolution, regulatory reporting, and emerging trends
  • Post-market insights translate into action — product improvements, CAPAs, risk-management updates, and a better customer experience

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You let data and clarity guide your decisions, and you take accountability for results. You're a difference maker — you drive ideas to commercial success from start to end 

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with quality. You treat feedback as a chance to learn, and you're deep in customer and partner feedback — translating it to action quickly

Team First — You collaborate effectively across teams and build trust through clarity and respect. You're comfortable bridging local execution with a global team, and you communicate openly across time zones

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale

jobs.title: Scrum Master
jobs.description:
For our client from banking industry, we are looking for a Scrum Master.

The Scrum Master acts as an Execution Leader responsible not only for facilitating Agile ceremonies and coaching the team, but also for actively driving the successful delivery of strategic initiatives from idea to implementation. The role combines Agile leadership, project execution, stakeholder management, delivery management, and AI enablement.

Detailed description of work task to be carried out:
Agile Leadership and Team Coaching
 Facilitate and continuously improve Agile ways of working within the team, ensuring effective execution of Scrum and SAFe practices.
 Organize and lead sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, reviews, backlog refinement sessions, PI Planning, and other Agile ceremonies.
 Coach team members, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile principles, continuous improvement, flow optimization, and value-driven delivery.
 Foster a high-performing, self-organizing, cross-functional team culture with strong collaboration, accountability, transparency, and psychological safety.
 Monitor and improve team health, engagement, predictability, quality, and delivery performance.

Initiative and Delivery Leadership:
 Take ownership of strategic initiatives, epics, features, and cross-team deliveries, acting as the primary execution leader throughout the delivery lifecycle.
 Create and maintain delivery plans, roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, risk logs, and execution tracking mechanisms
 Drive execution proactively by identifying blockers, coordinating issue resolution, escalating risks, and ensuring timely decision-making.
 Coordinate complex deliveries involving multiple teams, vendors, business stakeholders, and technology organizations.
 Ensure initiatives progress according to agreed scope, timelines, quality expectations, governance requirements, and funding constraints.
 Maintain visibility of delivery status and drive actions needed to achieve committed business outcomes.

AI Leadership and Transformation:
 Continuously identify and drive AI opportunities that improve productivity, quality, speed, and operational efficiency. Work with teams to define, prioritize, and implement AI use cases, ensuring AI and automation opportunities are considered during feature refinement, sprint planning, PI Planning, and continuous improvement activities.
 Promote an AI-first mindset across the Software Development Lifecycle by leveraging AI to improve planning, backlog management, documentation, testing, reporting, stakeholder communication, and overall team effectiveness. Encourage teams to actively challenge existing ways of working and explore how AI can simplify, automate, and accelerate value delivery

Must-have knowledge and experience:
 Experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, Project Manager, or Execution Leader in a technology-driven environment
 Strong delivery leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-team coordination capabilities
 Good understanding of API-based architectures, cloud technologies, infrastructure concepts, DevOps, and modern software development practices
 Understanding of Open Banking, digital platforms, or financial services technology ecosystems is considered a strong advantage
 Ability to engage effectively with architects, engineers, and business stakeholders without requiring hands-on technical expertise
 Proven interest in AI-driven ways of working and the ability to identify and drive adoption of AI, automation, and productivity-enhancing solutions across teams

Nice-to-have knowledge and experience:
 Experience working in financial services, banking, payments, Open Banking, Embedded Banking

Henkilö- ja pakettiautojen määräaikaishuoltoja ja mekaanisia korjauksia

Ilmastointihuoltoja ja korjauksia

Halutessasi rengastöitä

Autoalan perustutkintoa (autonasentaja / automekaanikko) tai vastaavaa työkokemusta. Kokemusta nykyaikaisten autojen diagnostiikkalaitteista ja sähköjärjestelmistä.

Huolellista, itsenäistä ja oma-aloitteista työskentelyotetta.

Voimassa olevaa B-ajokorttia.

Suomen kielen taitoa (englannin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi esim. korjausohjeiden tulkinnassa).

Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, asiakaspalvelu on työssämme keskiössä

Vakituisen ja vastuullisen työn vakaassa yrityksessä.

Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen osaamisesi mukaan

Kattavan työterveyshuollon

Nykyaikaiset työkalut, laitteet ja siistit työtilat.

Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ja osallistua alan täydennyskoulutuksiin.

Nuorekkaan ja rennon työyhteisön, jossa huumori kukkii.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Java
Forward Deployed Engineer, Manager -London
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Manager of Forward Deployed Engineering on Notion’s Services team, you will lead a team responsible for the hands-on technical delivery of our most complex customer engagements. Your team will design, build, and deploy production-ready solutions that help enterprise customers integrate Notion as the operating layer for their business.

You will combine people leadership, technical judgment, and customer-facing delivery. You will coach Forward Deployed Engineers through discovery, architecture, implementation, and launch while remaining close enough to the work to guide difficult technical decisions, unblock delivery, and build trust with senior customer stakeholders.

The team’s work includes custom code, production-grade agents and AI workflows using MCP, Agent APIs, and Notion’s automation and execution infrastructure, as well as integrations, data pipelines, enterprise migrations, and complex challenges involving scale, permissions, and governance.

You will help establish how Services delivers complex technical implementations across EMEA. This includes building a high-performing team, improving delivery standards and reusable technical assets, partnering with Sales, Product, CX, and Engineering, and turning lessons from customer deployments into product and platform improvements.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Forward Deployed Engineers delivering complex enterprise customer engagements across EMEA.

 - Create a high-performance team environment with clear expectations, strong technical standards, effective feedback, and meaningful career development.

 - Own the quality and outcomes of engagements from technical discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, launch, and handover.

 - Act as a trusted technical and delivery advisor to customer engineering, IT, security, and business leaders, helping them make informed architectural decisions and deepen their use of Notion.

 - Guide the design, build, and operation of custom agents, integrations, automations, and data pipelines that connect Notion with customers’ systems and workflows.

 - Oversee large-scale content and data migrations, including discovery, scoping, data modeling, transformation logic, validation, cutover, and post-migration optimization.

 - Review technical designs and implementation plans, identify delivery risks early, and step in directly when an engagement requires senior technical leadership.

 - Partner with Sales and Services leaders on qualification, feasibility, scoping, effort estimation, staffing, and delivery planning for strategic opportunities.

 - Balance customer priorities, team capacity, and technical complexity to make sound staffing and sequencing decisions.

 - Help define and scale the operating model for Forward Deployed Engineering, including hiring, onboarding, delivery methodologies, quality reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices.



SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 8+ years of experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, customer engineering, software engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role.

 - 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading engineers responsible for customer-facing technical delivery.

 - A strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams.

 - Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, or Python, with the technical depth to review production-quality code and guide implementation decisions.

 - Hands-on experience with APIs, integrations, authentication, data transformation, and production systems.

 - Experience leading technical discovery, assessing feasibility, identifying risks, scoping work, estimating effort, and translating ambiguous requirements into executable plans.

 - Strong architectural judgment and debugging skills, with the ability to isolate root causes across code, APIs, permissions, integrations, data quality, automation logic, system limits, and customer-specific environments.

 - Demonstrated success managing multiple complex customer engagements while maintaining quality, team health, and clear stakeholder communication.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and business audiences from practitioners through executive stakeholders.

 - A customer- and outcomes-oriented approach, with sound judgment about when to standardize, when to customize, and how to manage tradeoffs.
   
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building or scaling a Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or customer engineering function in a startup or high-growth environment.

 - Experience deploying AI agents in complex coding or business workflows.

 - Experience designing or implementing AI-powered workflows involving MCP, APIs, LLM applications, prompt engineering, retrieval or RAG systems, or workflow orchestration.

 - Experience with ETL or ELT workflows, schema mapping, validation scripts, and large-scale content or data migration tooling.

 - Experience partnering with product and engineering teams to influence roadmaps or architectural decisions based on customer implementation needs.

 - Experience supporting pre-sales and early engagement phases, including technical discovery, migration scoping, feasibility analysis, effort estimation, prototypes, and custom scripts.

 - Experience establishing technical delivery standards, quality review processes, discovery methodologies, or internal engineering tooling from the ground up.

 - A strong track record of successful enterprise implementations across multiple industries or regions.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. jobs.title: Premium Support Engineer (NYC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Premium Support Engineer at Replit, you’ll be the front line for our highest-value customers — delivering fast, expert, and reliable technical support when it matters most. You’ll handle complex product issues, guide customers through critical incidents, and ensure every interaction meets the highest standard of quality and speed.

Replit is at the forefront of AI-driven software development, and how we support customers is constantly evolving. You’ll play a critical role in shaping how Premium Support adapts to new products, new customer expectations, and AI-assisted workflows, operating effectively in ambiguity and driving clarity for your team.

You’ll combine deep technical troubleshooting with calm, confident communication to keep builders moving — whether it’s an enterprise team deploying at scale or a top-tier developer relying on Replit to power their business.






IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Provide swift, high-priority support to Premium customers, responding within strict SLAs.

 - Diagnose, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues across the Replit platform.

 - Escalate and track high-impact issues with Product and Engineering, ensuring timely fixes and transparent communication.

 - Lead customer-facing communications during outages or incidents.

 - Identify recurring issues and collaborate internally to reduce time-to-resolution.

 - Contribute to internal tooling, automation, and documentation that improves team efficiency.

 - Partner with Engineering, Product, Sales and other internal teams to ensure Premium customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience.

 - Help onboard and mentor other support engineers, raising the team’s overall bar for responsiveness and quality.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3+ years in technical support, developer support, or systems engineering.

 - Experience providing rapid-response support to high-value or enterprise customers.

 - Strong debugging skills with JavaScript, Python, or similar languages.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication under time pressure — able to convey technical concepts clearly and calmly.

 - Familiarity with support tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and internal debugging utilities.

 - Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority issues simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and composure.

 - A proactive, ownership-driven mindset and genuine empathy for customers building on Replit.




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are looking for an engaged and passionate Staff Engineer to join our growing engineering department and be a technical leader across our engineering teams.
 
As a Staff Engineer, you will be responsible for driving influence across teams and domains, leading solution delivery on cross-functional and strategic initiatives, and serving as a technical leader within the engineering organization. You will ensure the set quality standards and drive the adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps.
 
Quality, excellence, and agility drive our delivery processes and you will help us level these up. Using NodeJS and Typescript back-end stacks, appropriate for each requirement, but always hosted on AWS, we build added value and resilient services on top of voice and fully integrate with our customers’ business critical tools (CRM, Helpdesk, E-Commerce, …).
 

Your mission @ Aircall:
  • Lead transversal, complex projects, fully autonomously from ideation to completion, starting from a high-level problem statement.
  • Proactively communicate the technical vision across multiple teams, ensuring alignment and sharing knowledge across domains.
  • Act as a go-to expert, providing mentorship and guidance across teams.
  • Deeply understand multiple product domains; proactively identify improvements and advocate for customer needs across the company.
  • Lead and define technical strategies for complex, impactful problems.
  • Set and uphold higher quality standards and drive adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps.
  • Writes production-ready code, finding appropriate solutions for medium complexity challenges; participates in software design discussions; demonstrates a good understanding of system infrastructure and DevOps principles; contributes to performance and quality within their scope; applies a security-first mindset.
    •  

    A little about you:
  • A little about you:You have extensive experience (e.g., 10+ years) in back-end development, using TypeScript & NodeJS/Python/Ruby/Rails or other languages, with a focus on delivering for security, scalability, availability, and performance across multiple domains.
  • You lead and define technical strategies, demonstrating a strong understanding of system design to solve complex, impactful problems.
  • You are comfortable leading the development of complex projects affecting multiple teams and domains, driving initiatives from ideation to completion.
  • You are an expert at identifying opportunities for new impactful initiatives.
  • You have a deep understanding of multiple product domains and can anticipate long-term needs.
  • You possess effective and proactive communication skills, and can collaborate with different profiles and roles to ensure cross-domain alignment.

    • Our Tech Stack:
  • You do not need to be familiar with all of our technical stack or any specific functional area, but you have a strong willingness to learn and adapt quickly.
  • Typescript/Node.js, Python, REST API/GraphQL APIs, Ruby/Rails, React AWS/Serverless or EKS, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Redis
    • Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

    DE&I Statement: 
    At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. 

    We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.  

    We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn.

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Business Partner to serve as the dedicated operational partner to the GM, EMEA. In this role, you'll be the connective tissue between the EMEA go-to-market (GTM) organization and Global Revenue Operations (RevOps), owning the operating cadence, surfacing the insights that drive decisions, and turning regional strategy into executable plans.

You'll support the full EMEA GTM motion across Business Development Representative (BDR), Account Executive (AE), Partner Account Manager (PAM), Account Manager (AM), Solutions Engineer (SE), Customer Engineer (CE), and Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) functions, spanning four Areas: FIME, UKI, DACH, and Iberia. You'll run the forecast and QBR cadence, own analytics and insights for the region, drive process improvement, and feed regional learnings back into the Global RevOps Center of Excellence, so best practices scale across the business.

This is a high-visibility role for someone who can move fluently between the boardroom and the spreadsheet — equally comfortable facilitating an executive forecast review and building the capacity model underneath it.


What you will do:

  • Act as the trusted operational partner to the GM, EMEA, owning the region's GTM operating model and rhythm of business

  • Run the EMEA forecast process end to end — preparing, facilitating, and following up on weekly forecast calls across the four Areas (FIME, UKI, DACH, Iberia)

  • Own the quarterly business review (QBR) cadence: structure, narrative, data, and readouts for regional and executive audiences

  • Deliver analytics and insights across the full EMEA GTM funnel (BDR, AE, PAM, AM, SE, CE, FDE), translating data into clear, actionable recommendations

  • Lead process improvement initiatives that increase seller productivity, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy

  • Partner with the Global RevOps Center of Excellence, providing regional inputs and adopting standardized best practices, tooling, and methodologies

  • Drive annual planning for EMEA, including territory design, segmentation, and capacity/headcount modeling

  • Support quota setting, coverage models, and GTM design in partnership with Sales, Finance, and the broader RevOps team

  • Maintain data quality and operational discipline across the region's systems and reporting


    • What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Strategy & Operations, or a comparable analytical/commercial role, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment

  • Strong experience supporting a multi-segment, multi-country GTM organization across direct, partner, and post-sales motions

jobs.title: Occitan text provider / éditeur d'ancien occitan (H/F)
jobs.description:
L'Université de Montpellier Paul-Valéry (UMPV) est une université des Humanités : Lettres, Langues, Arts, Sciences Humaines et Sociales. Plus de 22 000 étudiants sont inscrits de la licence au doctorat et 240 diplômes en lien avec les besoins socio-économiques y sont préparés.

Université citoyenne et durable, dont le site principal est installé sur un campus arboré de plus de 10 hectares labellisé Patrimoine du XXe siècle, elle est dotée d'équipements pédagogiques exceptionnels, tels le Musée des Moulages classé, le Théâtre La Vignette « scène conventionnée pour l'émergence et la diversité », le Learning center ATRIUM conçu comme un lieu de savoir vivant, modernisant la fonction de bibliothèque universitaire et les services aux étudiants.

Contexte du recrutement
Projet SRC 2026-1 MIRANDA : Digital Occitan Paleography

Ce projet s'inscrit dans le cadre d'un partenariat de longue date avec les Archives de Montpellier Métropole et s'intéresse au Registre du clavaire, livre de comptes de la ville, rédigé en 1357-1358.
Son objectif est d'offrir une transcription complète de ce livre manuscrit inédit en formant des étudiants avancés d'une part à la paléographie de l'occitan médiéval et, d'autre part, à une utilisation correcte de l'intelligence artificielle. Grâce à la plateforme open source eScriptorium, système de reconnaissance de l'écriture manuscrite (HTR), il sera en effet possible d'entraîner l'IA à lire correctement l'occitan (principe du deep learning). Le programme se déroulera de septembre 2026 à mars 2027. En voici le calendrier : recrutement des stagiaires en septembre, installation et apprentissage des outils en octobre, colloque ouvert au public pour présenter les résultats de cette expérience fin mars. Les données produites, partagées selon les principes de la science ouverte, enrichiront les recherches sur l'histoire de Montpellier ainsi que sur la langue politique et administrative de la ville médiévale : l'occitan. Cette initiative saura également sensibiliser la jeune génération à la préservation du patrimoine linguistique et aux enjeux éthiques de l'intelligence artificielle, tout en rapprochant chercheurs, étudiants et citoyens autour d'un héritage commun.

Missions
La personne recrutée aura pour mission l'édition d'un livre manuscrit occitan du Moyen Âge tardif. Elle sera formée à l'utilisation de la plateforme open source eScriptorium, système de reconnaissance de l'écriture manuscrite (HTR) assisté par l'IA. Elle devra entraîner la plateforme à lire correctement les folios numérisés d'un livre manuscrit du XIVe siècle (principe du ML  -machine learning-) afin :

- d'éditer les 270 folios du ms. en question.

- de créer un modèle de reconnaissance de l'écriture manuscrite tardomédiévale pour l'occitan.

CONNAISSANCES ET SAVOIRS
Bonne connaissance de la langue occitane médiévale (niveau Master ou Doctorat).

SAVOIR FAIRE OPÉRATIONNELS
IA friendly, disponibilité à l'apprentissage des plateformes de transcription des textes.

SAVOIR ÊTRE
- Écoute,
- Patience,
- Ténacité,
- Autonomie,
- Disponibilité,
- Capacité d'interaction avec les autres membres de l'équipe.

Formations et/ou expérience professionnelle souhaitables
licence ou master d'occitan avec une préprofessionnalisation en paléographie occitane à la clé, connaissance de la TEI (protocole de balisage Text Encoding Initiative).

Rémunération
Pour les personnels contractuels, par référence à la grille de rémunération de l'université soit entre 1 682 € brut mensuel et 1 996€ brut mensuel en fonction de l'expérience acquise sur des fonctions similaires et dans une catégorie d'emploi équivalente :

Your role

As part of the French B2B team, you will contribute to the development and engagement of our healthcare professional network by building and managing B2B activations tailored to the needs of the French market.

jobs.title: Ph.D.-scholarship in numerical optimisation of wind assisted propulsion systems
jobs.description:
Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, has a vacancy for PhD Research Fellow in numerical optimisation of wind assisted propulsion systems

Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (Høgskulen på Vestlandet, HVL) has an open Ph.D. position with a project period of 4 years at the Department of Mechanical Engineering and Maritime Studies. The Ph.D. candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary project involving three research groups on energy and environmental technology, on wind, water and waves and on data science. 

Due to the nature of the work to be carried out in the project, the candidate will be a part of the Ph.D.-programme Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing. (https://www.hvl.no/en/research/phd-programmes/phd-programme-in-computer-science/). The research programme in Computer Science currently includes 20 professors and associate professors, more than 30 PhD and post-doctoral fellows, and a large number of master’s students.

This programme is located at the Faculty of Technology, Environmental and Social Sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. PhD research fellows receive an annual work expense funding which can be used for conference participation, research visits, and equipment.

Workplace will be at HVL Campus Bergen.


Tasks and areas of responsibility:

Wind Assisted Propulsion Systems (WAPS) are moving from demonstration to commercial scale. Rotor sails and rigid wing sails are currently installed on tankers, bulkers, and Ro-Ro vessels, and a growing number of wind-cargo ships are being purpose-built for sail propulsion. Sails reduce the ship’s onboard energy demand, and with it fuel consumption and emissions.


This PhD project will develop simulation and optimisation methods for modern sail design based on the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) as part of the optimisation loop. The developed method will be applied to optimise both existing sail technologies and novel concepts depending on ship size, route, and operation in order to determine fuel and emission savings.
 

The project will extend an existing Julia LBM in-house code, with established HPC LBM frameworks as references, benchmarks, and potential building blocks combined with Bayesian optimisation.

As part of the required duties (25% of the position), the candidate will join the team focusing on regional development at the faculty and the department. This might include:


• Promote more externally funded research projects in collaboration between our research environment and the shipping industry.
• Interact with regional, national and international partners, and work to promote cooperation between the department and the surrounding society (e.g., bachelor and master theses).
• Mobilization to promote research-based innovation in the shipping industry in collaboration with our participation in the project FORREGION Vestland.
• Supporting the department in our work related to lifelong learning in the shipping industry, with emphasis on strengthening the portfolio of flexible and decentralized education.


Qualifications (requirements):

•Admission to the PhD programme requires that the applicant holds a master’s degree in computer science or a closely related field, such as a master’s degree in informatics, software engineering, communication systems, engineering computing, scientific computing, or computational engineering.
•Candidates from other natural sciences or engineering disciplines holding a master’s degree with a strong emphasis on ICT and computing, for example mechanical, marine or aerospace engineering, applied mathematics or computational physics, may also qualify for admission to the PhD programme.
•Admission into the programme requires that the applicant has obtained strong grades for both the master’s thesis and the course work of the master’s degree. Specifically, admission into the programme normally requires that the applicant has obtained:
- a grade of B (Norwegian/ECTS scale) or better on the master’s thesis,
- an average grade higher than C (Norwegian/ECTS scale) on the coursework associated with the master’s degree
•Documented programming skills beyond scripting in Julia, or in a language Julia can call (Python, C, C++, Fortran).

The PhD research fellow must enrol in the PhD programme in Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, and must meet the formal admission requirements for admission into the PhD programme. The position is announced for a period of 4 years with 25% of the 4-year period will be designated to duties such as teaching, development and administrative tasks.

The PhD candidate will be assigned two academic supervisors at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. An application for enrolment should first be submitted after an appointment is made and the supervisors will help with this procedure. The candidate must be enrolled as a PhD student within 3 months from the start of the employment.


Favoured qualifications (not requirements):

- Master’s thesis in computational fluid dynamics, ideally applied to wings, foils, rotors, or similar configurations.
- Knowledge of and experience with Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) and/or Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
- Knowledge of and experience with optimisation methods.

 

Personal abilities:

- Ability to contribute towards a good work environment and in teamwork.
- Excellent communication skills, ability to communicate well in both written and spoken English. Proficiency, written and spoken, in a Scandinavian language is an advantage.
- The candidate must be diligent and display the ability to work independently, supplemented with regular guidance, and is expected to carry out high-quality research and to publish the results in international workshops, conferences, and journals.

 

Candidates who have submitted a master’s thesis and who have not yet been awarded a master’s degree may also qualify for the position, provided that the master`s degree is awarded within four weeks of the deadline for applications to this position. Proof of successfully finishing the master’s degree along with the grade for the thesis and the final average grade must be submitted to HVL as soon as possible. Applicants already holding a Ph.D. are not eligible for this position.


In addition to the required educational and scientific background, the following criteria will be evaluated: competence and grades on completed course work, quality of the master's thesis, publications (if any), research and teaching experience, practical software engineering skills and experience. A possible outline of a research plan for a potential PhD project will also be taken into account.

The PhD candidate will be assigned two academic supervisor(s) at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. The necessary application to join the Ph.D. programme Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing must be submitted and accepted within 3 months of starting in the position. The supervisors will help with this procedure.


Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to the regulation for export control system. The regulation might be applied in the processing of the applications.


For more information, contact: Associate Prof. Norbert Lümmen: Norbert.Lummen@hvl.no 


Application procedure:

Applications will be evaluated by an expert panel of three members.

Applicants are asked to submit their application and CV online. Please use the link “Apply for this job” (“Søk stillingen”).

The following documentation must be uploaded as an attachment to the online application:


•A brief cover letter including a description of research interests and motivation for working within the current project. The cover letter should include a detailed justification of your qualifications in relation to the listed requirements.
•CV (summarizing education, positions and a complete list of academic publications)
•Master thesis
•Transcripts and diplomas of bachelor’s and master’s degrees. If you have not yet completed your master’s degree, please submit a statement from your institution confirming the expected date of award of your master’s degree.
•Diplomas and certificatesAt least one letter of recommendation preferably from a previous academic supervisor.
•Names and contact details of 2 references. One of these should be the main supervisor of the master’s thesis.

At least one letter of recommendation preferably from a previous academic supervisor.

In case the applicant already has publications, a complete list of these and copies of up to five selected publications should be uploaded. Applicants should indicate which of these publications or parts of these publications should be given special consideration in the evaluation.

If the documents submitted are not in a Scandinavian language or in English, the applicants must submit certified translations of these. The transcripts must specify the topics, the course works, and the grades at the bachelor`s and master`s degree levels. It is required that the applicant encloses a recognition document showing that their degree is equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD. You can read more about applying for recognition of foreign higher education here.

The Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) offers an automatic recognition document for certain degrees from selected countries. If the applicant’s degree is covered by the automatic recognition, it will be sufficient to attach this document. Read more about automatic recognition here.

As the HK-dir application process may take some time it is recommended to apply to HK-dir as soon as possible. If you have not received a recognition document from HK- dir within the  application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir showing that they have received your application.

Applicants should note that the evaluation will be based on the documentation submitted electronically via Jobbnorge within the submission deadline. The applicants are responsible for ensuring that all the documentation is submitted before the closing date. It is of utmost importance that all publications to be considered in the evaluation are uploaded as an attachment with the application, since these are sent electronically to the expert panel. Applications cannot be sent by e-mail or to individuals at HVL.

Applicants may be called in for an interview.


Salary:
  • Good occupational pension, insurance and loan schemes from The Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Exciting academic environment with the possibility of competence enhancement and development
  • Opportunities for training within the working hours 

The Research Fellow position is compensated according to position code 1017 Research Fellow.

There is a compulsory 2 % deduction to the pension fund (see http://www.spk.no for more information). The successful applicant must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time.


General information:

The appointment will be made in accordance with the regulations for State employees Law in Norway ("Lov om statens ansatte)". Organizational changes and changes in the duties and responsibilities associated with the position must be expected.

State employment shall reflect the multiplicity of the population at large to the highest possible degree. Western Norway University of Applied Sciences Bergen has therefore adopted a personnel policy objective to ensure that we achieve a balanced age and gender composition and the recruitment of persons of various ethnic backgrounds.

Information about the applicant may be made public even though the applicant has requested not to be named in the list of applicants. The applicant will be notified if his/her request is not respected.

Short-listed applicants will be called in for an interview.

Employed on condition that you are granted a work and residence permit (must be considered individually).

Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to The Export Control Regulation. The regulation will be applied in the processing of the applications. 


Inclusion, challenging norms, collaboration

Homepage

https://www.hvl.no/en/research/phd-programmes/phd-programme-in-computer-science/


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Høgskulen på Vestlandet (HVL) er en av de største høgskolene i landet, med om lag 1 800 tilsette og 16 000 studenter fordelt på fem campus i Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og Haugesund. Hvert år uteksaminerer vi 3000 kandidater som er med på å løse viktige samfunnsoppgaver.


HVL har sterke og innovative fagmiljø innen helse- og sosialvitskap, ingeniør- og maritime utdanningar, lærer-, kultur- og idrettsfag, natur- og samfunnsvitskap, og økonomi og ledelse. HVL skal være tett på arbeidslivet, regionen og studentene. Den overordnet ambisjonen vår er å bli et universitet med en tydelig profesjons- og arbeidslivsrettet profil.


HVL sin visjon er "Kunnskap som bygger menneske og samfunn". Strategiske ambisjoner og mål har særlig oppmerksom på berekraftig samfunnsutvikling, velferd og innovasjon, forankret i våre verdier - inkludere, utfordre og samhandle - som kjennetegner identiteten og kulturen hos oss.


 Fakultetet for teknologi, miljø- og samfunnsvitskap har et bredt utdanningstilbud både på bachelor og masternivå innenfor ingeniør- og naturfag, økonomiske og administrative fag, maritime fag, samfunnsvitskap og humaniora, i tillegg til phd-utdanninger i datateknologi, ansvarlig innovasjon og regional utvikling og i nautiske operasjoner.

Fakultet har fem institutt med om lag 500 tilsette og 5700 studenter. Fakultetet blir ledet av dekan som har det overordnet ansvaret for den faglige og administrative virksomheten ved fakultetet og som rapporterer til rektor. Hoveddelen av fakultetet sin virksomhet er i Haugesund, Bergen, Sogndal og Førde, men fakultetet har også aktivitet ved campus Stord.


Institutt for maskin- og maritime studium har om lag 900 studentar og 80 tilsette i Bergen og Haugesund. Instituttet har ansvaret for fagtilbud innen maritime utdanninger, maskinfag, marinteknikk, bærekraftig produksjon og sirkulærøkonomi og energi- og havteknologi. Havrommet er en fellesnemnar - sammen med fagfelt som samhandling mellom mennesker, organisasjon og teknologi (inkludert system), framtidas utfordringer i blant annet grønn omstilling, og økt digitalisering og autonomi i maritim og marin sektor. Instituttet har syv bachelorprogram, to masterprogram og ph.d.-i Nautiske operasjoner. Det er flere mulige veier til gjennomgående utdanninger fra bachelor til ph.d. i instituttet.

jobs.title: Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS HGCAL
jobs.description:
What you'll do
As Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL), you will play a key role in the development, integration, testing and commissioning of the power systems for one of the most innovative particle detectors ever conceived.

Working within a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will contribute to the procurement and testing of power supplies for HGCAL detector modules, including low-voltage, high-current supplies for the readout electronics and medium-voltage supplies of up to 800 V for sensor biasing.

You will also contribute to the integration of power systems with the detector's safety, control and monitoring systems, as well as the testing and implementation of power components such as DC-DC converters, voltage regulation and cabling.

A key aspect of the role will be to assess the impact of the power system on HGCAL performance and to develop and implement strategies to minimise noise effects such as interference, coupling and ripple.

This role offers the opportunity to combine strong electrical engineering and detector-physics skills with hands-on involvement in the construction, testing and commissioning of a large-scale, state-of-the-art particle detector.

Your responsibilities
Follow the procurement of the power supplies (Low Voltage and Bias Voltage, totalling several MCHF), including carrying out acceptance and stress tests on the delivered units.
Support the commissioning of these power systems during the mass assembly and testing phases of HGCAL.
Work with physicists and engineers to evaluate the performance of HGCAL in relation to its power systems and to develop and implement mitigation strategies where possible and necessary, first on the surface and subsequently when HGCAL is installed in CMS, 100 metres underground.
Work with the HGCAL and central CMS Technical Coordination teams to oversee the installation and testing of the power systems underground in the "Service" and "Experimental" caverns. This will include overseeing cable installation, in-situ connectorisation where needed, testing and commissioning, and the integration of the power system into the HGCAL and CMS safety and monitoring systems.

Your profile
Strong track record in testing, operating and debugging power systems for complex devices, such as particle detectors used in high-energy physics experiments.
Experience with silicon- and/or scintillator-based particle detectors would be an advantage.
Experience with large-scale procurement of electronic systems, such as power supplies.
Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Construction, test and installation of power electronic components and systems.
Specification and follow-up of technical aspects of a contract.
Testing and validation of detector components.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Assimilates large quantities of information, identifies key issues and formulates conclusions clearly and concisely.
Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

jobs.title: rdinator for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter
jobs.description:
What you'll do
As Field Coordinator for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL), you will play a key role in coordinating and overseeing the assembly, integration, testing and commissioning of one of the most innovative particle detectors ever conceived. Working within a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will help coordinate the mass assembly and testing of HGCAL detector elements ("cassettes") on the surface, their integration into the complete 250-tonne detector, and the subsequent system-level testing.

You will also contribute to the installation and commissioning of HGCAL approximately 100 metres underground within CMS, including the integration and testing of essential services such as CO? cooling, dry gas, cabling and optical fibres. This role offers the opportunity to combine strong technical coordination skills with hands-on involvement in the construction and commissioning of a large-scale, state-of-the-art particle detector.

Your responsibilities
Oversee the operation and maintenance of the HGCAL assembly and testing facilities at CERN, which include large ISO 7 cleanrooms and a large assembly hall. These areas are equipped with high-power electrical and cooling infrastructure that must be operated continuously and safely. You will be responsible for planning and organising the execution of all interventions in these facilities.
Provide technical support to physicists, engineers and technicians using these facilities. This will include liaising with the HGCAL Technical Coordinators and Safety Officer, as well as with the central CMS Technical Coordination team and CERN service groups (e.g. HVAC, electrical infrastructure, etc.).
Plan and supervise all activities related to the large-scale detector integration, including cassette insertion (Hadronic section of HGCAL - CE-H) and stacking (Electromagnetic section - CE-E), the mechanical and electrical connection between CE-E and CE-H, installation and testing of the HGCAL thermal screen (to maintain the exterior at a warm temperature while the interior is cold), and cold testing of the complete detector.
Work with the HGCAL team to plan and execute tests of "sectors" of HGCAL on the surface, and similarly when HGCAL is installed inside CMS.
Work with the HGCAL Engineering Team to ensure the safe transport of large and delicate HGCAL structures around the site, as well as the overall lowering of HGCAL into the experimental cavern.
Oversee logistics for HGCAL-related items, including detector modules, cassettes, ancillary equipment and mechanical components.

Your profile
Strong track record in planning and coordinating facilities for the assembly and testing of complex devices, such as particle detectors.
Demonstrated experience in the assembly and testing of particle detectors, particularly those based on silicon sensors, would be an advantage.
Familiarity with project planning tools such as Merlin and MS Project.
Proven ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multidisciplinary teams of engineers, scientists and technicians.
Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physics, Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Operation and maintenance of electromechanical equipment and systems.
Operation and support of experimental facilities.
Organisation, planning and control.
Testing and validation of detector components.
Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
Coordinates activities and focuses team on goals and objectives; monitors progress of team towards agreed goals and takes corrective action when needed.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Anticipates obstacles; assesses alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.
Objectively assesses and monitors own work; regularly reports on progress and advises of any changes in schedule or priorities.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

jobs.title: Field Service Manager, Ecolab
jobs.description:
**Haluatko työskennellä tunnettujen ravintolaketjujen kanssa ja yhdistää asiakastyön, itsenäisen kenttäroolin sekä käytännön tekemisen? Etsimme nyt Ecolabille Field Service Manageria vahvistamaan Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) -tiimiämme Suomessa.**

_Ecolab on maailman johtava vesi-, hygienia- ja infektioiden ehkäisyratkaisuissa ja palveluissa, jotka auttavat suojelemaan ihmisten, planeetan ja yritysten terveyttä. Toimitamme kattavia tieteeseen perustuvia ratkaisuja, tietopohjaisia näkemyksiä ja maailmanluokan palvelua edistääksemme elintarviketurvallisuutta, autamme ylläpitämään puhtaita ja turvallisia ympäristöjä, optimoimaan veden ja energian käyttöä sekä parantamaan toiminnan tehokkuutta ja kestävyyttä asiakkaille kaikkialla maailmassa._

**Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?**

Field Service Managerina toimit asiakkaidesi luotettuna kumppanina puhtaanapitoon, hygieniaan ja laiteratkaisuihin liittyvissä asioissa. Vastaat oman alueesi asiakkuuksista ja työskentelet tiiviisti asiakkaiden kanssa varmistaaksesi, että he hyödyntävät Ecolabin ratkaisuja parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla.

Työssäsi vierailet säännöllisesti tunnettujen pikaruokaravintolaketjujen toimipisteissä, koulutat asiakkaita tuotteiden, laitteiden ja toimintatapojen parissa sekä autat heitä ylläpitämään korkeita hygienia- ja laatustandardeja. Vastaat oman alueesi asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä sekä tunnistat aktiivisesti myynti- ja lisämyyntimahdollisuuksia. Rakennat pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita ja autat asiakkaita löytämään heidän tarpeisiinsa sopivimmat ratkaisut. Tehtävääsi kuuluu myös annostelulaitteiden ja muiden laiteratkaisujen käyttöönottoja, asennuksia sekä huoltotoimenpiteitä. Lisäksi huolehdit tarvittavasta raportoinnista sekä osallistut oman vastuualueesi toimintatapojen ja palveluiden kehittämiseen.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, ja se solmitaan alkuun Biisonin kanssa. Työ on liikkuvaa ja itsenäistä kenttätyötä, jossa suurin osa työajasta kuluu asiakkaiden luona. Vastuualue kattaa koko Suomen, mutta työ painottuu erityisesti Etelä-Suomeen. Matkat ovat pääosin päiväreissuja, mutta toisinaan työ edellyttää myös yöpymistä. Kotimaan asiakastyön lisäksi tehtävään voi kuulua satunnaista työskentelyä myös ulkomailla, esimerkiksi Keski- ja Etelä-Aasiassa. Asiakaskäyntien ulkopuolella voit työskennellä joustavasti etänä tai Helsingin Pasilan toimistolla.

**Mitä me etsimme?**

Etsimme henkilöä, joka viihtyy asiakasrajapinnassa ja nauttii itsenäisestä työskentelystä. Sinulla on vähintään muutaman vuoden työkokemus asiakaslähtöisistä ja vastuullisista tehtävistä. Taustasi voi olla esimerkiksi ravintola-alalta tai muulta palvelualalta, kenttämyynnistä tai vastaavista asiakasrajapinnassa olevista tehtävistä. Aiempi kokemus erityisesti pikaruoka- tai ravintolaympäristöstä auttaa tehtävässä onnistumisessa, sillä tällöin ymmärrät asiakkaiden toimintaympäristöä ja arjen vaatimuksia. Arvostamme myös myynnillistä ajattelutapaa, kykyä rakentaa luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita sekä halua ottaa vastuuta omasta alueestasi.

Toivomme, että sinulla on käytännönläheinen ote tekemiseen ja valmius osallistua myös laitteiden käyttöönottoihin, asennuksiin ja huoltoihin. Sinun ei tarvitse olla tekninen asiantuntija, mutta käytännönläheinen ote, näppäryys työkalujen kanssa ja halu oppia uutta auttavat sinua menestymään tehtävässä.

Tehtävä vaatii matkustamista, joten voimassa oleva ajokortti ja oma auto ovat välttämättömiä. Toivomme hakijan olevan Etelä-Suomen alueelta, mutta sijainnista voidaan keskustella oikean hakijan kohdalla. Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä hyvää englannin kielen taitoa. Venäjän kielen osaaminen vähintään perustasolla on eduksi.

Työssä onnistumista tukevat oma-aloitteinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen työote sekä kyky tehdä päätöksiä itsenäisesti. Olet helposti lähestyttävä, luotettava ja yhteistyökykyinen persoona, joka rakentaa pitkäjänteisiä suhteita asiakkaiden kanssa.

**Miksi meille?**

Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen tehtävän kansainvälisessä ja vakaassa markkinajohtajayrityksessä, jonka tuotteita ja palveluita käytetään päivittäin tuhansissa ravintoloissa ympäri maailmaa. Saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen, tukea kokeneilta kollegoilta sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi kansainvälisessä ympäristössä. Toimit osana pohjoismaista tiimiä, jossa osaamista jaetaan aktiivisesti. Työ tarjoaa paljon vapautta ja vastuuta, sillä suunnittelet pitkälti itse omat työpäiväsi ja aikataulusi.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Mikäli mielenkiintosi heräsi, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme lisää. Laitathan hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin 30.9.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja valinta tehdään heti oikean henkilön löydyttyä.

Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytointikonsultti Nea Repo, **nea.repo@biisoni.fi.**

- tried the new build tool the weekend it came out.
- replaced a team's creaking toolchain with something modern, and nobody wanted to go back.
- has been told no about a rewrite more than once.
- moved into a lead, architect or managerial role years ago and never stopped writing code or tinkering with the pipelines.
- has rolled a new way of working out across several teams, and knows the hard part was never the tooling.

If a couple of these sound like you, keep reading. Whether you are a senior engineer ready to take your first step into leading and owning change beyond your own team, or a leader who has done this before and still wants to get your hands dirty, this role is built for you.

What you will own

- You define what modern software engineering means at Bittium: the standard every team builds against, and you keep raising it as the industry moves.
- You set our group-wide engineering workflow: version control strategy, branching, code review and CI/CD, from commit to release, with room for what each product and team needs and built for agentic-first development.
- You decide the quality bar a release has to clear: what we require from test automation, documentation and review before software ships.
- You author an engineering handbook with our senior engineers: a practical guide to how we build software, clear enough that any team can pick it up and use it.
- You help shape how we measure engineering health.

Product teams choose the right technology for their product. You are the engineers' engineer: you define, and help build, the engineering infrastructure and ways of working they stand on: pipelines, quality gates, test and documentation tooling, ready to use and maintained like products. Adoption is supported, not dumped on the teams. The work does not end with the first rollout. The foundation keeps evolving, and you keep pushing it forward.

Your first six months

- Help write the first version of our engineering handbook: a practical guide to how we build software, in one place.
- Set the group's ways of working, starting with source control and CI/CD, with the first teams already building on it.
- Get the first shared pipeline, quality gates and documentation tooling live with real teams. Working, not a slide deck.
- Put the first release quality gates into production use.

Where we are headed

Our goal is simple: well-tested, well-documented software, built on a shared, modern development platform. Software development is shifting toward agentic workflows, and we want our codebases ready for that: modular, containerized and verifiable, so an agent can check one out, build it, run the tests and trust the result. You define what that readiness means in practice, together with our Head of AI. We are also investing heavily in hardware-in-the-loop test automation against real devices, and your standards set the bar there too.

What we ask

- A software engineering background strong enough to hold your own with our senior engineers.
- A track record of changing how teams work, whether as the engineer who pushed for better Git workflows and modern tooling and made it stick, or as the lead who ran that change across an organisation.
- Strong opinions and dirty hands. You prototype, build and fix things yourself, and you lead the change at the same time: you own the direction, carry it through and answer for the outcome.
- You know modern DevOps and the engineering platform behind it well: version control, CI/CD, test automation, developer documentation.
- Agentic software development has clicked for you. You work with coding agents daily, you see where this goes as agents take on whole tasks with less and less supervision, and you have opinions about what that demands from codebases, tests, environments and documentation.
- You can work across very different stacks. Ours include, among other things, C/C++, Python, TypeScript/Node.js, web frontends, embedded Linux and FPGA.
- Fluent Finnish and good English.
- Due to the nature of Bittiums business and our customers expectations, you are a Finnish citizen and able to pass security clearance conducted by the Finnish Security Intelligence Service (SUPO).

We do not count years of experience. Skill, will and passion decide.

What we offer

- Group-wide authority over engineering standards.
- Deep technology with real stakes, from military radios in national defence to ECG monitors in hospitals.
- Room to stay hands-on. Prototype, experiment, pick the best tools. IT supports the infrastructure.
- Hybrid work in Oulu, our headquarters software site, or Espoo. Flexible inside Finland. Competitive pay.

Interested?

Send us your application as soon as possible. We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period.

About Bittium

Bittium specializes in the development of reliable, secure communications and connectivity solutions leveraging its 40-year legacy of expertise in advanced radio communication technologies. Bittium provides innovative products and services, customized solutions based on its product platforms and R&D services. Complementing its communications and connectivity solutions, Bittium offers proven information security solutions for mobile devices and portable computers. Bittium also provides healthcare technology products and services for biosignal measuring in the areas of cardiology and neurology. Net sales in 2025 were EUR 119.3 million and operating result was EUR 19.4 million. Bittium is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki

What you'll do

  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through product demos, negotiation, and close.

  • Build your own pipeline through cold outreach, referrals, industry events, field visits, and existing networks.

  • Run compelling demos of Choco’s products, including our AI-powered solutions, connecting what we build directly to the problems our customers need to solve.

  • Manage diverse sales cycles, from agile, family-run food suppliers to complex, multi-stakeholder organizations. You must adeptly pivot your strategy, balancing relationship-building with high-touch, consultative selling to drive consensus and close deals across varying business structures.

  • Help improve how we sell by sharing what you learn from customers, testing new approaches, and contributing to the team’s playbook.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to ensure a seamless transition for new clients and to provide feedback on market needs for scaling SMB and Mid Market relationships.

What you bring

  • 3+ years of experience in software sales, ideally progressing from SDR/BDR into an Account Executive role, with hands-on experience owning and closing deals.

  • A track record of consistently overachieving against sales quotas and targets.

  • Consistent achievement of self-sourced pipeline generation and outbound activity targets.

  • Experience managing a full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close.

  • A strong track record of outbound prospecting and creating your own pipeline.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced sales environment, managing multiple opportunities and maintaining momentum across your pipeline.

  • Fluency in French and English (C1+)

  • Proven ability to manage mid-market sales cycles with a focus on value-based selling and long-term partnership growth.
