jobs.title: Security Engineer, Corporate Security
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US:

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

 

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE:

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work. Protecting that trust starts with protecting the people who build Notion: our employees, their laptops, their identities, and the SaaS apps they rely on every day.



We are looking for a hands-on Corporate Security Engineer to own and improve the technical controls that keep our workforce and corporate environment safe. This is a security engineering role focused on building scalable controls and automation across identity, endpoints, SaaS, and workforce infrastructure, not a traditional IT support or corporate engineering role.



You'll own and evolve core security controls, design systems and automation that scale with the company, and help make security both stronger and easier to use. You'll partner closely with IT, Infrastructure, GRC, and Detection & Response to improve the security foundations that employees rely on every day.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Harden our identity and access management stack, including Okta and Google Workspace, with phishing-resistant MFA, strong SSO and SCIM lifecycles, and least-privilege access across SaaS.

 - Run our endpoint security program across a macOS-first fleet, including MDM, EDR, and configuration baselines, with working coverage for Windows and ChromeOS.

 - Secure AI tool usage at the endpoint, including governance of large language models, AI agents, and model context protocol (MCP) integrations; detect and prevent unauthorized or risky AI service access and data exfiltration through AI-enabled tools.

 - Reduce SaaS risk at scale through SSPM tooling and custom automation, including detection of risky OAuth grants, excessive permissions, shadow IT, and configuration drift.

 - Write code (Python, Terraform) to automate access reviews, onboarding and offboarding, configuration drift detection, and audit evidence collection.

 - Partner with Detection & Response to ensure corporate systems produce the telemetry needed to detect identity, endpoint, and SaaS abuse.

 - Support SOC 2, ISO 27001, and customer audits as a byproduct of good engineering, not a separate workstream.

 - Partner with Detection & Response on investigation and response for corporate security incidents, including phishing, account compromise, lost devices, and BEC.

 


SKILLS YOU NEED TO BRING:

 - Have 5+ years of hands-on experience in corporate security, enterprise security, or IT security engineering at a cloud-native company.

 - Have working knowledge of a major identity provider (Okta, Entra, or Google Workspace) and the underlying protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM).

 - Have hands-on experience operating endpoint management and detection tooling across macOS and enterprise environments.

 - Write production-quality scripts and automation in Python or Bash, and have shipped Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for security configuration.

 - Are familiar with SaaS security risks (OAuth governance, audit logging, SSPM) and the realities of integrating a long tail of vendors.

 - Have working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) at the security configuration level.

 - Communicate clearly in writing and work effectively across IT, Engineering, Legal, People, and GRC.



NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience at a fast-growing tech or AI company where the security program had to outpace headcount.

 - A background in IT engineering, SRE, or production engineering that transitioned into security engineering.

 - Experience building internal security tooling or workflows that improved employee or developer experience.

 - Contributions to the security community through open-source tools, blog posts, or conference talks.

 

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

 

Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. VODOINSTALATER/KA
- izvodi sve radove na održavanju vodovodnih instalacija,

- održava i redovno obavlja remonte svih strojeva vezanih za vodovod,
- otklanja manje kvarove koji nisu u domeni njegove struke,
- odgovoran je za stručno i sigurno izvođenje radova, racionalno trošenje materijala te ispravno i sigurno rukovanjem alatom,
- obavještava odgovornog rukovoditelja o svim uočenim kvarovima i šteti na instalacijama, opremi i objektima, te predlaže način i vrijeme otklanjanja većih kvarova,  
- sudjeluje u povjerenstvu za utvrđivanje štete,
- predlaže provođenje mjera za postizanje tehničke ispravnosti i zaštite u području vezanom za vodovodne instalacije i kanalizacije,
- vodi evidenciju utroška materijala i vodi dnevnik rada,
- obavlja i ostale poslove po nalogu nadređenog, a koji po naravi odgovaraju vrsti poslova navedenog radnog mjesta

Sukladno Kolektivnom ugovoru Sveučilišta u Zagrebu-Studentskog centra u Zagrebu, za navedeno radno mjesto ugovara se probni rad u trajanju od dva (2) mjeseca.
Prijavu na natječaj mogu podnijeti osobe oba spola sukladno Zakonu o ravnopravnosti spolova.

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu, kandidati su dužni priložiti:
- životopis
- dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja i stručnom znanju (diploma, svjedodžba, uvjerenje),
- elektronički zapis o radnopravnom statusu, odnosno e-radna knjižica
- preslika vozačke dozvole B kategorije.
Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenom presliku, a prije izbora kandidata predočit će se izvornik.

Rok za podnošenje prijava je od dana objave Oglasa do popune radnog mjesta.
Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju pod jednakim uvjetima po posebnim propisima, dužni su se u prijavi pozvati na to pravo, uz obavezno podnošenje dokaza iz kojih je vidljivo navedeno pravo.
Nepotpune i nepravodobno podnesene prijave neće biti razmatrane. Osobe koje podnesu nepotpune i/ili nepravovremene prijave na natječaj ne smatraju se kandidatima prijavljenim na oglas.
Prijavom na ovaj Oglas smatra se da je kandidat dao svoju privolu za obradu i objavu osobnih podataka vezano za realizaciju ovog Oglasa.
Poslodavac zadržava pravo poništiti natječaj ili ne prihvatiti niti jednu ponudu za zaposlenje.
Potpisane prijave i prateća dokumentacija, naslovljene na Služba za opće, pravne i kadrovske poslove, predaju se u Pisarnici u sjedištu SC-a ili poštom na adresu:

jobs.title: Bartender
jobs.description:
We are looking for an adult employee for a DJ or bartender position at a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town.

Work tasks: The role includes providing professional, friendly, and efficient service to customers in the karaoke bar and ensuring that the venue’s daily operations run smoothly. Depending on the shift and operational needs, the employee’s duties may include both bar work and tasks related to DJ and karaoke services.
Bartender duties include taking customer orders, preparing and serving alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, using the cash register system, accepting payments, and ensuring accurate transactions. The employee is responsible for keeping the bar area clean, organized, and ready for service, replenishing drink supplies and work materials when necessary, and maintaining a tidy workstation throughout the shift. When needed, the employee also helps with clearing tables, collecting glasses, serving customers in the seating area, and carrying out other daily tasks. DJ duties include operating the karaoke and music software, taking song requests from customers and managing the performance queue, selecting suitable background music, and ensuring that the karaoke evening runs smoothly. The employee uses the necessary sound and karaoke equipment, microphones, and computer programs, and assists customers in finding suitable songs when needed. The DJ is also responsible for creating a pleasant, lively, and positive atmosphere in the bar and communicating with customers in a polite and professional manner. The job also includes answering customer questions, introducing the bar’s services and offers, and assisting customers when needed. We expect the employee to be willing to cooperate with other team members and, when necessary, support colleagues with tasks in other areas in order to ensure fast and high-quality service.

We offer: We offer the opportunity to work in a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town in an active and international working environment. The job is well suited to someone who enjoys communication, music, entertainment, and a varied working day.
We offer a flexible work schedule and the opportunity to work mainly in the evenings and on weekends. Previous work experience is not required, as all necessary training is provided on site. We will teach you how to use the cash register system, prepare and serve drinks, work with karaoke and music programs, and use the necessary sound and bar equipment. The employee will receive support from experienced colleagues in their daily work and will have the opportunity to develop customer service, sales, bartending, and communication skills. For a suitable and motivated employee, we offer the opportunity to take on more responsibility over time and develop within the company. Our working environment is youthful, friendly, and informal. The work is not monotonous — every evening brings different customers, songs, and situations. We value good teamwork, a positive attitude, reliability, and a willingness to learn. We offer: • on-site training and guidance; • a flexible work schedule; • an international and communication-focused working environment; • the opportunity to gain practical experience in bartending, customer service, and DJ/karaoke work; • a supportive and friendly team; • opportunities for long-term cooperation and development within the company; • internal employee discounts and benefits according to agreement.

Other requirements: The work takes place mainly in the evenings and at night, as well as on weekends, so the employee must be prepared to work according to a flexible schedule. The role requires good communication skills, friendliness, responsibility, accuracy, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Previous work experience as a bartender, DJ, or service employee is not required. All necessary working methods, including use of the cash register system, bar work, karaoke software, and equipment, will be taught on site. The employee will receive the necessary guidance and training when starting work and will be supported by experienced colleagues during the first working days. We are primarily looking for a motivated, reliable, and willing-to-learn person who wants to work in the entertainment and service industry and is comfortable communicating actively with a wide range of customers.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts: 10-20 hours/week
; work includes night shifts

jobs.title: Responsable cellule « Open Banking » (F/H) h/f
jobs.description:
Notre activitéRejoignez un groupe de plus de 100 000 collaborateurs au cœur du développement de nos territoires et résolument tourné vers l'international ! En intégrant BPCE, vous intégrez une entreprise engagée au service du développement et de la coordination de toutes les enseignes du Groupe BPCE (Banque Populaire, Caisse d'Epargne, Crédit Coopératif, Casden, Natixis, Oney, Banque Palatine) afin de porter les ambitions du projet stratégique « Vision 2030 ». BPCE a créé le pôle Digital & Payments en 2021 pour réunir l'ensemble des métiers du digital avec l'ensemble des métiers des paiements du groupe. BPCE Digital & Payments aujourd'hui rassemble les services de paiement et du financement du commerce, le digital, l'IA et la data, l'open banking et l'innovation. Grâce aux 3200 collaborateurs travaillant au sein de marques renommées telles que Oney, BPCE Payment Services, Payplug et Xpollens, le pôle exerce une influence significative sur le marché français et européen. Il permet au groupe et à ses réseaux bancaires de s'appuyer sur des services de banque en ligne et des services de paiement aux meilleurs standards du marché. Pour plus d'informations n'hésitez pas à parcourir notre site : https://www.digital-payments.groupebpce.com/ Vos missions au sein de l'équipeLa direction Innovation & Open Banking du groupe BPCE a pour principales missions de piloter une veille marketing stratégique, d'impulser des transformations business en rupture et de gérer les relations avec les écosystèmes de partenaires innovants.

Les établissements du groupe BPCE sont soumis comme tous les teneurs de comptes aux exigences imposées par la Directive sur les Services de Paiement (DSP2) notamment en matière d'Open Banking. Ils mettent déjà à disposition des tiers régulés (Third Party Providers - TPPs) des interfaces API afin de fournir les services de paiement régulés : (1) d'Information sur les Comptes (AISP), d'Initiation de Paiement (PISP) et de Disponibilité des fonds (CBPII).

Depuis plusieurs années on constate une forte augmentation de l'usage de ce solutions Open Banking par les TPPs et les clients finaux qui se traduit également par une augmentation des sollicitations des tiers régulés (assistance, demandes, incidents, etc.).

A l'avenir, les exigences DSP2 sont amenées à se renforcer avec la publication à venir de la Réglementation sur les Services de Paiement (RSP) et au-delà du volet réglementaire le groupe BPCE s'est inscrit dans une démarche Open Finance business.
Compte tenu de ces enjeux réglementaires, business et de satisfaction client, le groupe BPCE fait évoluer son « dispositif Open » et souhaite renforcer la gestion de la relation entre les établissements du groupe et les TPPs ainsi que les activités transverses de coordination et de reportings.

Au sein de l'équipe « Innovation Produit et Ecosystèmes », le/la responsable de la Cellule « Open Banking » est le garant de la relation entre BPCE et les partenaires qui se connectent aux données et services du groupe BPCE aussi bien dans le cadre réglementaire (Directive sur les Services de Paiement 2 (DSP2), Règlement sur les services de paiement - RSP), que dans le cadre de relations d'affaires. Dans ce cadre, les principales missions du responsable de la Cellule Open Banking seront de :

- Piloter la relation avec nos partenaires tiers régulés (Third Party Providers - TPP) dans le cadre de la Directive sur les Services de Paiement 2 (DSP2)
- Coordonner les actions de support en lien avec les directions informatiques et digitales du groupe
- Coordonner l'instruction des incidents et demandes spécifiques et critiques
- Réaliser le reporting interne sur l'activité Open Banking
- Participer à l'évolution des dispositifs pour garantir une qualité de service au standard d marché
- Participer à la coordination des projets d'évolution sur le périmètre Open Banking
- Gérer les évolutions du portail API STORE du groupe BPCE transverse aux différentes lignes métiers du groupe et à destination des partenaires ;
- Participer aux activités de veille et d'écoute des besoins du marché en matière de finance embarquée
- Participer aux activités commerciales relatives aux produits API BusinessVos atouts pour réussirCompétences attendues :

- Connaissance des réglementations sur les services bancaires et les services de paiement notamment sur l'Open Banking (Règlement IP, DSP2, RSP, etc.)
- Connaissance des écosystèmes de startup, fintechs
- Capacité à animer des équipes pluridisciplinaires (produit, tech, business) de façon transverse
- Capacité à conduire et accompagner fonctionnellement des équipes dans le changement
- Esprit d'équipe
- Aisance relationnelle
- Capacité de synthèse et vulgarisation
- Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (lu, écrit, parlé) indispensable pour interagir avec les partenaires internationaux.

Formation et Expérience :

- Formation supérieure (Bac+5)
- Expérience de 3 à 5 ans minimum dans le secteur bancaire, une Fintech, un cabinet de conseil ou u...

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Lietoon
jobs.description:
**Lähihoitaja Lietoon Kreivinkotoon – kädet saveen, liikkeelle yhdessä ja musiikki soimaan!**

**Etsimme lähihoitajaa, joka ei pelkää laittaa itseään likoon – ja välillä laittaa myös musiikin soimaan.**

Kuulostaako siltä, että voisit viihtyä meidän porukassamme?

Kreivinkoto Lieto on ikäihmisten yhteisöllinen koti, jossa **ei vain hoideta, vaan eletään hyvää arkea yhdessä**. Meillä päivä voi sisältää lääkehoitoa ja hoitotyötä, mutta yhtä hyvin myös leivontaa, askartelua, ulkoilua, musiikkia, naurua ja kaikenlaista yhdessä tekemistä.

Etsimme nyt joukkoomme **lähihoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä työtä ihmisten kanssa – ei vain heidän puolestaan.

**Mitä työ Kreivinkodossa on?**

Olet tärkeä osa asukkaidemme jokapäiväistä elämää. Tuet heidän toimintakykyään, hyvinvointiaan ja itsenäisyyttään sekä olet mukana luomassa mielekästä arkea.

Työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- kokonaisvaltaista hoitoa ja huolenpitoa

- lääkehoitoa

- asukkaiden ohjaamista ja toimintakyvyn tukemista

- päivätoiminnan ja yhteisen tekemisen toteuttamista

- ulkoilua, virikkeitä ja arjen pieniä iloja

- kohtaamisia asukkaiden ja heidän läheistensä kanssa

- yhteistyötä muiden ammattilaisten kanssa.


**Ja kyllä – välillä tärkein työtehtävä voi olla istua hetkeksi alas, kuunnella ja olla läsnä.**

**Millainen tyyppi meille sopii?**

Toivomme, että olet:

- koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja

- lämmin ja helposti lähestyttävä

- oma-aloitteinen ja vastuuntuntoinen

- hyvä tyyppi tiimipelaajaksi

- kiinnostunut ikäihmisten hyvinvoinnista ja hyvästä arjesta

- valmis tarttumaan tekemiseen ja kokeilemaan uutta.


Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea valmiiksi. **Asenne ratkaisee.**

Jos tuot mukanasi ripauksen huumoria, hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja halun tehdä työsi sydämellä, saatat olla juuri se henkilö, jota etsimme.

**Miksi Kreivinkoto?**

Koska meillä saat olla **lähihoitaja, ihminen ja työkaveri**.

Meillä arvostetaan toisiamme ja tehdään töitä yhdessä. Saat mahdollisuuden käyttää omaa osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja olla mukana kehittämässä asukkaidemme arkea.

Meille yhteisöllisyys tarkoittaa sitä, että **asukkaat ja työntekijät tekevät arkea yhdessä**.

Ja ehkä juuri siksi täällä ei ole kahta samanlaista työpäivää.

Sairaanhoitaja uuteen Keisarinnaan!
jobs.description:
**Sairaanhoitaja, haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa jotain uutta?**

**Nyt on mahdollisuus päästä mukaan heti alusta asti.**

Keisarinnan uusi palvelukoti avaa ovensa, ja etsimme joukkoomme **sairaanhoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä, mutta myös vaikuttaa siihen, millainen työpaikka ja arki meillä rakentuu.

Keisarinnassa tuotetaan **yhteisöllistä asumispalvelua ja ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista ikäihmisille**. Me emme halua vain avata uutta yksikköä – haluamme rakentaa paikan, jossa on hyvä asua, hyvä tehdä töitä ja hyvä tulla kohdatuksi.

**Miksi juuri Keisarinna?**

Koska tässä työssä et astu valmiiseen muottiin.

Uuden yksikön käynnistyessä pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan siihen, **miten meillä tehdään asioita**. Saat tuoda pöytään omat ideasi, osaamisesi ja persoonasi.

Me haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa ei tarvitse miettiä:

_"Näin tämä on aina tehty."_

Vaan kysytään:

**"Voisiko tämän tehdä vielä paremmin?"**

Sairaanhoitajana olet tärkeässä roolissa sekä asukkaiden kokonaisvaltaisen hoidon että turvallisen arjen rakentamisessa. Päivissä on vaihtelua, vastuuta, kohtaamisia ja ennen kaikkea mahdollisuuksia tehdä työ omalla ammattitaidollasi näkyväksi.

**Tässä työssä pääset**

- olemaan mukana käynnistämässä täysin uutta palvelukotia

- rakentamaan kanssamme hyvää työyhteisöä alusta asti

- hyödyntämään ja kehittämään omaa sairaanhoitajan osaamistasi

- kohtaamaan ikäihmiset yksilöinä – ei vain asiakkaina

- vaikuttamaan arjen toimintatapoihin ja niiden kehittämiseen

- tekemään työtä, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä.


**Meille hyvä hoitotyö on muutakin kuin suorittamista**

Keisarinnassa asukkaiden elämä ei pysähdy siihen, että he muuttavat palvelukotiin.

Haluamme mahdollistaa **oman näköistä elämää, turvallisuutta, yhteisöllisyyttä ja hyviä hetkiä**. Siksi tarvitsemme hoitajia, joille ihminen tulee ennen rutiinia.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis paketti.

**Riittää, että olet ammattitaitoinen, utelias, vastuullinen ja valmis tekemään yhdessä.**

Arvostamme myös huumoria, hyvää energiaa ja sitä, että uskallat sanoa ääneen omat ajatuksesi.

**Tule tekemään tästä meidän näköisemme Keisarinna.**

Jos kaipaat työltäsi enemmän kuin valmista työvuorolistaa ja tuttua kaavaa, **Keisarinna saattaa olla juuri sinua varten.**

Täällä pääset näkemään oman kädenjälkesi.

**Uusi paikka. Uusi tiimi. Uudet mahdollisuudet.**

Ja ehkä juuri sinä olet yksi niistä ihmisistä, joiden ansiosta Keisarinnasta tulee paikka, jonne on maanantainakin kiva tulla töihin.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos olet **sairaanhoitaja** ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa uutta palvelukotia alusta asti, **lähetä meille hakemuksesi!**

Kerro meille lyhyesti, kuka olet, mitä osaat ja ennen kaikkea:

**Mitä sinä haluaisit tuoda Keisarinnaan?**

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan Keisarinnaa. Meillä on paikka sinulle.**

Cleaning Supervisor – Full-Time Position in Copenhagen

We are looking for a responsible, well-organised and motivated Cleaning Supervisor to join our team in Copenhagen.

This is a hands-on position combining team supervision, customer communication, quality control and daily cleaning operations. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes responsibility and can effectively organise both their own work and the work of others.

Your responsibilities

  • Preparing and managing staff schedules and organising shift coverage

  • Maintaining regular contact with employees and coordinating their daily work

  • Communicating with clients and responding to their requests and needs

  • Training, onboarding and supporting new employees

  • Organising training and providing ongoing guidance to the cleaning team

  • Performing regular quality checks and ensuring that our cleaning standards are maintained

  • Ordering cleaning products, equipment and other necessary supplies

  • Cleaning at client locations when required

  • Handling day-to-day operational issues and finding practical solutions

  • Supporting and motivating employees in their daily work

  • Ensuring good communication between employees, management and clients

  • Supporting the company in acquiring and onboarding new clients

We are looking for someone who:

  • Speaks English confidently

  • Is willing and motivated to learn Danish

  • Has strong organisational and communication skills

  • Is comfortable communicating with both employees and clients

  • Is responsible, reliable and able to work independently

  • Can make decisions and solve problems in a busy working environment

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and willing to work in shifts

  • Is available to work every second weekend

  • Is willing to take part in cleaning duties when necessary

  • Living in Denmark is an advantage, but not a requirement. However, you must be willing and able to relocate to Copenhagen for the position

  • Has, or is able to obtain, the legal right to work in Denmark

  • Previous experience in cleaning, supervision, team coordination or a similar position is an advantage

What we offer

We offer a responsible and varied position in a stable and established cleaning company in Copenhagen, where you will play an important role in our daily operations and future development.

Salary: DKK 37,500 gross per month
Working hours: 38 hours per week
Schedule: Shift work, including every second weekend
Location: Copenhagen, Denmark
Employment: Full-time

The work will primarily take place at different client locations across Copenhagen, so flexibility and the ability to organise your working day are important.

We are looking for someone who is not afraid to take responsibility, enjoys working with people and is committed to maintaining high standards of cleaning and customer service.

How to apply

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT REPLIT

Replit is building the world's most ubiquitous AI coding agent. Replit Agent can be used by anybody to bring their ideas to life. Whether it's an app for yourself, the next great startup idea, or a tool to make you more productive at work, Replit Agent can help build it. Replit is also the leader in secure vibe coding. We protect apps, give users features to manage security risks, and help them vibe code more safely.





ABOUT THE ROLE:

Replit is changing how people and companies turn ideas into software. Reaching those customers requires engineering that connects acquisition to the product experience and gives teams trustworthy evidence about what works.


This role goes beyond operating conventional marketing technology. You will rethink growth systems for a world where agents can observe performance, diagnose problems, take action, and learn from the result.


As the founding engineer for Growth Enablement, you will set the technical direction for this area. You will build agentic systems alongside shared foundations for attribution, audiences, lifecycle engagement, referrals, and promotions. The work spans web, mobile, billing, and data.


You will work directly with marketing, sales, and partnerships to find the highest-leverage problems and ship the first solutions. Successful projects will become platforms that help these teams move faster and give Replit a clearer view of what drives durable growth.





YOU WILL:

 - Design agentic growth systems that monitor performance, diagnose failures, run approved experiments, and improve from the results.

 - Explore AI-native approaches to answer engine optimization, campaign operations, audience discovery, and measurement.

 - Build acquisition measurement across web and mobile, including click-ID capture, identity matching, server-side conversion APIs, and warehouse attribution.

 - Create a shared standard for deep links and context transfer across web, iOS, Android, and app-store handoffs.

 - Build reusable systems for promotions, referrals, campaign landing pages, fraud controls, attribution, and holdout measurement.

 - Build audience pipelines that sync warehouse-defined cohorts and exclusions to each delivery channel.

 - Work directly with marketing, sales, and partnerships to turn business needs into technical systems.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend expertise in TypeScript/Node, Python, Go, or a similar language.

 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with a data warehouse and event instrumentation.

 - Hands-on experience with attribution, marketing technology, deep linking, payment webhooks, or high-scale event pipelines.

 - A record of working with non-engineering partners to turn ambiguous business needs into shipped systems.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Built growth or martech infrastructure at a consumer or PLG company, such as referral systems, promotion platforms, lifecycle tooling, or CDPs.

 - Built agents that act on business data with clear evaluations, permissions, and human controls.

 - Experience with experimentation platforms such as Statsig and lifecycle tools such as Iterable.

 - Familiarity with privacy and consent handling in marketing data pipelines.




BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience shipping mobile attribution with OneLink, Universal Links, App Links, or SKAN.

 - Experience carrying attribution through payment systems such as Stripe or Razorpay.

 - Regular use of AI agents to plan, implement, test, or review your work.




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Extreme ownership: identify important work, carry it through launch, and resolve blockers quickly.

 - Data-driven decisions: define hypotheses and success criteria before launch, then change direction when the evidence calls for it.

 - No borders: solve the highest-impact problem, whether it requires a PRD, a warehouse query, code, or campaign setup.

 - Speed through reversibility: ship the smallest step that produces useful signal, and slow down for decisions that are hard to reverse.

 - Strong communication: make technical constraints and business requirements clear to engineers and go-to-market partners.

Vi ser fram emot att starta en dialog med dig!

OM OSS

Vårdbemanning Sverige startade sin verksamhet 2014 och är idag ett av Sveriges största bemanningsföretag inom hälso- och sjukvård. Sedan 2019 har vi utsetts till ett av landets Gasellföretag av Dagens Industri, och utmärker oss som ett av landets snabbast växande företag. Vi erbjuder bemannings- och rekryteringslösningar till Sveriges regioner, privata vårdgivare och kommuner.

Så fungerar det

Det första steget till att arbeta via oss i Danmark är att vi startar en profil på dig i vårt verksamhetssystem. Vi börjar processen med ett initialt telefonsamtal där vi får veta mer om dig, din bakgrund och dina erfarenheter, samtidigt som du får svar på alla dina frågor om oss och om hur allt fungerar. För att kunna starta din profil och gå vidare behöver vi också få in ett antal handlingar från dig, såsom ditt CV och dina referenser.

Under våra samtal går vi även igenom vilket/vilka ställen du vill eller kan tänka dig jobba på, vilket geografiskt område som passar dig bäst samt ramarna för lönepaketen. När vi har hittat rätt matchning och samlat in alla uppgifter, sammanställer vi detta till en presentation för Nordic Medicare.

När presentationen är klar lämnar vi över till Nordic Medicare som då tar vid för den fortsatta processen. De kommer att hålla en uppföljande intervju med dig och sköta den konkreta dialogen kring själva anställningen. Det är också direkt med Nordic Medicare som du går igenom alla slutgiltiga arbetsrättsliga villkor, avtalsspecifika bestämmelser, juridik och eventuella frågor kring forskarskatteordningen. På så sätt får du en samlad, trygg och tydlig dialog om alla kontraktets detaljer direkt med din kommande arbetsgivare.

När du är ute och arbetar har du kontinuerlig dialog med din närmsta kontaktperson hos oss, som vägleder och stöttar dig genom uppdraget från början till slut. Vi sätter stort värde på att vara tillgänglig för dig. Du kan alltid nå oss på telefon eller mejl när du behöver.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will contribute to the development, procurement, assembly, testing and installation of innovative mechanical structures for the High Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL) of the Compact Muon Solenoid experiment, working with advanced materials and challenging structural and thermal requirements.

You will help oversee the surface assembly and testing of the 250-tonne detector, including its CO? cooling, dry gas, cabling and fibre services, as well as its installation and commissioning 100 metres underground. Working in a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will apply your expertise in structural and thermal calculations, finite element analysis and 3D CAD.

Your responsibilities:
- Coordinate a team of technicians in assembling and testing the steel structures of HGCAL, comprising more than 200 tonnes of steel plates per endcap.
- Provide engineering support for all activities at CERN related to the large-scale active detector components, known as "cassettes" (30-60-degree segments of circular structures with diameters of up to 5 m). This will include the cold testing of "electromagnetic cassettes" and their subsequent stacking with lead plates to form the complete electromagnetic endcaps.
- Integrate the hadronic cassettes into the steel structures and provide support for their testing.
- Integrate the electromagnetic (30 tonnes) and hadronic (200 tonnes) sections, including their cabling and piping, and support subsequent large-scale testing on the surface.
- Help oversee the lowering of the HGCAL endcaps into the CMS cavern and their connection to CMS, including the connection and testing of services.

Your profile:
- Strong track record in planning and coordinating the handling, assembling and testing of large mechanical structures.
- Demonstrated experience in performing thermal and structural calculations of complex mechanical structures using finite element analysis.
- Demonstrated experience in developing mechanical assemblies using 3D CAD.
- Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
- Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment: Knowledge of usual manufacturing methods (milling, turning, etc.), assembly methods (bolted, welding, etc.).
- Knowledge and application of mechanical measurement techniques: including quality control methods.
- Assembly and integration of detectors: capability to develop and validate manufacturing and installation methods.
- Production of 2D drawings and 3D models: proficiency in Catia V5 or equivalent 3D modelling software, good knowledge of drawing annotations.
- Knowledge and application of numerical modelling applied to mechanics.
- Proficiency in ANSYS would be a strong asset.
- Basic understanding of process engineering systems (i.e. cooling plants) would be an asset.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Adopts a pragmatic approach; understands the value of adopting generic rather than gold -plated' technical solutions.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Delivers presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusts style and content to the audience; responds calmly and confidently to questions.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 48
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 200090 - Mechanical Engineer
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

For more information about the position and application process, please visit: https://careers.cern/jobs/ep-cms-ec-2026-190-ld/

jobs.title: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

-Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
-Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
-General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.

We expect you to

-Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
-Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
-Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
-Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
-Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
-Not be afraid of getting dirty
-Understand and speak English
-Be an EU citizen

Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
-Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
-Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
-Start date: as soon as possible
-Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
-Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max

Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping.



As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.

As our new Account Manager Ocean Division, you will play a pivotal role in driving the company's growth by proactively identifying and pursuing new business opportunities.     Work proactively and in a structured manner within and across teams to optimize sales efficiency.
    Use CRM and other tools consistently and effectively to support the sales process and decision-making.



This position is based in one of our Nordic Sites located in Sandvika, Espoo, Søborg, Aalborg or Lund.



Who You Are

You are a proactive and driven sales professional with strong communication skills and a passion for building customer relationships. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, are comfortable using digital tools, and enjoy working both independently and as part of a team. You are structured, goal-oriented, and eager to deliver value to customers while growing your career in a global company.



What You Know
To succeed in this role, we imagine you have:

    Proficiency in commercial contract management and understanding.
    Experience in field sales, account management, or a similar customer-facing role, with a proven track record of successful face-to-face customer engagement.
    High digital competence including frequent usage of CRM systems and digital communication tools.
    You understand technical products and can translate customer needs into value-based solutions.
    Excellent interpersonal skills, comfortable communicating with individuals and teams, including at senior levels.
    Strong communication skills in English and a Scandinavian language.
    You know how to work collaboratively across teams to achieve sales goals.

What We Offer

You'll be part of a small, informal team where everyone's voice matters. We work hard, but we also make sure there's room for a healthy balance in life. Teamwork is at the heart of everything we do, we support each other, share ideas, and celebrate our successes together. As part of Alfa Laval, you'll also enjoy the benefits of working in a global company, with opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from around the world, learn from diverse perspectives, and grow your career in an international environment.



What's in it for you?

You'll enjoy a challenging and rewarding role in a global, open, and supportive environment. You'll collaborate across functions, gaining broad business insights and building a valuable international network. Your contributions will be recognized, and you'll see the real impact of your work on Alfa Laval's success. As you help shape the future of our industry, you'll also have opportunities for personal and professional growth, developing your skills, expanding your horizons, and advancing your career in a company that values innovation, teamwork, and initiative.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Har du starka kunskaper inom redovisning och ekonomi, och motiveras du av att skapa struktur, kvalitet och insikter i finansiella processer? Trivs du i en roll där du får ansvar för rapportering, controlling och ekonomisk uppföljning? Då kan detta vara rätt möjlighet för dig.

Om rollen

Tjänsten är baserad på vårt nordiska huvudkontor i Albertslund, Danmark. Som Financial Controller får du en viktig roll i den löpande ekonomistyrningen och rapporteringen av våra verksamheter. Ditt huvudsakliga ansvarsområde blir att stötta och följa upp våra svenska och finska bolag samt säkerställa hög kvalitet i den finansiella rapporteringen och ekonomiska uppföljningen.

Du ansvarar för finansiell uppföljning, månads- och årsbokslut samt för att säkerställa noggrannhet och kvalitet i våra redovisningsdata och finansiella rapporter. Du kommer att delta aktivt i budget- och prognosprocesser, analysera ekonomiska resultat och bidra med insikter som stödjer ledningens beslutsfattande.

Du kommer även att arbeta med processförbättringar och interna kontroller för att säkerställa effektiva och robusta finansiella processer. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med både interna och externa intressenter, och du kommer att bidra till att säkerställa efterlevnad av gällande redovisningsprinciper och interna riktlinjer.

Ditt arbete kommer att vara avgörande för att skapa transparens, kvalitet och kontroll i våra finansiella processer.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som inte bara är erfaren, utan även har ett genuint intresse för att skapa struktur och kvalitet i ekonomiska processer. Du har en relevant utbildning inom ekonomi, redovisning eller finans samt erfarenhet från en liknande roll.

Du behärskar engelska och minst ett skandinaviskt språk och har stark analytisk förmåga. Du arbetar strukturerat och noggrant och är bekväm med att hantera stora datamängder och finansiella analyser. Erfarenhet av ERP-system och Excel är meriterande.

Som person är du proaktiv, ansvarstagande och självständig. Du trivs med att samarbeta över organisatoriska gränser, skapar förtroende genom din professionalism och har ett naturligt intresse för att förbättra processer och arbetssätt. Du tar ägarskap för dina uppgifter och levererar resultat med hög kvalitet inom överenskomna tidsramar.

Intresserad?

Vi genomför intervjuer löpande, så skicka in din ansökan och ditt CV redan idag.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Heidrun Thorsteinsdottir på +45 2234 6657.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

jobs.title: Strategic Project Manager
jobs.description:
Drive Strategy. Lead Growth. Make an Impact.

Instabee is changing the way last-mile deliveries work in Europe. We make online shopping faster, smarter, and more convenient. In Finland, we’ve scaled quickly—but we’re just getting started. Now, we need a strategic powerhouse to help shape our expansion, drive high-impact projects, and turn opportunities into growth.

If you’re an analytical problem solver who thrives on tackling complex business challenges, working cross-functionally, and translating strategy into execution, let’s talk.

What You’ll Do 📈 Shape the Strategy – Assess market opportunities, identify challenges, and help define the roadmap for Instabee Finland’s growth.

🔍 Lead High-Impact Projects – Take ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive business performance and scale our operations.

🤝 Work with Leadership – Collaborate closely with the Country Manager and senior team to set targets and implement strategic plans.

📊 Use Data to Drive Decisions – Monitor performance, track key business metrics, and adjust strategies based on insights.

⚡ Remove Roadblocks – Identify challenges, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure our strategic initiatives run smoothly.

🚀 Think Big, Plan for the Future – We’re looking for someone with the ambition and potential to grow into a larger leadership role over time.

Who You Are

✅ A Strategic Thinker with a Commercial Edge – You have experience in strategy, management consulting, investment banking, or business development. Start-up/scale-up experience is a bonus.

✅ A Problem-Solver Who Gets Things Done – You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership, and know how to move projects forward.

✅ A Data-Driven Decision Maker – You use insights, analytics, and performance tracking to sharpen your approach and drive measurable impact.

✅ An Effective Communicator – You can turn complex ideas into clear, actionable plans and collaborate across teams.

✅ Experience Matters Most, but Education Helps – you have probably Master’s degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related field

✅ Fluent in English (Finnish is a bonus) – You can communicate clearly and persuasively in a fast-moving, international environment.

Why Instabee?

🌍 Join a Fast-Growing Company – Be part of a team that’s reshaping e-commerce logistics in Europe.

🚀 Advance Your Career – This role is built for growth, with a path toward broader leadership.

🏢 Work Flexibly – Hybrid setup with a modern Helsinki office centrally located in Kluuvi.

💡 Work with Cutting-Edge Tech – Shape the future of logistics with smart, data-driven solutions.

🎉 A Culture That Values Action – We move fast, make decisions quickly, and focus on what works.

Ready to Make an Impact? We’re looking for someone who’s ready to own projects, drive strategy, and shape the future of Instabee in Finland. If that’s you, apply today.

About Instabee

Instabee was founded in 2022 after combining Budbee and Instabox — two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox and Porterbuddy. Instabee is present in six countries, serving thousands of online merchants, including ASOS, Zalando, Inditex and H&M and is on track to become the most admired European e-commerce enabler.

In Finland, Budbee has been a key player since 2018 — and we’re moving fast.

jobs.title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

jobs.title: Nurse
jobs.description:
Give your career a new dimension

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.

Your tasks:
Your main responsibilities will be the following:
- Provide routine and emergency care
- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software
- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff
- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")
- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations
- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications
- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff
- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register
- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards
- Carry out workstation assessments
- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees
- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentation

Your profile:
- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)
- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".
- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.
- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).
- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.
- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.
- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.
- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.

What we offer:

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/34. This vacancy will remain open until we find the suitable candidate, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) - operates Europe's leading research facility for basic research with neutrons in Grenoble (France). The passion for progress and technology unites us and makes innovation in science and research possible every day. Let's work together to change our society and our world for the better.

www.ill.eu/careers

jobs.title: Palvelupäällikkö
jobs.description:
**Tule meille palvelupäälliköksi Lapin ja Pohjois-Pohjanmaan alueelle!**

Haluatko johtaa omaa palvelualueettasi ja vastata asiakkuuksien, henkilöstön ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä? Meillä työ tehdään vastuullisesti osana luotettavaa tiimiä.

Etsimme tavoitteellista ja kehittämisorientoitunutta palvelupäällikköä, joka nauttii ihmisten johtamisesta, asiakastyöstä ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä.

Palvelupäällikkönä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnasta kokonaisvaltaisesti. Johdat arjen tekemistä tavoitteellisesti, kehität palvelun laatua ja toimintaa sekä varmistat asiakastyytyväisyyden ja toiminnan kannattavuuden. Samalla huolehdit siitä, että toiminta on sujuvaa, turvallista ja arvojemme mukaista.

Roolissasi toimit keskeisessä asemassa asiakkaiden, henkilöstön ja sisäisten sidosryhmien välillä. Vaikutat suoraan asiakaskokemukseen, henkilöstön onnistumiseen ja liiketoiminnan tuloksellisuuteen sekä ja johdat muutosta sekä kehität toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti.

Tehtävässä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnan ja asiakassuhteiden johtamisesta sekä niiden kehittämisestä, laadun ja tehokkuuden varmistamisesta sekä myynnillisestä työotteesta ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta. Arjessa johdat henkilöstöä ja tuet työkykyä sekä vastaat talouden, resurssien ja kannattavuuden kokonaisvaltaisesta hallinnasta.

**Odotamme sinulta**

Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva koulutus, esimerkiksi korkeakoulututkinto. Kokemus esihenkilötehtävistä ja/tai palveluliiketoiminnasta on eduksi, mutta ei välttämätöntä.Ymmärrät talouden tunnuslukuja ja kannattavuuden johtamista. Työskentelet asiakaslähtöisesti ja myynnillisellä otteella, tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja osaat tarjota niihin toimivia ratkaisuja.

Olet vuorovaikutustaitoinen, oikeudenmukainen ja johdonmukainen esihenkilö, joka osaa motivoida, kehittää ja valmentaa tiimiään arjessa. Toiminnassasi korostuvat vastuullisuus, ratkaisukeskeisyys, liiketoimintalähtöinen ajattelu ja kyky johtaa kokonaisuuksia. Haluat myös aktiivisesti edistää yhdenvertaista ja arvostavaa työyhteisöä.

Tehtävä edellyttää voimassa olevaa ajokorttia sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä työssä liikutaan asiakkaiden ja tiimin tarpeiden mukaisesti eri kohteiden välillä laajalla työskentelyalueella.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin liiketoiminnan ytimessä sekä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ja kehittää toimintaa aidosti.

Lisäksi tarjoamme:

- kilpailukykyisen palkan n. 3400–3800 €/kk kokemuksesta riippuen

- kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan tuen tehtävässä onnistumiseen

- mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja rakentaa urapolkuasi kasvavassa organisaatiossa

- kansainvälisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön

- turvallisen ja arvostavan työympäristön reilut työehdot, turvallisen työympäristön ja työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista huolehtimisen

jobs.title: Safari Guide, Lapland Safaris Levi
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Safari Guides for various locations of Lapland Safaris for the winter season 2026–2027. We are looking for Safari Guides to work in Luosto, Levi, Saariselkä, Ylläs and Olos.**

As a Safari Guide, you get to introduce our international guests to the magnificent nature of Finnish Lapland and guide them through adventure activities. You may act as a guide, for example, on a snowshoe safari at the top of a fell, take the guests on a visit to a reindeer farm and a husky kennel, or snowmobile into the snowy forest to see the Northern Lights. In some of our destinations a part of safari guides job is to also guide various bus tours.

Your work tools can be snowmobiles, ice fishing gear, e-fatbikes, skis and snowshoes. As a guide, your workdays consist of preparing for the safari programs, meeting the guests before the safaris, as well as taking care of the clothing of your guests. You will help them dress up properly before each safari and after the activity you will take care of the clothes that you provided such as overalls, socks, boots and gloves. One of the most essential parts of the job is to help dress our guests with winter clothes, and all our safari guides work as part of our equipment team. After the safaris, cleaning and maintaining the equipment used on safaris is an important part of a safari guides daily routine as well. Whatever you do, every day you get to see the excitement on your guests faces as they prepare for new and unique experiences!

We are looking for people who enjoy being outdoors regardless of the weather and to maintain a positive attitude even on long and busy days. Your workdays are rarely the same, and a working day can consist of one or several different tasks, and a lot of work is also done in the evening. Changes to your daily tasks may come with short notice.

In addition to outdoor work, variation to your days comes from indoor clothing maintenance work. Work tasks and guest groups vary a little between destinations. The guides we are looking for are versatile and multitalented, with an open attitude towards different work tasks.

**In all our destinations,** knowledge of French language, is considered an advantage. We train our employees in first aid skills, but we value previously acquired first aid skills as well. At least a class B driver's license is an essential requirement for the job. BE driver's license and experience of driving a 9-seater vehicle in snowy conditions are considered advantageous, as well as knowledge of the area. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement.**

**In Luosto,** the safari guides may act as elf guides during the Christmas season. **In Luosto and Levi**, knowledge of French language (fluent) is a prerequisite.

**We expect from you:**

- Positive attitude and excellent cooperation and interaction skills

- Customer service-focused and group management skills

- Flexibility and ability to work under pressure

- Passion for outdoors and Interest in Finnish Laplands nature, culture and history

- Fluent English - knowledge of French, German, Italian or Spanish is considered an advantage


**We offer you:**

- Fun working days and a supportive team

- The opportunity to learn about the nature of the north

- Numerous leisure opportunities enjoying the real winter

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides for new employees a paid Arctic Guide -course at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will start in November 2026 and will last until the end of March 2027, in Rovaniemi a few positions end already mid-January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A-C, minimum hourly wage between 10,80-13,60 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

More information: info@laplandstaff.fi

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineers and Architects
jobs.description:
Nolwenture was established in 2012 and continues to grow and adapt, with an exciting portfolio of national and international clients across many industry sectors. We work together to make our clients' vision a reality and enable their core operations to be more efficient. In 2025 we became part of the ProVerse Group, who were a customer and for whom we continue to work with to create immersive experiences, with the communication and visualisation needed for remote operations. Nolwenture remains independent to offer a wide range of software development services. We are now looking for:

**Senior Software Engineers and Architects**

The Senior Software Engineers at Nolwenture are responsible for supporting both client and internal projects, playing to the individual's strengths within the project team – in the role of Lead Developer, Product Owner or Project Manager.

As a senior developer, you will work with modern technologies that are kept up-to-date by the entire team's contributions in order to keep our best practices current and ahead of the game. You will also support mid-level, junior and trainee level team members with their project tasks and broader learning and development.

You will work directly with our clients throughout the project lifecycle; gathering requirements, managing expectations, and helping to plan and coordinate delivery alongside the wider team.

For even more experienced and skilled candidates we also offer Architect level appointments.

**Why work with us?**

We are more than just software coders. At the core of our value proposition is the strength of our team, highly experienced and with diverse backgrounds and interests. We invest in our people, tools and processes, technical skills and capabilities.

Our shared mindset and strong ethics are reflected in our working culture. Everyone has a voice across the company, as it should be in a creative industry, where we have trust and a safe environment to innovate.

**Requirements**

We expect you to

- possess a strong understanding about software development

- have a desire to work on both web and mobile applications

- comply with our documentation processes and best practices

- be fluent in English as it is our operating language

- have good communication skills; at Nolwenture we work very closely with our clients

- be comfortable working directly with clients and confident taking on light project management responsibilities (e.g. previous experience as a Scrum Product Owner or had Scrum Master duties or having run sessions on story mapping or requirement gathering)

- be willing to adapt to our ways, learn new stuff and challenge yourself

- (and this is important!) readily ask others for help and return help where needed

- be familiar with, or keen to work with, Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools as part of our everyday workflow


We work with a variety of programming languages, but a JavaScript background will suit us well as we use a lot of NodeJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and React Native.

You will benefit from knowing additional languages (e.g. Swift, Kotlin and Python) and being familiar with Scrum project methodology and tools within the Atlassian suite (Jira, Tempo, Confluence). A background in areas such as Unity, WebRTC stream processing, DevOps, UI, robotics or GIS, or other data visualisation and physics / simulations experience, DB (sql/postgres etc.), administration (DBA) is of interest to us too.

Furthermore, an interest or experience in AI/ML will be highly appreciated.

**Work location**

Joensuu headquarters ideally. Other possible locations include Kuopio and Helsinki, and working remotely is also a long-term option.

**How to apply**

We are only accepting applications from candidates with a Finnish residence permit for work or EU/EEA/Swiss citizenship. Please send an email with a covering note along with your CV to recruitment@nolwenture.com and we will explain the process further from there onwards.

**_Want to know more about us? Please visit our website for further information https://nolwenture.com/_**

jobs.description:
Nolwenture was established in 2012 and continues to grow and adapt, with an exciting portfolio of national and international clients across many industry sectors. We work together to make our clients' vision a reality and enable their core operations to be more efficient. In 2025 we became part of the ProVerse Group, who were a customer and for whom we continue to work with to create immersive experiences, with the communication and visualisation needed for remote operations. Nolwenture remains independent to offer a wide range of software development services. We are now looking for:

**Software Test Engineers – Trainee to Mid-Level (QA Focus)**

The Test Engineers at Nolwenture play a key role in our project teams, working closely with developers, Product Owners and clients to make sure the software we build is reliable, high quality and fit for purpose. This role is open to candidates ranging from trainee level, just starting out in their QA career, through to mid-level engineers with a few years of testing experience.

You will design and execute test plans and test cases, perform manual and automated testing across our web and mobile applications, and help build out our automated test suites and CI/CD test pipelines alongside the rest of the team.

As you grow with us, you'll take on more responsibility for planning testing activities, liaising directly with clients on quality and acceptance criteria, and supporting the project team with light project coordination; there is a genuine path here into more senior QA, project management or engineering roles.

**Why work with us?**

We are more than just software coders. At the core of our value proposition is the strength of our team, highly experienced and with diverse backgrounds and interests. We invest in our people, tools and processes, technical skills and capabilities.

Our shared mindset and strong ethics are reflected in our working culture. Everyone has a voice across the company, as it should be in a creative industry, where we have trust and a safe environment to innovate.

**Requirements**

We expect you to

- have an interest in, or some experience with, software testing and quality assurance (trainee and junior candidates welcome – we will support your development)

- understand, or be keen to learn, testing fundamentals: test case design, exploratory testing, regression testing and bug reporting

- be comfortable working with, or eager to learn, test automation tools and frameworks such as Jest, Cypress, Playwright, Selenium or Appium

- have some familiarity with API testing tools (e.g. Postman) and issue tracking in Jira

- comply with our documentation processes and best practices

- be fluent in English as it is our operating language

- have good communication skills and be comfortable working directly with our clients, including supporting light project management tasks as you gain experience (e.g. assisting with story mapping, requirement gathering or sprint and task coordination)

- be willing to adapt to our ways, learn new things and challenge yourself

- (and this is important!) readily ask others for help and return help where needed

- a background in development and coding

- be familiar with, or keen to work with, Claude Code and other AI-assisted tools as part of our everyday workflow


Our engineering team works mainly in NodeJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and React Native, so exposure to testing within a JavaScript-based stack is a bonus, though not essential – we're happy to teach the specifics.

You will benefit from being familiar with Scrum project methodology and tools within the Atlassian suite (Jira, Tempo, Confluence). Testing experience within games, simulation or data visualisation environments (e.g. Unity, WebRTC stream processing, DevOps, UI, robotics or GIS) is also of interest to us.

Furthermore, an interest in AI/ML, or in exploring how AI tools can support testing and quality assurance, will be highly appreciated.

**Work location**

Joensuu headquarters. Other possible locations include Kuopio and Helsinki, and working remotely is also a long-term option.

**How to apply**

We are only accepting applications from candidates with a Finnish residence permit for work or EU/EEA/Swiss citizenship. Please send an email with a covering note along with your CV to recruitment@nolwenture.com and we will explain the process further from there onwards.

**_Want to know more about us? Please visit our website for further information https://nolwenture.com/_**
