Om opgaverne:

Som arbejdsleder for vores elektronik-team, vil nogle af opgaverne indebære:

  • Daglig ledelse af elektronikafdelingen – samt motivation og udvikling af afdelingens timelønnede medarbejdere gennem synlig og nærværende ledelse.

  • Sammensætning af det rette team til de enkelte opgaver.

  • Planlægning og koordinering af arbejdsopgaver med fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og leveringstid.

  • Samarbejde med øvrige arbejdsledere for at sikre optimal koordinering på tværs af afdelinger.

  • Opfølgning på timeforbrug og materialeforbrug på ordrer.

  • Opfølgning på ekstraarbejde og sikring af overensstemmelse mellem tilbud og udførelse.

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er udlært inden for elektronik (Elektronikmekaniker, elektronikfagtekniker, el-ingeniør, installatør el.lign.). Du kan også være udlært elektriker med interesse/erfaring og flair for elektronik.

  • Har erfaring med at lede og koordinere arbejdet i en medarbejdergruppe

  • Er pligtopfyldende, fleksibel og imødekommende.

  • Erfaring fra den maritime branche er en fordel.

Vi kan tilbyde dig:

  • En fast stilling på fuldtid.

  • Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer.

  • Pensionsordning og sundhedssikring.

  • En anderledes og spændende arbejdsplads, hvor sikkerhed og et godt arbejdsmiljø er topprioriteter.

  • Et stærkt socialt fællesskab og sjove sociale arrangementer.

 

Vil du med ombord?

Hvis du har lyst til at blive en del af et internationalt team, hvor vi sætter kvalitet i højsædet, så skal du sende din ansøgning afsted nu. Vi behandler ansøgninger og indkalder til samtaler løbende.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte vores produktionschef, René Hansen, på tlf. (+45) 26 87 44 33.

 

Ansøgning sendes til:          job@kselektro.dk

Tiltrædelse:                            Snarest muligt – eller efter aftale.

 

KS Elektro A/S er et ungt firma, der har stor erfaring og stærke kompetencer indenfor levering af el- og elektronik løsninger til den maritime industri. Vi beskæftiger ca. 150 medarbejdere i Skagen.

Med vores søsterselskab Karstensens Skibsværft, som er førende indenfor nybygning af pelagiske fartøjer og reparationer af forskellige skibstyper, beskæftiger vi tilsammen over 650 medarbejdere. Dertil har vi en ordrebog på 5-7 nybygninger og mellem 100-150 reparations – og større ombygningsopgaver om året.

jobs.title: Brand Designer, Creative Studio
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This role is based in New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.



This role sits on Notion’s Creative Studio, a small team of designers, illustrators, and filmmakers. Our work tells the story of our offering in a way that reflects the products themselves: smart, refined, and with a dash of wit on the side.



As a Brand Designer, you’ll work on high-impact brand initiatives and campaigns: setting direction from early strategy through final execution, partnering closely with stakeholders and executives, and raising the bar for craft and systems. You’ll be asked to define approaches, resolve ambiguity, and influence both project outcomes and how the team works.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Concept, art direct and design high-visibility moments from brand campaigns, product launches, and events, developing approaches that can scale across a broad range of surfaces, moments, and channels.

 - Contribute to our brand systems and develop standards and tooling that improve velocity and consistency for teammates near and far.

 - Mentor and raise the bar for other designers and creative partners through feedback, critique, and patterns that make great work repeatable.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 10+ years in an agency or in-house environment, with demonstrated leadership on ambiguous, complex, high-impact work.

 - A strong portfolio of work that’s culturally resonant and visually diverse, and that showcases your ability to tell stories across many channels.

 - A deep commitment to systems thinking, typographic excellence, and sensitivity to small details.

 - Experience working with a broad range of makers. You’ve teamed up with illustrators, animators, copywriters, filmmakers, photographers, and beyond to bring your ideas to life.

 - Excellent partnership skills. You can work hand-in-hand with cross-functional stakeholders, drive alignment, and make pragmatic tradeoffs.

 - A tinkerer’s mindset. You're curious about how your tools are evolving and have a strong perspective on how AI can expand creative expression and drive production. You’ll actively experiment with new AI workflows to concept, prototype, and push our design systems further.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $250,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Systems Engineer – Aerospace & Optical Communications
jobs.description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Chauffør - STARK Regionale Distributionscenter
jobs.description:
Jobbeskrivelse

Trives du med frihed, ansvar og kundekontakt, og har du erfaring med krankørsel? Så er du måske vores nye chauffør på STARKs regionale distributionscenter i Aarhus.

Du bliver en del af et team på 80 kolleger, der hver dag sørger for levering af byggematerialer til professionelle håndværkere, byggepladser og private kunder.

Dine opgaver

  • Levering af byggematerialer med lastbil og kran

  • Læsning og aflæsning med kran og truck

  • God og professionel kundeservice

  • Sikker og ansvarlig håndtering af varer

Vi forestiller os at du:

  • Har kørekort C

  • Har kran D-certifikat

  • Har truckcertifikat

  • Har EU-kvalifikationsbevis

  • Er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og serviceminded

Det får du hos os:

  • Moderne MAN- og Volvo-lastbiler

  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • Fri weekender og helligdage

  • En hverdag med variation og selvstændighed

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt fra 06:00 - 14:15

Bliv en del af STARK holdet

Hos STARK ser vi mangfoldighed som en værdifuld egenskab, og vores medarbejderes bidrag er nøglen til vores fremgang. Vi opfordrer derfor alle, som kan se sig selv i stillingen til at søge. Udover gode arbejdsforhold og ansættelse på overenskomst har vi personalepolitikker, der tilgodeser medarbejderen i tråd med STARKs værdi om ordentlighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer og vi håber, at du kan starte snarest.

Send os dit CV med en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge stillingen hos STARK RDC via linket. Vi inviterer til samtaler løbende og afslutter processen, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål jobbet, eller er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om STARK RDC som din kommende arbejdsplads, er du velkommen til at kontakte driftschef Bjarne Søndergaard på telefon +45 28 94 82 76

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

___________________________________________________
 

Om STARK

STARK er Danmarks største forhandler og distributør af byggematerialer med flere end 80 forretninger i Danmark og Grønland. STARK tilbyder også faglig rådgivning og en lang række services til både entreprenører og professionelle håndværkere. Virksomheden beskæftiger over 2.400 medarbejdere og er en del af STARK Group, der med flere end 18.500 medarbejdere og 1.050 forretninger og distributionscentre i Norden, Storbritannien, Tyskland og Østrig, er en førende leverandør af byggematerialer i Europa.

STARK Group har SBTi-godkendte net zero klimamål for 2050. Koncernen har underskrevet FN’s Global Compact principper og er anerkendt af EcoVadis med en Platinum-rating for sin bæredygtighedsindsats.

Restaurationsmanager

Dit Smørrebrød i Skagen er en travl virksomhed i rivende udvikling. 
Vores kendetegn er traditionelt dansk smørrebrød til Skawboer og turister – uden dikkedarer.
Godt gammeldags smørrebrød, klassiske frokost retter samt “Mormor mad” på aftenmenuen, hvor det er lavet fra bunden med friske råvarer – og ”salt, peber og kærlighed”, råvarer af bedste kvalitet samt vores kvalitet og service er ALTID i top.

Vores restaurant emmer af afslappet stemning og maden indtages i hyggelig gammel dansk atmosfære med rød og hvidternede duge. Skagens hyggeligste frokost og aftens restaurant. 

Vi har stor ansvarsfølelse for vores ansatte - vi værdsætter gensidig tillid. Vi løser vores opgaver i fællesskab ved at serverer godt gedigent mad i en afslappet atmosfære, som er fyldt med grin og glæde for så vel ansatte som for vores gæster.

•    Løse udfordringer løbende under vagten
•    Stå for varebestilling og lagerstyring

Vi forestiller os, at du

•    Har erfaring fra restaurant- eller servicebranchen
•    Trives med ansvar og kan bevare overblikket i travle perioder
•    Er serviceminded, imødekommende og løsningsorienteret
•    Kan motivere og skabe et godt samarbejde blandt kollegaerne

Restaurant Manager

Dit Smørrebrød in Skagen is a busy restaurant experiencing strong growth.
We are known for serving traditional Danish open sandwiches (smørrebrød) to both local residents and tourists. We pride ourselves on good old-fashioned ‘smørrebrød’, classic lunch dishes, and traditional home-style cooking on our evening menu. Our restaurant offers a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, where guests enjoy their meals surrounded by cosy Danish charm, complete with red-and-white checked tablecloths. We are proud to be one of Skagen's most inviting lunch and dinner restaurants.

•    Assisting with the training and onboarding of new employees
•    Resolving operational challenges as they arise during service
•    Managing stock orders and inventory control

About You

•    Has experience within the restaurant, hospitality, or service industry
•    Thrives on responsibility and remains calm under pressure during busy periods
•    Is service-minded, approachable, and solution-oriented
•    Can motivate colleagues and foster a positive team environment
•    Has a strong focus on quality and guest experience

We Offer

•    Permanent, year-round employment
•    Accommodation available
•    An informal working environment with plenty of room for good spirits
•    A relaxed workplace culture with a positive atmosphere
•    Some of the happiest guests around, because we serve great food
•    Supportive colleagues who work together as a team
•    A busy, exciting, and enjoyable high season
•    Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

Working Hours

jobs.description:
Socialfaglig medarbejder og fast tilkaldevikar søges til Toftehuset ApS

Der er tale om en fast stilling som socialfaglig medarbejder på 35 timer ugentligt og stillingen som fast vikaransættelse.
Angiv venligst i din ansøgning, hvilken stilling du er interesseret i.

Tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Om Toftehuset

Toftehuset ApS har gennem 18 år skabt trygge rammer for mennesker med forskellige problematikker som misbrug, hjemløshed og forskellige psykosociale barrierer. Vi holder til i Hviding tæt på Ribe og har plads til ni beboere fordelt på vores matrikel, der omfatter både lejligheder, en hytte og en udslusningsbolig.

Vores beboere er voksne over 18 år, der er visiteret efter §§ 101, 107 og 108 samt hjemløse, der har ophold jf. §110. Derudover tilbyder vi socialpædagogisk støtte efter §85 samt afsoning efter §78.

Vi søger en engageret socialfaglig medarbejder

Vil du gøre en forskel for mennesker, der har brug for støtte til at skabe en ny tilværelse?

Vi søger en engageret socialfaglig medarbejder til vores team. Arbejdstiden vil være 30 timer ugentligt, og der vil forekomme aften- og weekendvagter.

Som socialfaglig medarbejder bliver du en vigtig del af beboernes udvikling og hverdag. En central del af arbejdet er at støtte den enkelte beboer i at arbejde hen imod egne mål og delmål og i takt med deres forudsætninger udvikle færdigheder, struktur og selvstændighed.

Du vil blandt andet arbejde med ADL, sociale kompetencer, økonomi, bolig, kontakt til offentlige myndigheder samt støtte til at skabe struktur og sammenhæng i hverdagen. Du vil også deltage i husets daglige aktiviteter og ledsagelse.

En væsentlig del af arbejdet er desuden den socialfaglige dokumentation. Du skal kunne observere, beskrive og dokumentere beboernes udvikling, progression og udfordringer samt være med til løbende at følge op på de mål og delmål, der arbejdes med. Dokumentationen er en vigtig del af vores faglige arbejde og skal være med til at sikre, at indsatsen tager udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboers behov og udvikling.

Dine kvalifikationer

  • Du har en relevant socialfaglig uddannelse, f.eks. socialpædagog eller lign. uddannelse.

  • Du har interesse for arbejdet med mennesker i udsatte positioner og gerne erfaring fra socialområdet.

  • Du kan arbejde målrettet med beboernes udvikling og støtte dem i at nå deres individuelle mål og delmål.

  • Du kan dokumentere systematisk og fagligt og kan omsætte observationer til relevant dokumentation.

  • Du har forståelse for, at relation, struktur og tydelige rammer er væsentlige elementer i det socialfaglige arbejde.

  • Du har kørekort B.

  • Du er fleksibel og kan arbejde systematisk efter gældende retningslinjer.

  • Du er stabil, engageret og god til at opbygge tillidsfulde relationer.

  • Du kan fremvise straffeattest.

Dine ansvarsområder

  • Støtte og vejledning af beboerne i dagligdagens gøremål og udvikling af deres selvstændighed.

  • Arbejde målrettet med beboernes individuelle mål og delmål.

  • Observere og følge op på beboernes trivsel, udvikling og progression.

  • Udarbejde og ajourføre socialfaglig dokumentation.

  • Bidrage til statusbeskrivelser og evaluering af den socialfaglige indsats.

  • Deltage i husets daglige aktiviteter og ledsagelse.

  • Støtte beboerne i kontakten til offentlige myndigheder, sundhedsvæsen, familie og øvrige relevante samarbejdspartnere.

  • Indgå aktivt i det tværfaglige samarbejde omkring den enkelte beboer.

Vi tilbyder

  • En meningsfuld hverdag, hvor du gør en konkret forskel for mennesker i udsatte positioner.

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på relationer, udvikling og faglighed.

  • Et dedikeret og engageret team.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og supervision.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til at bringe egne faglige kompetencer og idéer i spil.

 

Ansøgninger med relevante bilag sendes pr. mail til leder@toftehuset.dk

jobs.title: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English
·         Be an EU citizen
 
Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
·         Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
·         Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
·         Start date: as soon as possible
·         Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
·         Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

jobs.title: Allround-håndværker søges til fast ansættelse/All-round tradesperson wanted for full-time position

Der kan også forekomme reparationer, vedligeholdelse og forskellige mindre håndværksopgaver, som kan berøre eller trække på andre håndværksfag.

Vi leder efter en fagligt dygtig og alsidig person med relevant brancheerfaring. Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar for dine opgaver og levere et pænt resultat med fokus på kvalitet og detaljer.

The work will include carpentry and minor renovation projects, building and levelling subfloors, installing click flooring, engineered flooring and solid wooden floors, as well as fitting trims, skirting boards, floor sanding and floor coating. jobs.title: Senior Service Engineer, High Voltage; DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for renewable energy and a sharp eye for technical details? Are you excited about managing projects from start to finish but also want to use your technical skillset and knowhow hands-on offshore? If so, we want to hear from you!

Your position 

As our new Senior Service Engineer in the Renewable division, you will be a valuable member of the Medium and High Voltage Service team, whose mission is to execute medium- and high-voltage service projects across disciplines for offshore assets, e.g. OSS, rigs, and WTGs. You will have the chance to drive all aspects of the project process, from initial client inquiries to final execution. Moreover, this role provides an exciting opportunity for you to make a lasting impact on the projects you work on and advance your professional development.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be our Global HQ in Esbjerg, and you should live within daily driving distance of Esbjerg. The position is full-time, and up to 90 travel days per year should be expected.
“You will be part of a team of fantastic and competent colleagues who prioritise teamwork and a ‘winning as a team’ mentality. Our team values a flexible work atmosphere with an emphasis on balancing work and personal life, as well as opportunities for professional growth. In this role, you will have great opportunities to bring your own ideas to the table and play a key role in shaping our projects and services.”                                                              – Christian Poulsen, Head of MV & HV Service

Your tasks & responsibilities 

As a Senior Service Engineer, you will be responsible for managing and executing MV & HV Service projects from a technical perspective in collaboration with cross-functional teams, external partners, and customers. Moreover, you will apply your expertise hands-on by using your specialist knowledge to execute the service. You will be responsible from the initiation and tendering of the project through to delivering a solution and finally executing it offshore. This will involve collaborating with various teams across the organisation and externally.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • You will have end-to-end technical responsibility for specific projects in the MV & HV Service team, from tendering, clarification, and planning to execution.
  • Provide technical assistance and calculations to support projects across the organisation.
  • Perform hands-on offshore special technical testing and troubleshooting.
  • Coordinate and plan work packages for execution, both on- and offshore.

Your profile & qualifications

As a person, you enjoy having a lot of responsibility and thrive in an environment where you communicate daily with many stakeholders. You are driven by completing tasks to the best of your ability and remain in control, even in fast-paced situations. You have a safety-focused mindset and never compromise when it comes to safety on the job. Additionally, you are service-minded and greatly enjoy collaborating with your colleagues.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • An engineering degree or similar qualification within electrical systems.
  • Broad know-how of MV and HV systems and technologies from the offshore wind industry.
  • In-depth knowledge of electrical systems.
  • A proven track record of servicing protection systems for both low voltage and high voltage.
  • Broad knowledge of electrical systems: high, medium, and low voltage.
  • Desire and willingness to travel and perform hands-on onsite work.
  • Fluency in English, written and verbal.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 
So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 

Change. With us. 

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Christian Poulsen, Head of MV & HV Service at +45 2294 4199.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.description:
MEHANIČAR / MEHATRONIČAR (m/ž)

Kao obiteljsko poduzeće znamo da su ljudi ti, koji svojim znanjem i vještinama pridonose našem uspjehu. Isto im vraćamo sa stimulativnim primanjima i korporativnom kulturom u kojoj se žive obiteljske vrijednosti. Želimo biti više od skupine timova u jednom poduzeću. Međusobna suradnja znači za nas međusobnu povezanost. Svi smo složni u uvjerenju da zajedno postižemo velike stvari.

Kao poduzeće. Kao tim. Kao obitelj.

Očekuju te sljedeći zadaci:

  • Redovito održavanje strojeva u proizvodnom pogonu
  • Utvrđivanje i otklanjanje kvarova na strojevima
  • Izvođenje servisa, remonta i montaže strojeva
  • Briga o zalihi rezervnih dijelova
  • Godišnje provođenje ispitivanja elektro uređaja

  • Završena škola: elektrotehničar, elektromehaničar, mehatroničar ili električar, stručnjak za pneumatiku i hidrauliku

  • Pouzdanost i samostalnost u obavljanju radnih zadataka
  • Izraženi timski duh
  • Fleksibilnost
  • Poželjno poznavanje engleskog ili njemačkog jezika u govoru i pismu

Što te očekuje:

  • Rad u internacionalnom okruženju
  • Stimulativna primanja
  • Mogućnost napredovanja
  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme
  • Poticajna i prijateljska radna atmosfera
  • Uvođenje u posao pod vodstvom mentora
  • Dvosmjenski rad
  • Vrhunska oprema i postrojenje

jobs.title: AI Enablement & Automation Engineer (80-100%, f::m::d) - Remote (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
Remote AI Enablement & Automation Engineer (80-100%, f::m::d) Salary: 65000 - 75000 EUR per year. At OnlineDoctor AG we are looking for a Machine-Learning engineer! Our tech stack: AI, AI Agents, Cloud, Confluence, Support, JIRA, Security, SharePoint. Requirements: - Professional experience in software engineering, automation engineering, systems integration, internal tooling, or a comparable hands-on technical role.

- Proven experience independently designing, building, and maintaining software, integrations, or automation solutions used in day-to-day operations.
- Strong practical programming or scripting skills and experience working with APIs, webhooks, data sources, business systems, and automation or integration tools.
- Practical familiarity with generative AI, AI assistants, or AI-supported workflows. Deep machine-learning or AI research expertise is not required.
- Understanding of authentication, authorization, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and basic cloud-security practices.

- Design and build internal automation and AI-enabled solutions, including assistants, agents, document workflows, extraction and classification, and knowledge search.
- Build and maintain integrations between AI services and systems such as SharePoint, Teams, Jira, Confluence, Zoho, and other internal tools using APIs, webhooks, scripting, and automation tools.

Solution Ownership & Operations

- Take ownership of solutions beyond the prototype stage, including testing, deployment, monitoring, documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
- Maintain and further develop existing automation and AI solutions across the organization.
- Establish reusable standards for integrations, access controls, testing, monitoring, error handling, documentation, and human review.

AI Enablement & Governance

- Support teams in evaluating automation and AI ideas, developing suitable solutions, and using approved tools effectively.
- Identify and prioritize internal automation and AI use cases based on value, feasibility, effort, data sensitivity, risk, and expected adoption.
- Work closely with IT, Security, Privacy, Quality Management, Regulatory, Legal, and other relevant experts to translate agreed requirements into practical technical controls.
- Work closely with the responsible compliance, security, privacy, quality, AI, and regulatory experts.

Were looking for an AI Enablement & Automation Engineer to help us improve and automate internal processes across OnlineDoctor. - Additional benefits: Free choice of laptop, home office allowance, additional vacation day, etc.
- Our Values: Respect and tolerance are part of our DNA. We actively support diversity and inclusion, believing they are the keys to a successful and healthy company culture.

Work Location & Relocation:
Due to current legal and regulatory reasons, we can only hire team members who live in Germany or Switzerland. If youre based elsewhere but excited to join OnlineDoctor, were happy to discuss and support your relocation to either country.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.title: Külaliskorterite koristaja
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Dream Stay OÜ on pikaajalise kogemusega lühiajalise rendiga tegelev ettevõte, kelle hallata on üle 120 külaliskorteri Tallinnas.
Seoses suvise hooaja ja suurenenud töömahuga otsime oma meeskonda külaliskorterite koristajaid nii täis- kui osalise koormusega. Võimalik on töötada ka ainult nädalavahetustel (näiteks laupäevast esmaspäevani) — töö sobib hästi lisatööks või hooajaliseks tööks suveperioodil. Enamik külaliskortereid asub Tallinna vanalinnas ja kesklinnas või nende vahetus läheduses. Pakume tööd külaliskorterites. Palun arvestage, et kõik korterid – kokku umbes 120 – asuvad erinevates hoonetes. Autot tööks vaja ei ole — liikumine objektide vahel toimub ühistranspordiga ning see aeg on samuti tasustatud. Linna peal pesu vedama ei pea: puhta pesu toob kohale meie kuller. Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid on olemas apartementides või keldriruumides. Koristaja peab endaga kaasas kandma vaid meilt saadud lappe, kindaid ja mõned švammid. Töö sisaldab vahetusi nädalavahetustel ja pühade ajal — see on turismisektoris töötamise loomulik osa. Esmaspäevast reedeni töögraafikut kahjuks pakkuda ei ole võimalik ning väikeste lastega tööl viibimine ei ole lubatud.

Omalt poolt pakume: * Kaasaegseid töövahendeid
* Sõbralikku ning toetavat kollektiivi * Töötulemustele vastavat töötasu

Muud nõuded: Oled sobiv kandidaat, kui sul on olemas töötahe, armastad puhtust ja korrektsust ning oled võimeline töötama iseseisvalt.
Varasem töökogemus sarnasel ametikohal on väga hinnatud ja annab eelise. Oluline tingimus on nutitelefoni kasutamise oskus, kuna põhiline suhtlus ja töökorraldus toimub grupivestluses.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

Koormus, vahetused: 0,5-1,0

jobs.title: Senior Immersion Engineer
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The immersion engineering team is looking for a naval architect, maritime engineer or offshore engineer to strengthen the team. Immersion engineering is taking care of all calculations regarding tunnel elements float up (weight analysis, determine ballast concrete and water, longitudinal section forces, floating stability), transfers in basins and harbor (winch operations with or without vessel assistance), mooring of the tunnel elements, transport to offshore location, immersion (including but not limited to dynamic analyses) and the stability of the elements after immersion.

As an Immersion Engineer, you will participate in the team responsible for floating up and/or hoisting the concrete tunnel elements, equipping them in the port and then transporting and installing them at sea. In the first phase you will participate in the preparation of this crucial operation, by making ballast plans e.g.. In the second phase, you will be part of the operational team that does the immersion work, assisting the Immersion Master by giving technical advice.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

  • During the preparatory phase, you are responsible for the ballast plans and float up calculations.

  • You take part in the interface management with other departments within FLC regarding specific parts of the T&I scope

  • You will coordinate part of the design scope between Work Preparations and the design team based in the Netherlands

  • You are involved in the management/operation of Tunnel Control Systems

  • You ensure the conclusions and results from the design documents are correctly taken over in the work method statements, drawings and operation manuals for the Immersion Pontoon specific operations related to the overall transport and immersion scope

  • You liaise with the Marine Warranty Surveyor and contribute to the work procedures, Go/No Go procedures

  • During float up and ballasting you check if the operations stay within boundary conditions and act accordingly

  • During the execution phase, you advise during the transport and installation of the elements. You will be present in the command unit of the immersion pontoons during offshore operations.

  • You will do checks during execution, monitor the immersion process, and have an advisory role to the one in charge of the operation. You are also prepared and ready to deal with contingencies if any might occur

  • After immersion, you will do checks on data to create lessons learned for next operations

Qualifications:

  • You are a qualified naval architect/maritime engineer/offshore engineer with minimum of 7 years experience

  • You have prior experience with immersion of large structures or offshore lifting operations

  • You have a good understanding of stability calculations, mooring calculations and hydrodynamics

  • You are a hands-on problem solver and a decision maker

  • You are a team player with strong communication skills

  • You find it a challenge to work in a international, multi-cultural work-environment in which communication and team spirit is key to success

  • You are fluent in English.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company.

Full time employment with health insurance and lunch arrangement available upon request.

Workplace:

Based in Rødbyhavn.

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible and. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

jobs.title: ROSKILDE: THATCHERS WANTED – A BAD HAIR DAY IS ACTUALLY PART OF THE JOB
jobs.description:
ROSKILDE: THATCHERS WANTED – A BAD HAIR DAY IS ACTUALLY PART OF THE JOB

Straw in your hair.

Straw on your clothes.

Straw in places you didn’t even know straw could get into.

But at the end of the day, you’ll have a thatched roof you can look at and be proud of.

We are looking for several skilled thatchers to work on thatched roofs in and around Roskilde.

A CRAFT YOU CAN ACTUALLY SEE

Your working day will revolve around thatching and thatched roofs.

You’ll work on a variety of tasks within the trade, where craftsmanship, precision and attention to the finished result really matter.

Because there’s one slightly unforgiving thing about a thatched roof:

It’s pretty difficult to hide a poor finish behind a sheet of plasterboard.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

There are two ways you could be a good fit:

You have relevant training or qualifications

or

You have hands-on experience with thatching.

The important thing is that you know the trade and are able to contribute from day one.

In addition:

✔ A Category B driving licence is required
✔ A BE driving licence is a plus
✔ You can work independently
✔ You take pride and responsibility in your craftsmanship
✔ You have an eye for quality and a good finish
✔ You’re comfortable with your workplace being a little higher up than the car park

A COMPANY VEHICLE CAN BE PROVIDED

So there’s no need to turn your own car into a combination of toolbox, storage unit and hay bale.

If you want to work in a trade where quality craftsmanship is still done by hand – and can be admired from a distance, we’d like to hear from you.

And no...

You don’t have to enjoy finding straw in your socks. That part just comes with the job.

jobs.title: Site Engineer, Mechanical for Renewables; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Aarhus, Worldwide
jobs.description:
If you are as passionate about sustainability and the green transition as we are, then this is a great opportunity for you to join an international company in growth as our new Site Engineer, Mechanical for our Renewables Division!
 
Your position 

As our new Site Engineer, Mechanical at Semco Maritime you will join an experienced, highly skilled and passionate team of engineers in our Renewables division. This team has been responsible for creating one of the largest project portfolios within offshore substations worldwide.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. 
We are working on sites globally in our markets, including Europe, Asia and the USA. So, traveling work is the standard and we work both offshore and onshore.

Your tasks & responsibilities 

You will be involved in the construction of offshore substation for windfarms and distribution/transmission projects world-wide. You, together with your team will be responsible for installations, tests, and commissioning of mechanical systems such as ventilation systems, cooling systems, fire extinguishing system, diesel generator system and fuel system.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 

  • Coordinating and managing daily site activities for 4-10 skilled workers
  • Ensuring that the project activities adhere to the schedule and activities are planned accordingly
  • Coordinate and plan with installation suppliers / yard / partners
  • Purchase and overseeing the timely delivery of materials and coordination with vendors
  • Plan and align with Engineering department on changes in design and/or other topics
  • Ad-hoc daily tasks and problem solving
  • Run and manage start-up and commissioning of mechanical systems

Your profile & qualifications 

We imagine that you are an ambitious and talented professional with a keen eye for detail. You are also a dedicated team player with a positive attitude as well as good commercial awareness and managerial skills.
 
To succeed in this position, we expect that you:
  • Preferred to have a master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, marine engineering or similar
  • Have prior hands-on experience with some of the mechanical systems
  • Have experience working with staff and supplier contracts
  • Possess a safety-first mindset
  • Would like to work in an international setting where a lot of traveling is required to go to the sites
  • Have effective interpersonal skills and great communication skills in English

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 
Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  
We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   
Care to join the movement? 

Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Senior Research Adviser for EU, International Funding, Innovation and Impact, Faculty of Health Sciences
jobs.description:
Are you curious about how FP10 will change the opportunities and requirements facing universities? Are you interested in the growing expectations for innovation and impact arising from research? And would you like to work both strategically and closely with researchers and projects, with one clear objective: to strengthen SUND’s international position and secure more external funding?

Then you could play a central role in SUND Research Support. We are looking for an experienced research adviser who from 1 December 2026 can serve as our key specialist for EU and international funding opportunities – and help prepare the unit for tomorrow’s requirements in relation to funding, project delivery, innovation and societal impact.

Responsibilities
You will take an overview of EU and international funding: from developments in Horizon Europe and FP10 to specific calls, partnerships and opportunities for SUND researchers. You will translate policy and programme developments into action and help us position ourselves early as new agendas emerge.

The role spans strategic intelligence and portfolio oversight through to hands-on advice and coordination of prioritised initiatives. Some days you will work on long-term EU positioning and pipeline development; on others, closely with a researcher, an international consortium or a specific call. We do not expect you to do everything yourself, but you will need to spot opportunities, bring together the right expertise and drive progress.

Innovation and impact are important parts of the role. You will strengthen our impact-upfront approach and ensure that requirements relating to involvement, uptake, implementation and knowledge valorisation are considered early. At the same time, you will contribute to a smooth transition from pre-award to post-award, so that project delivery is considered from the outset and lessons from funded projects and project implementation feed into new applications.

You will be both a key contributor to specific EU and international initiatives and a co-developer of our shared models, workflows and portfolio overview. The aim is a more coherent approach to international funding – not simply more individual applications.

Qualifications
We are looking for an experienced professional who thrives at the intersection of research, EU policy, funding, innovation and impact. You have solid experience of EU or international funding, research development or research support, and a good knowledge of Horizon Europe or other major international programmes.

You work strategically and analytically but are also keen to turn insight into tangible results. You are a strong coordinator and relationship-builder who can navigate complex processes, bring together expertise and build trust with researchers, colleagues and management. You communicate confidently in both Danish and English.
It is an advantage if you also have experience of areas such as EU policy, international consortia, Brussels networks, post-award, innovation, societal impact or knowledge valorisation. We do not expect you to be an expert in all of these areas. A PhD or other research experience may be an advantage but is not essential.

In addition, you have an understanding of and a desire to work with digitalization and artificial intelligence (AI) in relation to optimizing processes and creating value within the organization. 

About SUND Research Support and the Faculty of Health Sciences
SUND Research Support assists researchers at the Faculty of Health Sciences at SDU from the early idea and funding opportunity through to application, project delivery, innovation and impact.

We aim to work more proactively with funding intelligence, positioning, partnerships and long-term pipelines – and to create stronger links between pre-award, post-award, innovation and impact. At the same time, we want to use data, organisational learning and AI more systematically.

You will have the opportunity both to work directly with researchers and projects and to help shape how a modern research support function should operate in the years ahead. You will play a central role in SUND’s international funding activities in the run-up to FP10 and help create stronger links between EU/international funding, post-award, innovation and impact.

You will work closely with strong health sciences research environments, management teams and colleagues with a range of specialist profiles. We are interested in new ways of working and in how data, digital tools and AI can add value to research support. This is an opportunity both to deliver results today and to help shape how we work tomorrow.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.
As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

Read more about the Faculty of Health Sciences here.

Contact
If you would like more information about the position, you are welcome to contact head of SUND Research Support Anne Kathrine Overgaard, tlf. 60111043, e-mail: aovergaard@health.sdu.dk or Head of Education and Secretariat Merete Munk på mmunk@health.sdu.dk.

Application Process
The application deadline is 29 September 2026 at 11:59 PM. We expect to conduct interviews 7 October 2026. 

Employment starts on 1 December 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Salary and Terms of Employment
Your place of employment will be the University of Southern Denmark in Odense, Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

There may be limited travel activity to other SDU campus cities.

Employment is in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and collective agreement for academics (AC).

The position is full time.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range of the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.
SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. 

If you are interested in the position, you must submit an application that includes a cover letter, CV indicating months and years (without photo), and diploma. All documents related to the application should not contain photos or CPR numbers – if so, the CPR number must be redacted.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. The cover letter and CV must not exceed 5 MB.

Guidance on the application process can be found here.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified applicants, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

About SDU
The University of Southern Denmark exists to create value for and with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we aim to make a positive difference for society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talent. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. It is the university’s researchers, teachers, students, leaders, and technical-administrative staff who form the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Tenure-track Assistant Professorship at the Hans Christian Andersen Centre with a Focus on Digital Humanities, Textual Genesis and Nineteenth-Century Literature
jobs.description:
A five-year tenure-track assistant professorship is available at the Hans Christian Andersen Centre, Department for the Study of Culture and Language, University of Southern Denmark, with appointment from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The Hans Christian Andersen Centre is an internationally leading research environment within Andersen studies. Its research encompasses literary, cultural and public dissemination-oriented approaches to Andersen’s works, life and cultural significance. The Centre conducts research at the highest international level with the aim of developing new literary, cultural and dissemination-oriented perspectives on Andersen’s complete artistic oeuvre. The Centre provides a framework for collaboration with Danish and international researchers, cultural mediators and other actors in the field.

Job Content
The assistant professorship is a tenure-track position with a view to obtaining a permanent appointment as associate professor following a positive academic assessment.

The position is affiliated with the project Hans Christian Andersen’s Fairy Tales and Stories – the Digital Manuscript Edition and will, in close interaction with the project’s existing research activities, contribute to integrating digital, philological and literary approaches.

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Learning Experiences Creator
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit is where millions of people learn to build software - and our documentation and learning content are where they get going or give up. We're taking ownership of that experience, and we're looking for a Learning Experience Creator who can make it worthy of the product: someone who turns product knowledge into experiences people actually use - clear written docs, guided learning, short video, interactive experiences - findable at the moment of need, accurate every time, and genuinely enjoyable.

You're a learning-experience creator first. You understand how people actually learn a product - what they're trying to accomplish, where they get stuck, what format serves each moment - and you move fluidly between writing a crisp help article, designing a hands-on walkthrough, and producing a short video. Underneath it all, you're a storyteller: you know how to earn attention in the first few seconds, hold it against real-world attention spans, and make ideas stick - and sometimes make something people can't help but share. You're also a builder: unafraid to try new formats and experiment, you read the data and listen to customers, and you continually improve and evolve with speed as our product evolves. You'll turn complex things into simple, useful experiences, and you'll own how well they land.

The Mission: help every user - external customers and internal teams - self-serve to reach their creative and business goals, with content so good, so current, and so findable that they don't need to open a ticket. Success looks like real ticket deflection, faster activation, and high CSAT.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - New documentation and learning content. You'll populate our documentation and learning surfaces with new, accurate, plain-language content - help articles, answer-first FAQs, goal-based tutorials, and rebuilt getting-started paths - prioritized by real reader and ticket data, made at volume with the help of our AI- native content tools.

 - The content lifecycle. Content isn't done when it ships. You'll keep the library current through every product launch - freshness reviews, launch-day updates, retiring what's stale - so nothing published contradicts the product. Our pipeline flags what's drifting; you own making it right.

 - Learning experiences across formats. Written first where reading serves best - plus short-form video, microlearning, interactive courses, quick walkthroughs, GIFs, and in-product tips. You pick the format that fits the job, not the other way around, and you bring a storyteller's instinct for attention and memorability to every one - learning content competes with everything else on someone's screen, and yours wins. You keep pushing into new, innovative experiences as our tools grow.

 - A content calendar built for effectiveness. You plan what gets made and when - covering the topics customers most need help with, sequenced for maximum impact, so the library actually answers the questions people are asking.

 - Findability. You make sure content is easy to discover - titled, tagged, and structured so people (and the AI assistants that read our docs) find the right answer through search, at the moment of need. Great content nobody can find doesn't deflect anything, and this is yours to own.

 - Engagement and outcomes. You care whether it worked - reader feedback, findability, completion and watch-through, self-serve resolution, deflection, CSAT - and you tune the calendar and the craft based on what the data and customers tell you.

 - A recognizable voice. A consistent, human style across docs, learning, and video that makes every piece feel like part of one connected experience, whether someone reads a single article or completes a whole course.

 


HOW YOU'LL WORK WITH THE TEAM

This role is a force-multiplier - it makes the whole team's knowledge reach people. You won't work alone:

• With our Technical Customer Education Specialist for accuracy and depth - they bring the technical truth; you turn it into clear, findable content people trust and enjoy.

• With our Sr. Learning Experience Lead on what content is needed and what's working - they own the learning platform, journeys, and measurement; you read the same effectiveness data to steer the calendar.

• With our docs and product partners on launches - so new features ship with accurate, ready content on day one, not weeks later.

• With the hiring manager and the wider team to scale our content capability together, so the sum is greater than the parts.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• A proven learning-content creator. A portfolio of documentation, tutorials, courses, or product education that people actually used and learned from - across at least two formats, with written content among them. You understand clarity, structure, and story, and you can prove it.

• A strong writer. You make complex or dry topics genuinely clear and engaging in plain language, with warmth and a point of view. Docs people want to read are your craft.

• A gifted storyteller, across media. You understand hooks, pacing, attention spans, and what makes content memorable - sometimes shareable, occasionally viral - and you apply that craft to written, video, and interactive work alike. It shows up in a doc's first sentence as much as a video's first five seconds.

• A capable short-form video creator. Video is one of your formats - you understand watchability and modern platform sensibilities, and you're comfortable producing (on or off camera) with AI-assisted workflows.

• A builder and experimenter. You try new formats and ideas, take calculated content risks, glean insights from data and customers, and continually improve - determining the right approach even when the problem is ambiguous.

• Fast to learn a product. You get up to speed quickly and can represent it accurately to newcomers - you don't need to be a developer, but you make technical things make sense.

• Outcome-minded. You define what success looks like for your work, and you care about real results (deflection, activation, self-serve success, CSAT), not just output.

• A strong thought partner. You share ideas openly, seek other perspectives, and collaborate well across a small, fast team.

 


BONUS

• Experience writing or maintaining developer or product documentation (docs-as-code, Markdown-based platforms) - and a feel for content lifecycle at scale.

• Hands-on with AI-native build or content tools (Replit) and modern editing/production workflows.

• Instructional design fundamentals - you know why a checklist beats a paragraph and when a video beats both.

• A feel for discoverability and search - how people (and AI assistants) find content and how to help them.

• Experience running a content channel, editorial calendar, or creator program with an audience - bonus points if something you made really took off.

 

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
